 13814                                  ;fren90:	
 13815                                  ;	;jmp	FCB_RET_ERR
 13816                                  ;	; 08/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 13817                                  ;	jmp	short fcb_close_err
 13818                                  
 13819                                  ;Break <Misbehavior fixers>
 13820                                  ;
 13821                                  ;   FCBs suffer from several problems. First, they are maintained in the
 13822                                  ;   user's space so he may move them at will. Second, they have a small
 13823                                  ;   reserved area that may be used for system information. Third, there was
 13824                                  ;   never any "rules for behavior" for FCBs; there was no protocol for their
 13825                                  ;   usage.
 13826                                  ;
 13827                                  ;   This results in the following misbehavior:
 13828                                  ;
 13829                                  ;	infinite opens of the same file:
 13830                                  ;
 13831                                  ;	While (TRUE) {			While (TRUE) {
 13832                                  ;	    FCBOpen (FCB);		    FCBOpen (FCB);
 13833                                  ;	    Read (FCB); 		    Write (FCB);
 13834                                  ;	    }				    }
 13835                                  ;
 13836                                  ;	infinite opens of different files:
 13837                                  ;
 13838                                  ;	While (TRUE) {			While (TRUE) {
 13839                                  ;	    FCBOpen (FCB[i++]); 	    FCBOpen (FCB[i++]);
 13840                                  ;	    Read (FCB); 		    Write (FCB);
 13841                                  ;	    }				    }
 13842                                  ;
 13843                                  ;	multiple closes of the same file:
 13844                                  ;
 13845                                  ;	FCBOpen (FCB);
 13846                                  ;	while (TRUE)
 13847                                  ;	    FCBClose (FCB);
 13848                                  ;
 13849                                  ;	I/O after closing file:
 13850                                  ;
 13851                                  ;	FCBOpen (FCB);
 13852                                  ;	while (TRUE) {
 13853                                  ;	    FCBWrite (FCB);
 13854                                  ;	    FCBClose (FCB);
 13855                                  ;	    }
 13856                                  ;
 13857                                  ;   The following is am implementation of a methodology for emulating the
 13858                                  ;   above with the exception of I/O after close. We are NOT attempting to
 13859                                  ;   resolve that particular misbehavior. We will enforce correct behaviour in
 13860                                  ;   FCBs when they refer to a network file or when there is file sharing on
 13861                                  ;   the local machine.
 13862                                  ;
 13863                                  ;   The reserved fields of the FCB (10 bytes worth) is divided up into various
 13864                                  ;   structures depending on the file itself and the state of operations of the
 13865                                  ;   OS. The information contained in this reserved field is enough to
 13866                                  ;   regenerate the SFT for the local non-shared file. It is assumed that this
 13867                                  ;   regeneration procedure may be expensive. The SFT for the FCB is
 13868                                  ;   maintained in a LRU cache as the ONLY performance inprovement.
 13869                                  ;
 13870                                  ;   No regeneration of SFTs is attempted for network FCBs.
 13871                                  ;
 13872                                  ;   To regenerate the SFT for a local FCB, it is necessary to determine if the
 13873                                  ;   file sharer is working. If the file sharer is present then the SFT is not
 13874                                  ;   regenerated.
 13875                                  ;
 13876                                  ;   Finally, if there is no local sharing, the full name of the file is no
 13877                                  ;   longer available. We can make up for this by using the following
 13878                                  ;   information:
 13879                                  ;
 13880                                  ;	The Drive number (from the DPB).
 13881                                  ;	The physical sector of the directory that contains the entry.
 13882                                  ;	The relative position of the entry in the sector.
 13883                                  ;	The first cluster field.
 13884                                  ;	The last used SFT.
 13885                                  ;      OR In the case of a device FCB
 13886                                  ;	The low 6 bits of sf_flags (indicating device type)
 13887                                  ;	The pointer to the device header
 13888                                  ;
 13889                                  ;   We read in the particular directory sector and examine the indicated
 13890                                  ;   directory entry. If it matches, then we are kosher; otherwise, we fail.
 13891                                  ;
 13892                                  ;   Some key items need to be remembered:
 13893                                  ;
 13894                                  ;	Even though we are caching SFTs, they may contain useful sharing
 13895                                  ;	information. We enforce good behavior on the FCBs.
 13896                                  ;
 13897                                  ;	Network support must not treat FCBs as impacting the ref counts on
 13898                                  ;	open VCs. The VCs may be closed only at process termination.
 13899                                  ;
 13900                                  ;	If this is not an installed version of the DOS, file sharing will
 13901                                  ;	always be present.
 13902                                  ;
 13903                                  ;	We MUST always initialize lstclus to = firclus when regenerating a
 13904                                  ;	file. Otherwise we start allocating clusters up the wazoo.
 13905                                  ;
 13906                                  ;	Always initialize, during regeneration, the mode field to both isFCB
 13907                                  ;	and open_for_both. This is so the FCB code in the sharer can find the
 13908                                  ;	proper OI record.
 13909                                  ;
 13910                                  ;   The test bits are:
 13911                                  ;
 13912                                  ;	00 -> local file
 13913                                  ;	40 -> sharing local
 13914                                  ;	80 -> network
 13915                                  ;	C0 -> local device
 13916                                  
 13917                                  ;Break	<SaveFCBInfo - store pertinent information from an SFT into the FCB>
 13918                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13919                                  ;
 13920                                  ;   SaveFCBInfo - given an FCB and its associated SFT, copy the relevant
 13921                                  ;	pieces of information into the FCB to allow for subsequent
 13922                                  ;	regeneration. Poke LRU also.
 13923                                  ;
 13924                                  ;   Inputs:	ThisSFT points to a complete SFT.
 13925                                  ;		DS:SI point to the FCB (not an extended one)
 13926                                  ;   Outputs:	The relevant reserved fields in the FCB are filled in.
 13927                                  ;		DS:SI preserved
 13928                                  ;		ES:DI point to sft
 13929                                  ;   Registers modified: All
 13930                                  ;
 13931                                  ;
 13932                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13933                                  ;
 13934                                  
 13935                                  	; 08/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 13936                                  	; 20/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 13937                                  	
 13938                                  SaveFCBInfo:
 13939                                  
 13940 00001E1E 36C43E[9E05]            	LES	DI,[SS:THISSFT]		; SS override
 13941 00001E23 E80DFA                  	call	IsSFTNet
 13942 00001E26 740B                    	JZ	short SaveLocal		; if not network then save local info
 13943                                  ;
 13944                                  ;----- In net support -----
 13945                                  ;
 13946                                  	; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 13947                                  
 13948                                  	; MSDOS 3.3
 13949                                  	;;mov	ax,[es:di+1Dh]
 13950                                  	;mov	ax,[es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_dirsec]
 13951                                  	;;mov	[si+1Ah],ax
 13952                                  	;mov	[si+fcb_net_handle],ax
 13953                                  	;push	es
 13954                                  	;push	di
 13955                                  	;;les	di,[es:di+19h]
 13956                                  	;LES	DI,[ES:DI+sf_netid]

 14459                                  ; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 14460                                  ; LRUFCB for MSDOS 6.0 !
 14461                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14462                                  ;
 14463                                  ; LruFCB -- allocate the LRU SFT from the SFT Table. The LRU scheme
 14464                                  ; maintains separate counts for net/Share and local SFTs. We allocate a 
 14465                                  ; net/Share SFT only if we do not find a local SFT. This helps keep
 14466                                  ; net/Share SFTs which cannot be regenerated for as long as possible. We
 14467                                  ; optimize regeneration operations by keeping track of the current local
 14468                                  ; SFT. This avoids scanning of the SFTs as long as we have at least one 
 14469                                  ; local SFT in the SFT Block.
 14470                                  ;
 14471                                  ; Inputs: al = 0 => Regenerate SFT operation
 14472                                  ;	    = 1 => Allocate new SFT for Open/Create
 14473                                  ;
 14474                                  ; Outputs: Carry clear
 14475                                  ;	 	es:di = Address of allocated SFT
 14476                                  ;	  	ThisSFT = Address of allocated SFT
 14477                                  ;
 14478                                  ;	  carry set if closes of net/Share files failed 
 14479                                  ;		al = error_FCB_unavailable
 14480                                  ;
 14481                                  ; Registers affected: None
 14482                                  ;
 14483                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14484                                  
 14485                                  ;LruFCB	PROC	NEAR
 14486                                  LRUFCB:
 14487                                  	; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 14488                                  	; DOSCODE:5805h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 14491                                  	; DOSCODE:57F1h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 14492

 14801                                  	; called from SFTFromFCB. SS already DOSDATA
 14802

 14811

 14815                                  
 14816                                  	; The FCB is for a network or a sharing based system. At this point 
 14817                                  	; we have already closed the SFT for this guy and reconnection is 
 14818                                  	; impossible.

 14820                                  	; Remember that he may have given us a FCB with bogus information in
 14821                                  	; it. Check to see if sharing is present or if the redir is present.
 14822                                  	; If either is around, presume that we have cycled out the FCB and 
 14823                                  	; give the hard error. Otherwise, just return with carry set.

 14831                                  			; Return: AL = 00h  not installed, OK to install
 14832                                  			; 01h  not installed, not OK to install
 14833                                  			; FFh  installed
 14834 00001FE1 08C0                    	OR	AL,AL			; is it there?
 14835 00001FE3 740C                    	JZ	short RegenDead		; no, just fail the operation

 15367                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15368                                  ;
 15369                                  ;   SFTFromFCB - the workhorse of this compatability crap. Check to see if
 15370                                  ;	the SFT for the FCB is Good. If so, make ThisSFT point to it. If not
 15371                                  ;	good, get one from the cache and regenerate it. Overlay the LRU field
 15372                                  ;	with PID
 15373                                  ;
 15374                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI point to FCB
 15375                                  ;   Outputs:	ThisSFT point to appropriate SFT

 15377                                  ;		Carry set -> error in ax
 15378                                  ;   Registers modified: ES,DI, AX
 15379                                  ;
 15380                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15381

 15393 0000215C 58                      	pop	ax

 15397 00002162 368C06[A005]            	MOV	[SS:THISSFT+2],ES

 15517                                  ;Break <GetRR - return the random record field in DX:AX>
 15518                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15519                                  ;
 15520                                  ;   GetRR - correctly load DX:AX with the random record field (3 or 4 bytes)
 15521                                  ;	from the FCB pointed to by DS:SI
 15522                                  ;
 15523                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI point to an FCB
 15524                                  ;		BX has record size
 15525                                  ;   Outputs:	DX:AX contain the contents of the random record field
 15526                                  ;   Registers modified: none
 15527                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15528                                  
 15529                                  GetRR:
 15530                                  	;mov	ax,[si+21h]
 15531 000021C6 8B4421                  	MOV	AX,[SI+SYS_FCB.RR]	; get low order part
 15532                                  	;mov	dx,[si+23h]
 15533 000021C9 8B5423                  	MOV	DX,[SI+SYS_FCB.RR+2]	; get high order part
 15534 000021CC 83FB40                  	CMP	BX,64			; ignore MSB of RR if recsiz > 64
 15535 000021CF 7202                    	JB	short GetRRBye
 15536                                  GetExtent_bye:	; 21/01/2024
 15537 000021D1 30F6                    	XOR	DH,DH
 15538                                  GetRRBye:
 15539 000021D3 C3                      	retn

 15541                                  ;Break <GetExtent - retrieve next location for sequential IO>
 15542                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15543                                  ;
 15544                                  ;   GetExtent - Construct the next record to perform I/O from the EXTENT and
 15545                                  ;	NR fields in the FCB.
 15546                                  ;
 15547                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI - point to FCB
 15548                                  ;   Outputs:	DX:AX contain the contents of the random record field
 15549                                  ;   Registers modified: none
 15550                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15551                                  
 15552                                  GetExtent:
 15553                                  	;mov	al,[si+20h]
 15554 000021D4 8A4420                  	MOV	AL,[SI+SYS_FCB.NR]	; get low order piece
 15555                                  	;mov	dx,[si+0Ch]
 15556 000021D7 8B540C                  	MOV	DX,[SI+SYS_FCB.EXTENT]	; get high order piece
 15557 000021DA D0E0                    	SHL	AL,1
 15558 000021DC D1EA                    	SHR	DX,1
 15559 000021DE D0D8                    	RCR	AL,1	; move low order bit of DL to high order of AH
 15560 000021E0 88D4                    	MOV	AH,DL

 15567                                  ;Break <SetExtent - update the extent/NR field>
 15568                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15569                                  ;
 15570                                  ;   SetExtent - change the position of an FCB by filling in the extent/NR
 15571                                  ;	fields
 15572                                  ;
 15573                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI point to FCB
 15574                                  ;		DX:AX is a record location in file
 15575                                  ;   Outputs:	Extent/NR fields are filled in
 15576                                  ;   Registers modified: CX
 15577                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15578                                  
 15579                                  SetExtent:
 15580 000021E6 50                      	push	ax
 15581 000021E7 52                      	push	dx
 15582 000021E8 89C1                    	MOV	CX,AX
 15583 000021EA 247F                    	AND	AL,7FH			; next rec field
 15584                                  	;mov	[si+20h],al
 15585 000021EC 884420                  	MOV	[SI+SYS_FCB.NR],AL
 15586 000021EF 80E180                  	AND	CL,80H			; save upper bit
 15587 000021F2 D1E1                    	SHL	CX,1
 15588 000021F4 D1D2                    	RCL	DX,1			; move high bit of CX to low bit of DX
 15589 000021F6 88E8                    	MOV	AL,CH
 15590 000021F8 88D4                    	MOV	AH,DL
 15591                                  	;mov	[si+0Ch], ax
 15592 000021FA 89440C                  	MOV	[SI+SYS_FCB.EXTENT],AX	; all done
 15593 000021FD 5A                      	pop	dx
 15594 000021FE 58                      	pop	ax
 15595 000021FF C3                      	retn

 16340                                  
 16341                                  ; The SFT at ES:DI is the one that is already in use for this FCB. We set the
 16342                                  ; FCB to use this one. We increment its ref count. We do NOT close it at all.
 16343                                  ; Consider:
 16344                                  ;
 16345                                  ;   open (foo)	delete (foo) open (bar)
 16346                                  ;
 16347                                  ; This causes us to recycle (potentially) bar through the same local SFT as
 16348                                  ; foo even though foo is no longer needed; this is due to the server closing
 16349                                  ; foo for us when we delete it. Unfortunately, we cannot see this closure.
 16350                                  ; If we were to CLOSE bar, the server would then close the only reference to
 16351                                  ; bar and subsequent I/O would be lost to the redirector.
 16352                                  ;
 16353                                  ; This gets solved by NOT closing the sft, but zeroing the ref count
 16354                                  ; (effectively freeing the SFT) and informing the sharer (if relevant) that
 16355                                  ; the SFT is no longer in use. Note that the SHARER MUST keep its ref counts
 16356                                  ; around. This will allow us to access the same file through multiple network
 16357                                  ; connections and NOT prematurely terminate when the ref count on one
 16358                                  ; connection goes to zero.
 16359                                  
 16360                                  OpenFound:
 16361                                  	;mov	[si+18h],al
 16362 000024AB 884418                  	MOV	[SI+fcb_sfn],AL 	; assign with this
 16363 000024AE 26FF05                  	inc	word [es:di]
 16364                                  	;INC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 16365                                  					; remember this new invocation
 16366                                  	; 23/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 16367                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 16368                                  	;;;
 16369 000024B1 E8C923                  	call	set_sftfcb_entry
 16370                                  	;;;
 16371                                  
 16372                                  	; 24/01/2024
 16373 000024B4 16                      	push	ss
 16374 000024B5 1F                      	pop	ds
 16375                                  	
 16376                                  	;MOV	AX,[SS:FCBLRU]		; update LRU counts
 16377 000024B6 A1[1000]                	mov	ax,[FCBLRU] ; 24/01/2024
 16378                                  	;mov	[es:di+15h],ax
 16379 000024B9 26894515                	MOV	[ES:DI+sf_LRU],AX
 16380                                  ;
 16381                                  ; We have an FCB sft that is now of no use. We release sharing info and then
 16382                                  ; blast it to prevent other reuse.
 16383                                  ;
 16384                                  	;push	ss
 16385                                  	;pop	ds
 16386                                  	
 16387 000024BD C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 16388 000024C1 26FF0D                  	dec	word [es:di]

 17142                                  ;BREAK <$ChDir -- Change current directory on a drive>
 17143                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17144                                  ;
 17145                                  ; $ChDir - Top-level change directory system call.  This call is responsible
 17146                                  ; for setting up the CDS for the specified drive appropriately.  There are
 17147                                  ; several cases to consider:
 17148                                  ;
 17149                                  ;   o	Local, simple CDS.  In this case, we take the input path and convert
 17150                                  ;	it into a WFP.	We verify the existance of this directory and then
 17151                                  ;	copy the WFP into the CDS and set up the ID field to point to the
 17152                                  ;	directory cluster.
 17153                                  ;   o	Net CDS.  We form the path from the root (including network prefix)
 17154                                  ;	and verify its existance (via DOS_Chdir).  If successful, we copy the
 17155                                  ;	WFP back into the CDS.
 17156                                  ;   o	SUBST'ed CDS.  This is no different than the local, simple CDS.
 17157                                  ;   o	JOIN'ed CDS.  This is trouble as there are two CDS's at work.  If we
 17158                                  ;	call TransPath, we will get the PHYSICAL CDS that the path refers to
 17159                                  ;	and the PHYSICAL WFP that the input path refers to.  This is perfectly
 17160                                  ;	good for the validation but not for currency.  We call TransPathNoSet
 17161                                  ;	to process the path but to return the logical CDS and the logical
 17162                                  ;	path.  We then copy the logical path into the logical CDS.
 17163                                  ;
 17164                                  ; Inputs:
 17165                                  ;	DS:DX Points to asciz name
 17166                                  ; Returns:
 17167                                  ;	STD XENIX Return
 17168                                  ;	AX = chdir_path_not_found if error
 17169                                  ;
 17170                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17171                                  	
 17172                                  	; 25/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 17173                                  	
 17174                                  _$CHDIR:
 17175                                  	; 25/01/2024
 17176                                  	;;;
 17177 00002742 36C606[0C11]43          	mov	byte [ss:PATHNAMELEN],67 ; Retro DOS v5.0
 17178                                  	;mov	word [ss:PATHNAMELEN],67 ; DIRSTRLEN = 67
 17179                                  	;;;
 17180 00002748 BF[BE03]                	MOV	DI,OPENBUF		; spot for translated name
 17181 0000274B 89D6                    	MOV	SI,DX			; get source
 17182 0000274D E83D51                  	call	TransPath		; go munge the path and get real CDS
 17183 00002750 7304                    	JNC	short ChDirCrack	; no errors, try path
 17184                                  ChDirErrP:
 17185                                  	;mov	al,3
 17186 00002752 B003                    	MOV	AL,error_path_not_found
 17187                                  ChDirErr:

 17208 00002769 729A                    	jc	short chdir_errj
 17209                                  ;
 17210                                  ; Get back CDS to see if a join as seen. Set the currency pointer (only if
 17211                                  ; not network). If one was seen, all we need to do is copy in the text

 17437                                  ; 07/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 17438                                  ; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 17439                                  
 17440                                  ;**	IOCTL system call.
 17441                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17442                                  ;	$IOCTL
 17443                                  ;
 17444                                  ;	  Revision history:
 17445                                  ;
 17446                                  ;		Created: ARR 4 April 1983
 17447                                  ;
 17448                                  ;		GenericIOCTL added:		KGS	22 April 1985
 17449                                  ;
 17450                                  ;		A000	version 4.00	Jan. 1988
 17451                                  ;
 17452                                  ;		Used jump table to dispatch IOCTL functions. HKN 3/12/90
 17453                                  ;
 17454                                  
 17455                                  ;BREAK <IOCTL - munge on a handle to do device specific stuff>
 17456                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17457                                  ;
 17458                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 17459                                  ;	    MOV     BX, Handle
 17460                                  ;	    MOV     DX, Data
 17461                                  ;
 17462                                  ;	(or LDS     DX,BUF
 17463                                  ;	    MOV     CX,COUNT)
 17464                                  ;
 17465                                  ;	    MOV     AH, Ioctl
 17466                                  ;	    MOV     AL, Request
 17467                                  ;	    INT     21h
 17468                                  ;
 17469                                  ;   AH = 0  Return a combination of low byte of sf_flags and device driver
 17470                                  ;	    attribute word in DX, handle in BX:
 17471                                  ;	    DH = high word of device driver attributes
 17472                                  ;	    DL = low byte of sf_flags
 17473                                  ;	 1  Set the bits contained in DX to sf_flags.  DH MUST be 0.  Handle
 17474                                  ;	    in BX.
 17475                                  ;	 2  Read CX bytes from the device control channel for handle in BX
 17476                                  ;	    into DS:DX.  Return number read in AX.
 17477                                  ;	 3  Write CX bytes to the device control channel for handle in BX from
 17478                                  ;	    DS:DX.  Return bytes written in AX.
 17479                                  ;	 4  Read CX bytes from the device control channel for drive in BX
 17480                                  ;	    into DS:DX.  Return number read in AX.
 17481                                  ;	 5  Write CX bytes to the device control channel for drive in BX from
 17482                                  ;	    DS:DX.  Return bytes written in AX.
 17483                                  ;	 6  Return input status of handle in BX. If a read will go to the
 17484                                  ;	    device, AL = 0FFh, otherwise 0.
 17485                                  ;	 7  Return output status of handle in BX. If a write will go to the
 17486                                  ;	    device, AL = 0FFh, otherwise 0.
 17487                                  ;	 8  Given a drive in BX, return 1 if the device contains non-
 17488                                  ;	    removable media, 0 otherwise.
 17489                                  ;	 9  Return the contents of the device attribute word in DX for the
 17490                                  ;	    drive in BX.  0200h is the bit for shared.	1000h is the bit for
 17491                                  ;	    network. 8000h is the bit for local use.
 17492                                  ;	 A  Return 8000h if the handle in BX is for the network or not.
 17493                                  ;	 B  Change the retry delay and the retry count for the system. BX is
 17494                                  ;	    the count and CX is the delay.
 17495                                  ;
 17496                                  ;   Error returns:
 17497                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_handle
 17498                                  ;	       = error_invalid_function
 17499                                  ;	       = error_invalid_data
 17500                                  ;
 17501                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17502                                  ;
 17503                                  ;   This is the documentation copied from DOS 4.0 it is much better
 17504                                  ;   than the above
 17505                                  ;
 17506                                  ;	There are several basic forms of IOCTL calls:
 17507                                  ;
 17508                                  ;
 17509                                  ;	** Get/Set device information:	**
 17510                                  ;
 17511                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17512                                  ;		  0 - Get device information
 17513                                  ;		  1 - Set device information
 17514                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17515                                  ;		(DX) = info for "Set Device Information"
 17516                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17517                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17518                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17519                                  ;		  (DX) = info for "Get Device Information"
 17520                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17521                                  ;
 17522                                  ;
 17523                                  ;	**  Read/Write Control Data From/To Handle  **
 17524                                  ;
 17525                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17526                                  ;		  2 - Read device control info
 17527                                  ;		  3 - Write device control info
 17528                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17529                                  ;		(CX) = transfer count
 17530                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data
 17531                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17532                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17533                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17534                                  ;		  (AX) = count of bytes transfered
 17535                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17536                                  ;
 17537                                  ;
 17538                                  ;	**  Read/Write Control Data From/To Block Device  **
 17539                                  ;
 17540                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17541                                  ;		  4 - Read device control info
 17542                                  ;		  5 - Write device control info
 17543                                  ;		(BL) = Drive number (0=default, 1='A', 2='B', etc)
 17544                                  ;		(CX) = transfer count
 17545                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data
 17546                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17547                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17548                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17549                                  ;		  (AX) = count of bytes transfered
 17550                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17551                                  ;
 17552                                  ;
 17553                                  ;	**  Get Input/Output Status  **
 17554                                  ;
 17555                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17556                                  ;		  6 - Get Input status
 17557                                  ;		  7 - Get Output Status
 17558                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17559                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17560                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17561                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17562                                  ;		  (AL) = 00 if not ready
 17563                                  ;		  (AL) = FF if ready
 17564                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17565                                  ;
 17566                                  ;
 17567                                  ;	**  Get Drive Information  **
 17568                                  ;
 17569                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17570                                  ;		  8 - Check for removable media
 17571                                  ;		  9 - Get device attributes
 17572                                  ;		(BL) = Drive number (0=default, 1='A', 2='B', etc)
 17573                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17574                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17575                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17576                                  ;		  (AX) = 0/1 media is removable/fixed (func. 8)
 17577                                  ;		  (DX) = device attribute word (func. 9)
 17578                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17579                                  ;
 17580                                  ;
 17581                                  ;	**  Get Redirected bit	**
 17582                                  ;
 17583                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17584                                  ;		  0Ah - Network stuff
 17585                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17586                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17587                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17588                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17589                                  ;		  (DX) = SFT flags word, 8000h set if network file
 17590                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17591                                  ;
 17592                                  ;
 17593                                  ;	**  Change sharer retry parameters  **
 17594                                  ;
 17595                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17596                                  ;		  0Bh - Set retry parameters
 17597                                  ;		(CX) = retry loop count
 17598                                  ;		(DX) = number of retries
 17599                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17600                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17601                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17602                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17603                                  ;
 17604                                  ;
 17605                                  ;   =================================================================
 17606                                  ;
 17607                                  ;	**  New Standard Control  **
 17608                                  ;
 17609                                  ;	ALL NEW IOCTL FACILITIES SHOULD USE THIS FORM.	THE OTHER
 17610                                  ;	FORMS ARE OBSOLETE.
 17611                                  ;
 17612                                  ;   =================================================================
 17613                                  ;
 17614                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17615                                  ;		  0Ch - Control Function subcode
 17616                                  ;		(BX) = File Handle
 17617                                  ;		(CH) = Category Indicator
 17618                                  ;		(CL) = Function within category
 17619                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data, if any
 17620                                  ;		(SI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17621                                  ;		(DI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17622                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17623                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17624                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17625                                  ;		  (SI) = Return value, meaning is function dependent
 17626                                  ;		  (DI) = Return value, meaning is function dependent
 17627                                  ;		  (DS:DX) = Return address, use is function dependent
 17628                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17629                                  ;
 17630                                  ;    ============== Generic IOCTL Definitions for DOS 3.2 ============
 17631                                  ;     (See inc\ioctl.inc for more info)
 17632                                  ;
 17633                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17634                                  ;		  0Dh - Control Function subcode
 17635                                  ;		(BL) = Drive Number (0 = Default, 1= 'A')
 17636                                  ;		(CH) = Category Indicator
 17637                                  ;		(CL) = Function within category
 17638                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data, if any
 17639                                  ;		(SI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17640                                  ;		(DI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17641                                  ;
 17642                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17643                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17644                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17645                                  ;		  (DS:DX) = Return address, use is function dependent
 17646                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17647                                  ;
 17648                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17649                                  	
 17650                                  	; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 17651                                  	; DOSCODE:611Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 17652                                  
 17653                                  	; 11/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 17654                                  	; DOSCODE:610Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 18410                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18411                                  ; Proc Name : Check_If_Net:
 18412                                  ;
 18413                                  ;
 18414                                  ; Checks if the device is over the net or not. Returns result in ZERO flag.
 18415                                  ; If no device is found, the return address is popped off the stack, and a
 18416                                  ; jump is made to ioctl_drv_err.
 18417                                  ;
 18418                                  ; On Entry:
 18419                                  ; Registers same as those for Get_Driver_BL
 18420                                  ;
 18421                                  ; On Exit:
 18422                                  ; ZERO flag	- set if not a net device
 18423                                  ;		- reset if net device
 18424                                  ; ES:DI -> the device
 18425                                  ;
 18426                                  ;
 18427                                  ; BUGBUG: This function assumes the following stack setup on entry
 18428                                  ;
 18429                                  ;	  SP+2 -> Error return address
 18430                                  ;	  SP   -> Normal return address
 18431                                  ;
 18432                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18433                                  
 18434                                  	; 30/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 18435                                  	; MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:639Ch
 18436                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:6A91h
 18437                                  	; Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:68E1h
 18438                                  
 18439                                  Check_If_Net:
 18440                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)
 18441 00002AC6 E8D2FF                  	CALL	Get_Driver_BL
 18442 00002AC9 7201                    	JC	short ioctl_drv_err_pop	; invalid drive letter
 18443                                  
 18444                                  ; 30/01/2024 ('Get_Driver_BL' returns with
 18445                                  ;	      'curdir_isnet' condition/ZF, no need to a second test)
 18446                                  %if 0
 18447                                  	;;;
 18448                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM, Windows ME IO.SYS)
 18449                                  	PUSH	ES
 18450                                  	PUSH	DI
 18451                                  	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 18452                                  	;test	word [es:di+43h],8000h
 18453                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_isnet
 18454                                  	;test	byte [es:di+44h],80h
 18455                                  	TEST	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],(curdir_isnet>>8)
 18456                                  	POP	DI
 18457                                  	POP	ES
 18458                                  	;;;
 18459                                  %endif

 18543                                  ;**	DELETE.ASM - Low level routine for deleting files
 18544                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18545                                  ;		DOS_DELETE
 18546                                  ;		REN_DEL_Check
 18547                                  ;		FastOpen_Delete	       ; DOS 3.3
 18548                                  ;		FastOpen_Update	       ; DOS 3.3
 18549                                  
 18550                                  ;   Revision history:
 18551                                  ;
 18552                                  ;   A000  version 4.00	Jan. 1988
 18553                                  ;   A001  Fastopen Rename fix	April 1989
 18554                                  
 18555                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 18556                                  
 18557                                  ;	i_need	NoSetDir,BYTE
 18558                                  ;	i_need	Creating,BYTE
 18559                                  ;	i_need	DELALL,BYTE
 18560                                  ;	i_need	THISDPB,DWORD
 18561                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 18562                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 18563                                  ;	i_need	CURBUF,DWORD
 18564                                  ;	i_need	ATTRIB,BYTE

 18572                                  ;	i_need	JShare,DWORD
 18573                                  ;	i_need	FastOpenTable,BYTE		  ; DOS 3.3
 18574                                  ;	i_need	FastTable,BYTE			  ; DOS 4.00
 18575                                  ;
 18576                                  ;	i_need	Del_ExtCluster,WORD		  ; DOS 4.00
 18577                                  ;
 18578                                  ;	i_need	SAVE_BX,WORD			  ; DOS 4.00
 18579                                  ;	i_need	DMAADD,DWORD
 18580                                  ;	i_need	RENAMEDMA,BYTE
 18581                                  
 18582                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18583                                  ;
 18584                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DELETE
 18585                                  ;
 18586                                  ; Inputs:
 18587                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18588                                  ;		terminated)
 18589                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18590                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18591                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 18592                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 18593                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 18594                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18595                                  ; Function:
 18596                                  ;	Delete the specified file(s)
 18597                                  ; Outputs:
 18598                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 18599                                  ;		OK
 18600                                  ;	CARRY SET
 18601                                  ;	    AX is error code
 18602                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 18603                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 18604                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 18605                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 18606                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 18607                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 18608                                  ;		error_access_denied
 18609                                  ;			Attempt to delete device or directory
 18610                                  ;		***error_sharing_violation***
 18611                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 18612                                  ;			This error is NOT returned. The INT 24H is generated,
 18613                                  ;			  and the file is ignored (not deleted). Delete will
 18614                                  ;			  simply continue on looking for more files.
 18615                                  ;			  Carry will NOT be set in this case.
 18616                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 18617                                  ;
 18618                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18619

 18919                                  ; Procedure Name : REN_DEL_Check
 18920                                  ;
 18921                                  ; Inputs:
 18922                                  ;	[THISDPB] set
 18923                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX points to entry
 18924                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:SI points to firclus field of entry
 18925                                  ;	[WFP_Start] points to name
 18926                                  ; Function:

 18931                                  ;	NOTE: The WFP string pointed to by [WFP_Start] Will be Modified. The
 18932                                  ;		last element will be loaded from the directory entry. This is
 18933                                  ;		so the name given to the sharer doesn't have any meta chars in
 18934                                  ;		it.

 19067                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19068                                  ;
 19069                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_RENAME
 19070                                  ;
 19071                                  ; Inputs:
 19072                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to SOURCE WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 19073                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 19074                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string [SOURCE]
 19075                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 19076                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 19077                                  ;	[REN_WFP] Points to DEST WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 19078                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 19079                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 19080                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 19081                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 19082                                  ; Function:
 19083                                  ;	Rename the specified file(s)
 19084                                  ;	NOTE: This routine uses most of AUXSTACK as a temp buffer.
 19085                                  ; Outputs:
 19086                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 19087                                  ;	    OK
 19088                                  ;	CARRY SET
 19089                                  ;	    AX is error code
 19090                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 19091                                  ;			No match for source, or dest path invalid
 19092                                  ;		error_not_same_device
 19093                                  ;			Source and dest are on different devices
 19094                                  ;		error_access_denied
 19095                                  ;			Directory specified (not simple rename),
 19096                                  ;			Device name given, Destination exists.
 19097                                  ;			NOTE: In third case some renames may have
 19098                                  ;			 been done if metas.
 19099                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 19100                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 19101                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 19102                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 19103                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 19104                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 19105                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 19106                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 19107                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 19108                                  ;
 19109                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19110                                  
 19111                                  	; 14/11/2022 Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 19112                                  	; 31/01/2024 Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 19113                                  
 19114                                  DOS_RENAME:
 19115                                  
 19116                                  ;hkn; DOS_RENAME is called from file.asm and fcbio.asm. DS has been set up
 19117                                  ;hkn; at this point to DOSDATA.
 19118                                  
 19119 00002CF2 E825EB                  	call	TestNet
 19120 00002CF5 7306                    	JNC	short LOCAL_RENAME
 19121                                  
 19122                                  ;IF NOT Installed
 19123                                  ;	transfer NET_RENAME
 19124                                  ;ELSE
 19125                                  	;MOV	AX,(MultNET SHL 8) OR 17
 19126                                  	;INT	2FH
 19127                                  	;return
 19128                                  
 19129 00002CF7 B81111                  	mov     ax, 1111h
 19130 00002CFA CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - RENAME REMOTE FILE
 19131                                  			; SS = DS = DOS CS, 
 19132                                  			; SDA first filename pointer = offset of fully-qualified old name
 19133                                  			; SDA CDS pointer -> current directory
 19134                                  			; Return: CF set on error
 19135 00002CFC C3                      	retn
 19136                                  ;ENDIF

 19679                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19680                                  ; Procedure Name : GET_FILE_INFO
 19681                                  ;
 19682                                  ; Inputs:

 19684                                  ;		terminated)
 19685                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 19686                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 19687                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 19688                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used

 19690                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 19691                                  ; Function:
 19692                                  ;	Get Information about a file
 19693                                  ; Returns:
 19694                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 19695                                  ;	    AX = Attribute of file
 19696                                  ;	    CX = Time stamp of file
 19697                                  ;	    DX = Date stamp of file
 19698                                  ;	    BX:DI = Size of file (32 bit)
 19699                                  ;	CARRY SET
 19700                                  ;	    AX is error code
 19701                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 19702                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 19703                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 19704                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 19705                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 19706                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 19707                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed

 19729                                  			; SS = DOS CS, SDA first filename pointer -> fully-qualified name of file

 19825                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else

 19834                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR

 19836                                  ;	CARRY SET

 19838                                  ;		error_file_not_found

 19842                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir

 19844                                  ;		error_access_denied
 19845                                  ;			Attempt to set an attribute which cannot be set
 19846                                  ;			(attr_directory, attr_volume_ID)

 19986                                  ;** 	Low level DUP routine for use by EXEC when creating a new process.
 19987                                  ;   	Exports the DUP to the server machine and increments the SFT ref count
 19988                                  ;
 19989                                  ;	DOS_DUP
 19990                                  ;
 19991                                  ;	Modification history:
 19992                                  ;
 19993                                  ;	  Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 19994                                  
 19995                                  ;BREAK <DOS_DUP -- DUP SFT across network>
 19996                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19997                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DUP
 19998                                  ;
 19999                                  ; Inputs:
 20000                                  ;	[THISSFT] set to the SFT for the file being DUPed
 20001                                  ;		(a non net SFT is OK, in this case the ref
 20002                                  ;		 count is simply incremented)
 20003                                  ; Function:
 20004                                  ;	Signal to the devices that a logical open is occurring
 20005                                  ; Returns:
 20006                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 20007                                  ;    Carry clear
 20008                                  ;	SFT ref_count is incremented
 20009                                  ; Registers modified: None.
 20010                                  ; NOTE:
 20011                                  ;	This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK at DOSINIT
 20012                                  ;	time with SS NOT DOSGROUP. There will be no Network handles at
 20013                                  ;	that time.
 20014                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20015                                  
 20016                                  DOS_DUP:
 20017                                  	;LES	DI,[CS:THISSFT]  ; MSDOS 3.3
 20018                                  
 20019                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 20020 00002FFB 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 20021 00003000 26C43E[9E05]            	les	di,[es:THISSFT]
 20022                                  
 20023                                  	;Entry	Dos_Dup_Direct
 20024                                  DOS_Dup_Direct:
 20025 00003005 E82BE8                  	call	IsSFTNet
 20026 00003008 7503                    	JNZ	short DO_INC
 20027 0000300A E8941E                  	call	DEV_OPEN_SFT
 20028                                  DO_INC:
 20029                                  	;INC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 20030 0000300D 26FF05                  	inc	word [ES:DI]		; Clears carry (if this ever wraps
 20031                                  					;   we're in big trouble anyway)
 20032 00003010 C3                      	retn

 20073                                  ;***	DOS_CREATE - Create a File
 20074                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20075                                  ;	DOS_Create is called to create the specified file, truncating
 20076                                  ;	the old one if it exists.
 20077                                  ;
 20078                                  ;	ENTRY	AX is Attribute to create
 20079                                  ;		(ds) = DOSDATA
 20080                                  ;		[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 20081                                  ;			terminated)
 20082                                  ;		[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 20083                                  ;			( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 20084                                  ;			 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 20085                                  ;		[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 20086                                  ;			(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 20087                                  ;		[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file created
 20088                                  ;			(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 20089                                  ;		[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 20090                                  ;
 20091                                  ;	EXIT	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 20092                                  ;		CARRY CLEAR
 20093                                  ;		    THISSFT filled in.
 20094                                  ;			sf_mode = unchanged for FCB, sharing_compat + open_for_both
 20095                                  ;		CARRY SET
 20096                                  ;		    AX is error code
 20097                                  ;			error_path_not_found
 20098                                  ;				Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 20099                                  ;			error_bad_curr_dir
 20100                                  ;				Bad path in current directory part of path
 20101                                  ;			error_access_denied
 20102                                  ;				Attempt to re-create read only file , or
 20103                                  ;				create a second volume id or create a dir
 20104                                  ;			error_sharing_violation
 20105                                  ;				The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 20106                                  ;				generates an INT 24
 20107                                  ;	USES	all but DS
 20108                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20109                                  
 20110                                  	; 14/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 20111                                  	; DOSCODE:6920h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 20360                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20361                                  ; Procedure Name : Dos_Create_New
 20362                                  ;
 20363                                  ; Inputs:
 20364                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 20365                                  ;		terminated)
 20366                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 20367                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 20368                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 20369                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 20370                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 20371                                  ;	[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file created
 20372                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 20373                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 20374                                  ;	AX is Attribute to create
 20375                                  ; Function:
 20376                                  ;	Try to create the specified file truncating an old one that exists
 20377                                  ; Outputs:
 20378                                  ;	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 20379                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 20380                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 20381                                  ;		sf_mode = sharing_compat + open_for_both for Non-FCB SFT
 20382                                  ;	CARRY SET
 20383                                  ;	    AX is error code
 20384                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 20385                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 20386                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 20387                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 20388                                  ;		error_access_denied
 20389                                  ;			Create a second volume id or create a dir
 20390                                  ;		error_file_exists
 20391                                  ;			Already a file by this name
 20392                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 20393                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20394                                  
 20395                                  DOS_Create_New:
 20396 000030D5 B401                    	MOV	AH,1		; Truncate is NOT OK
 20397 000030D7 E939FF                  	JMP	Create_inter

 20550                                  ; OPEN.ASM, MSDOS 6.0, 1991
 20551                                  ;============================================================================
 20552                                  ; 08/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 20553                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 20554                                  
 20555                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_OPEN - Internal OPEN call for MS-DOS
 20556                                  ;	NAME	DOS_OPEN
 20557                                  
 20558                                  ;**	OPEN.ASM - File Open
 20559                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20560                                  ;	Low level routines for openning a file from a file spec.
 20561                                  ;	Also misc routines for sharing errors
 20562                                  ;
 20563                                  ;	DOS_Open
 20564                                  ;	Check_Access_AX
 20565                                  ;	SHARE_ERROR
 20566                                  ;	SET_SFT_MODE
 20567                                  ;	Code_Page_Mismatched_Error		   ; DOS 4.00
 20568                                  ;
 20569                                  ;	Revision history:
 20570                                  ;
 20571                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 20572                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00   Jan. 1988
 20573                                  ;
 20574                                  ;	M034 - The value in save_bx must be pushed on to the stack for
 20575                                  ; 	       remote extended opens and not save_cx.
 20576                                  ;
 20577                                  ;	M035 - if open made from exec then we must set the appropriate bits
 20578                                  ;	       on the stack before calling off to the redir.
 20579                                  ;	M042 - Bit 11 of DOS34_FLAG set indicates that the redir knows how 
 20580                                  ;	       to handle open from exec. In this case set the appropriate bit
 20581                                  ;	       else do not.
 20582                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------	
 20583                                  
 20584                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 20585                                  
 20586                                  ;	i_need	NoSetDir,BYTE
 20587                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 20588                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 20589                                  ;	i_need	CURBUF,DWORD
 20590                                  ;	i_need	CurrentPDB,WORD
 20591                                  ;	i_need	CURR_DIR_END,WORD
 20592                                  ;	I_need	RetryCount,WORD
 20593                                  ;	I_need	Open_Access,BYTE
 20594                                  ;	I_need	fSharing,BYTE
 20595                                  ;	i_need	JShare,DWORD
 20596                                  ;	I_need	FastOpenFlg,byte
 20597                                  ;	I_need	EXTOPEN_ON,BYTE 		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20598                                  ;	I_need	ALLOWED,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20599                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20600                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_LOCUS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20601                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_ACTION,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20602                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_CLASS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20603                                  ;	I_need	CPSWFLAG,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20604                                  ;	I_need	EXITHOLD,DWORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20605                                  ;	I_need	THISDPB,DWORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20606                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_CX,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20607                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_BX,WORD			  ;M034
 20608                                  ;
 20609                                  ;	I_need	DOS_FLAG,BYTE
 20610                                  ;	I_need	DOS34_FLAG,WORD			  ;M042
 20611                                  
 20612                                  ;Break	<DOS_Open - internal file access>
 20613                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20614                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_Open
 20615                                  ;
 20616                                  ; Inputs:
 20617                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 20618                                  ;		terminated)
 20619                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 20620                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 20621                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 20622                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 20623                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 20624                                  ;	[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file found
 20625                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 20626                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 20627                                  ;	AX is Access and Sharing mode
 20628                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 20629                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 20630                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 20631                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 20632                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 20633                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 20634                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 20635                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 20636                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 20637                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 20638                                  ;
 20639                                  ;	  For FCB SFTs AL should = sharing_compat + open_for_both
 20640                                  ;		(not checked)
 20641                                  ; Function:
 20642                                  ;	Try to open the specified file
 20643                                  ; Outputs:
 20644                                  ;	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 20645                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 20646                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 20647                                  ;	CARRY SET
 20648                                  ;	    AX is error code
 20649                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 20650                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 20651                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 20652                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 20653                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 20654                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 20655                                  ;		error_invalid_access
 20656                                  ;			Bad sharing mode or bad access mode or bad combination
 20657                                  ;		error_access_denied
 20658                                  ;			Attempt to open read only file for writting, or
 20659                                  ;			open a directory
 20660                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 20661                                  ;			The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 20662                                  ;			generates an INT 24 on compatibility mode SFTs
 20663                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 20664                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20665                                  
 20666                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 20667                                  ; DOSCODE:6A60h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 20668                                  ; 14/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 20669                                  ; DOSCODE:6A4Ch (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 20670                                  
 20671                                  ; 01/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 20672                                  ; DOSCODE:71BBh (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 20673

 20685

 20698                                  _IFS_extopen:									;AN000;
 20699 00003165 A0[0106]                	MOV	AL,[SAVE_BX]		    ; M034 - save_bx has original bx  
 20700                                  					    ; with which call was made. This
 20701                                  					    ; has the open access bits.

 20703

 20705                                  	;mov	ax,112Eh
 20706                                  	;MOV	AX,(MultNET SHL 8) OR 46    ;FT. issue extended open verb	;AN000;
 20707 00003169 B82E11                  	mov	ax,(MultNET*256)+46 
 20708 0000316C CD2F                    	INT	2FH			    ;FT.				;AN000;
 20709 0000316E 5B                      	POP	BX			    ;FT. trash bx			;AN000;
 20710 0000316F C606[F605]00            	MOV	byte [EXTOPEN_ON],0	    ;FT.				;AN000;
 20711                                  
 20712                                  do_ret_label:
 20713 00003174 C3                      	retn				    ;FT.				;AN000;

 20716                                  	;
