 20718                                  	;transfer NET_SEQ_OPEN
 20719                                  ;ELSE
 20720                                  	
 20721                                  do_net_int2f:
 20722 00003175 F606[8600]01            	test	byte [DOS_FLAG],EXECOPEN ; Q: was this open call made from exec
 20723 0000317A 7409                    	jz	short not_exec_open	; N: just do net open
 20724                                  					; Y: check to see if redir is aware
 20725                                  					;    of this 
 20726                                  	
 20727                                  					; M042 - start
 20728                                  	;test	word [DOS34_FLAG],EXEC_AWARE_REDIR ; 800h
 20729 0000317C F606[1206]08            	test	byte [DOS34_FLAG+1],(EXEC_AWARE_REDIR>>8)
 20730                                  					; Q: does this redir know how to 
 20731                                  					;    this
 20732 00003181 7402                    	jz	short not_exec_open	; N: just do net open
 20733                                  					; Y: set bit 3 of access byte and 
 20734                                  					;    set sharing mode to DENY_WRITE
 20735                                  					; M042 - end
 20736                                  	
 20737                                  	; NOTE: This specific mode has not been set for the code assembled
 20738                                  	; under the "NOT Installed" conditional. Currently Installed is 
 20739                                  	; always one.
 20740                                  					; M035 - set the bits on the stack
 20741                                  	;mov	al,23h
 20742 00003183 B023                    	mov	AL,SHARING_DENY_WRITE+EXEC_OPEN
 20743                                  	
 20744                                  not_exec_open:
 20745                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 20746 00003185 50                      	PUSH	AX
 20747                                  
 20748                                  	;MOV	AX,(MultNET SHL 8) OR 22
 20749                                  	;INT	2FH
 20750                                  
 20751 00003186 B81611                  	mov     ax,1116h
 20752 00003189 CD2F                    	int     2Fh	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - OPEN EXISTING REMOTE FILE
 20753                                  			; ES:DI -> uninitialized SFT, SS = DOS CS
 20754                                  			; SDA first filename pointer -> fully-qualified name of file to open
 20755                                  			; STACK: WORD file open mode
 20756                                  			; Return: CF set on error
 20757                                  
 20758 0000318B 5B                      	POP	BX			; clean stack
 20759                                  ;do_ret_label: ; 09/08/2018
 20760 0000318C C3                      	retn
 20761                                  ;ENDIF
 20762

 20823                                  
 20824                                  Open_found:
 20825 000031BD 74F9                    	JZ	short Open_Bad_Access 	; test for directories
 20826 000031BF 08E4                    	OR	AH,AH
 20827 000031C1 783E                    	JS	short open_ok		; Devices don't have attributes
 20828 000031C3 8E06[E405]              	MOV	ES,[CURBUF+2]		; get buffer location
 20829                                  	;mov	al,[es:bx+0Bh]
 20830 000031C7 268A470B                	MOV	AL,[ES:BX+dir_entry.dir_attr]
 20831 000031CB A808                    	TEST	AL,attr_volume_id	; can't open volume ids
 20832 000031CD 75E9                    	JNZ	short Open_Bad_Access
 20833 000031CF A801                    	TEST	AL,attr_read_only	; check write on read only
 20834 000031D1 742E                    	JZ	short open_ok
 20835                                  
 20836                                  ; The file is marked READ-ONLY. We verify that the open mode allows access to
 20837                                  ; the read-only file. Unfortunately, with FCB's and net-FCB's we cannot
 20838                                  ; determine at the OPEN time if such access is allowed. Thus, we defer such
 20839                                  ; processing until the actual write operation:
 20840                                  ;
 20841                                  ; If FCB, then we change the mode to be read_only.
 20842                                  ; If net_FCB, then we change the mode to be read_only.
 20843                                  ; If not open for read then error.
 20844                                  
 20845 000031D3 1E                      	push	ds
 20846 000031D4 56                      	push	si
 20847 000031D5 C536[9E05]              	LDS	SI,[THISSFT]
 20848                                  	;mov	cx,[si+2]
 20849 000031D9 8B4C02                  	MOV	CX,[SI+SF_ENTRY.sf_mode]
 20850                                  	; 17/12/2022
 20851                                  	;test	ch,80h
 20852 000031DC F6C580                  	test	ch,sf_isFCB>>8
 20853                                  	;TEST	CX,sf_isFCB ; 8000h	; is it FCB?
 20854 000031DF 750A                    	JNZ	short ResetAccess	; yes, reset the access
 20855 000031E1 88CA                    	MOV	DL,CL
 20856 000031E3 80E2F0                  	AND	DL,SHARING_MASK	; 0F0h
 20857 000031E6 80FA70                  	CMP	DL,SHARING_NET_FCB ; 70h ; is it net FCB?
 20858 000031E9 7508                    	JNZ	short NormalOpen	; no
 20859                                  ResetAccess:
 20860                                  	; 14/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)	
 20861                                  	;AND	CX,~access_mask	; 0FFF0h ; clear access
 20862                                  	; 16/12/2022
 20863                                  	;and	cl,0F0h ; 18/05/2019
 20864                                  	;;;
 20865                                  	; 01/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 20866                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 20867                                  	;and	cx,0FFFCh
 20868 000031EB 80E1FC                  	and	cl,0FCh ; ~3 ; ~open_mode_mask ; clear access
 20869                                  	;;;
 20870                                  ;	OR	CX,open_for_read ; 0	; stick in open_for_read
 20871 000031EE 894C02                  	MOV	[SI+SF_ENTRY.sf_mode],CX
 20872 000031F1 EB0C                    	JMP	SHORT FillSFT
 20873                                  
 20874                                  ; The SFT is normal. See if the requested access is open_for_read
 20875                                  
 20876                                  NormalOpen:
 20877                                  	;AND	CL,access_mask	; 0Fh	; remove extras
 20878                                  	;;;
 20879                                  	; 01/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 20880                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 20881 000031F3 80E103                  	and     cl,3		; it was 'and cl,0Fh' in MSDOS 6.22
 20882                                  				; (and cl,access_mask)
 20883                                  				; this may be open_mode_mask
 20884                                  	;;;
 20885 000031F6 80F900                  	CMP	CL,open_for_read ; 0	; is it open for read?
 20886 000031F9 7404                    	JZ	short FillSFT	; yes
 20887 000031FB 5E                      	pop	si
 20888 000031FC 1F                      	pop	ds
 20889 000031FD EBB9                    	JMP	short Open_Bad_Access
 20890                                  ;
 20891                                  ; All done, restore registers and fill the SFT.
 20892                                  ;
 20893                                  FillSFT:
 20894 000031FF 5E                      	pop	si
 20895 00003200 1F                      	pop	ds
 20896                                  open_ok:
 20897 00003201 E87B20                  	call	DOOPEN			; Fill in SFT
 20898                                  
 20899                                  ;hkn; FastOpenFlg is in DOSDATA. use SS override
 20900                                  	; 18/05/2019
 20901                                  	;and	byte [ss:FastOpenFlag],80h
 20902                                  	; 03/03/2025 (MiniDOS)
 20903                                  	;AND	BYTE [SS:FastOpenFlg],Fast_yes	;; DOS 3.3
 20904                                  	; 12/08/2018
 20905                                  	;and	byte [FastOpenFlg],Fast_yes	
 20906                                  
 20907                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 20908 00003204 E84300                  	CALL	DO_SHARE_CHECK
 20909 00003207 7303                    	JNC	short SHARE_OK
 20910                                  	;call	LCritDisk
 20911                                  	; 16/12/2022
 20912 00003209 E9B9E6                  	jmp	LCritDisk
 20913                                  
 20914                                  SHARE_OK:
 20915                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 20916 0000320C B80300                  	MOV	AX,3
 20917 0000320F C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]

 21028                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 21029                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer

 21034                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing

 21375                                  					; ***

 21377                                  					; without invalidating cluster counts is
 21378                                  					; 2 GB (512K clusters * 8 sectors per cluster)
 21379                                  					;      (128K clusters * 32 sectors per cluster)

 21399                                  					; di:bx = modified value of total clusters

 21415                                  ; =============== S U B R O U T I N E =======================================
 21416                                  
 21417                                  ; write FSINFO sector onto disk
 21418                                  
 21419                                  ; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 21420                                  ; --------------------------------
 21421                                  ; FAT32 FSInfo Sector Structure
 21422                                  ; --------------------------------
 21423                                  ; ref: Microsoft FAT32 File System Specification (2000)
 21424                                  
 21425                                  struc FSINFO		; Offset ;
 21426 00000000 ????????                .LeadSig:	resb 4	  ; 0		; Value 0x41615252. Lead Signature.
 21427 00000004 <res 1E0h>              .Reserved1:	resb 480  ; 4		; Reserved. Must be 0. Never be used.
 21428 000001E4 ????????                .StrucSig:	resb 4	  ; 484		; Value 0x61417272. Fields Signature.
 21429 000001E8 ????????                .Free_Count:	resb 4	  ; 488		; Last known free cluster count. (*) 
 21430 000001EC ????????                .Nxt_Free:	resb 4	  ; 492		; Start clus for free clus srch. (**)
 21431 000001F0 <res Ch>                .Reserved2:	resb 12	  ; 496		; Reserved. Must be 0. Never be used.
 21432 000001FC ????????                .TrailSig:	resb 4	  ; 508		; Value 0xAA550000. Trail Signature.
 21433                                  .size:
 21434                                  endstruc
 21435                                  
 21436                                  ; (*) If the value is 0xFFFFFFFF, then the free count is unknown
 21437                                  ;     and must be computed.
 21438                                  ; (**) If the value is 0xFFFFFFFF, then free cluster search must be started
 21439                                  ;     from cluster 2.
 21440                                  ; Lead Signature, Fields (Structure) Signature and Trail Signature
 21441                                  ; are used to validate FSInfo sector.
 21442                                  
 21443                                  ; --------------------------------
 21444                                  
 21445                                  	; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 21446                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:7436h
 21447                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:7227h)
 21448                                  
 21449                                  update_fat32_fsinfo:
 21450 0000339F 51                      	push	cx
 21451 000033A0 52                      	push	dx
 21452 000033A1 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx
 21453                                  	;mov	dx,[es:bp+25h]
 21454 000033A3 268B5625                	mov	dx,[es:bp+DPB.FSINFO_SECTOR]
 21455                                  	;cmp	[es:bp+0Fh],cx
 21456 000033A7 26394E0F                	cmp	[es:bp+DPB.FAT_SIZE],cx ; 0
 21457                                  				; (16bit FAT size field = 0 for FAT32 fs)
 21458 000033AB 7505                    	jne	short u_fat32_inf_1
 21459 000033AD 83FAFF                  	cmp	dx,0FFFFh ; -1

 21469                                  					; bit 3 - BPB_ExtFlags update bit

 21493                                  					;  if it's dirty.

 21570                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_SEARCH - Internal SEARCH calls for MS-DOS
 21571                                  ;	NAME	DOS_SEARCH
 21572                                  
 21573                                  ;**	Low level routines for doing local and NET directory searches
 21574                                  ;
 21575                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 21576                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_NEXT
 21577                                  ;	RENAME_NEXT
 21578                                  ;
 21579                                  ;	Revision history:
 21580                                  ;
 21581                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 21582                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 21583                                  ;	    A001	PTM 3564 -- search for fastopen
 21584                                  
 21585                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 21586                                  
 21587                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21588                                  ;
 21589                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 21590                                  ;
 21591                                  ; Inputs:
 21592                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 21593                                  ;		terminated)
 21594                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 21595                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 21596                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 21597                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 21598                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 21599                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 21600                                  ;	[DMAADD] Points to 53 byte buffer
 21601                                  ; Function:
 21602                                  ;	Initiate a search for the given file spec
 21603                                  ; Outputs:
 21604                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 21605                                  ;	    The 53 bytes ot DMAADD are filled in as follows:
 21606                                  ;
 21607                                  ;	LOCAL
 21608                                  ;	    Drive Byte (A=1, B=2, ...) High bit clear
 21609                                  ;		NEVER STORE DRIVE BYTE AFTER  found_it
 21610                                  ;	    11 byte search name with Meta chars in it
 21611                                  ;	    Search Attribute Byte, attribute of search
 21612                                  ;	    WORD LastEnt value
 21613                                  ;	    WORD DirStart
 21614                                  ;	    4 byte pad
 21615                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 21616                                  ;	NET
 21617                                  ;	    21 bytes First byte has high bit set
 21618                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 21619                                  ;
 21620                                  ;	CARRY SET
 21621                                  ;	    AX = error code
 21622                                  ;		error_no_more_files
 21623                                  ;			No match for this file
 21624                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 21625                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 21626                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 21627                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 21628                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 21629                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21630                                  
 21631                                  ; 11/05/2025
 21632                                  ; 03/03/2025 (MiniDOS)
 21633                                  ; 24/01/2024
 21634                                  %if 0

 22094                                  ;**
 22095                                  ;
 22096                                  ; Internal Abort call closes all handles and FCBs associated with a process.
 22097                                  ;  If process has NET resources a close all is sent out over the net.
 22098                                  ;
 22099                                  ;   DOS_ABORT
 22100                                  ;
 22101                                  ;   Modification history:
 22102                                  ;
 22103                                  ;       Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 22104                                  ;
 22105                                  ;	M038	SR	10/16/90	Free SFT with the PSP of the process
 22106                                  ;				being terminated only if it is busy.
 22107                                  ;
 22108                                  
 22109                                  ;Break   <DOS_ABORT -- CLOSE all files for process>
 22110                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22111                                  ;
 22112                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_ABORT
 22113                                  ;
 22114                                  ; Inputs:
 22115                                  ;       [CurrentPDB] set to PID of process aborting
 22116                                  ; Function:
 22117                                  ;       Close all files and free all SFTs for this PID
 22118                                  ; Returns:
 22119                                  ;       None
 22120                                  ; All destroyed except stack
 22121                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22122                                  
 22123                                  	; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 22124                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:7685h
 22125                                  	; (Win ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:74F4h) 
 22126                                  
 22127                                  DOS_ABORT:
 22128 0000359A 368E06[3003]            	MOV     ES,[SS:CurrentPDB]	; SS override
 22129 0000359F 268B0E3200              	MOV     CX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]  ; Number of JFNs
 22130                                  reset_free_jfn:
 22131 000035A4 89CB                    	MOV     BX,CX
 22132 000035A6 51                      	PUSH    CX
 22133 000035A7 4B                      	DEC     BX                      ; get jfn (start with last one)
 22134                                  
 22135 000035A8 E8F13D                  	CALL	_$CLOSE
 22136 000035AB 59                      	POP     CX
 22137 000035AC E2F6                    	LOOP    reset_free_jfn          ; and do 'em all
 22138                                  
 22139                                  ; Note: We do need to explicitly close FCBs. Reasons are as follows: If we
 22140                                  ; are running in the no-sharing no-network environment, we are simulating the
 22141                                  ; 2.0 world and thus if the user doesn't close the file, that is his problem
 22142                                  ; BUT... the cache remains in a state with garbage that may be reused by the
 22143                                  ; next process. We scan the set and blast the ref counts of the FCBs we own.
 22144                                  ;
 22145                                  ; If sharing is loaded, then the following call to close process will
 22146                                  ; correctly close all FCBs. We will then need to walk the list AFTER here.
 22147                                  ;
 22148                                  ; Finally, the following call to NET_Abort will cause an EOP to be sent to all
 22149                                  ; known network resources. These resources are then responsible for cleaning
 22150                                  ; up after this process.
 22151                                  ;
 22152                                  ; Sleazy, eh?
 22153                                  
 22154                                  	;context DS			; SS is DOSDATA
 22155 000035AE 16                      	push	ss
 22156 000035AF 1F                      	pop	ds  ; 09/09/2018
 22157                                  
 22158                                  	;CallInstall Net_Abort, MultNET, 29
 22159 000035B0 B81D11                  	mov	ax,111Dh
 22160 000035B3 CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR 
 22161                                  			;	    - CLOSE ALL REMOTE FILES FOR PROCESS
 22162                                  			; DS???, SS = DOS CS
 22163                                  ;if installed
 22164 000035B5 FF1E[A000]              	call	far [JShare+(4*4)]	; 4 = MFTCloseP
 22165                                  ;else
 22166                                  ;	call 	MFTCloseP
 22167                                  ;endif
 22168                                  
 22169                                  ; Scan the FCB cache for guys that belong to this process and zap their ref
 22170                                  ; counts.
 22171                                  					; SS override
 22172 000035B9 36C43E[4000]            	les     di,[ss:SFTFCB]		; grab the pointer to the table
 22173                                  
 22174                                  	;;;
 22175                                  	; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 22176                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 22177                                  SFTFCB_check:
 22178 000035BE 8CC1                    	mov	cx,es
 22179 000035C0 09F9                    	or	cx,di
 22180 000035C2 E325                    	jcxz	FCBScanDone

 22214                                  	;;;

 22216 000035E0 5F                      	pop	di

 22285                                  ;**	Internal Close and Commit calls to close a local or NET SFT.
 22286                                  ;
 22287                                  ;	DOS_CLOSE

 22291                                  ;

 22293                                  ;
 22294                                  ;	   AN000  version 4.00	Jan. 1988

 22300                                  ;Break <DOS_CLOSE -- CLOSE FILE from SFT>
 22301                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22302                                  ;
 22303                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_CLOSE
 22304                                  ;
 22305                                  ; Inputs:
 22306                                  ;	[THISSFT] set to the SFT for the file being used
 22307                                  ; Function:
 22308                                  ;	Close the indicated file via the SFT
 22309                                  ; Returns:
 22310                                  ;	sf_ref_count decremented otherwise
 22311                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 22312                                  ;	Carry set if error
 22313                                  ;	    AX has error code
 22314                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 22315                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22316                                  
 22317                                  ;hkn; DOS_CLOSE called from fcbio.asm and handle.asm. DS alreday set up.
 22318                                  
 22319                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 22320                                  ; DOSCODE:6E2Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 22321                                  
 22322                                  ; 14/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 22323                                  ; DOSCODE:6E1Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 22324                                  
 22325                                  ; 23/07/2018 - IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3), 1987 - Offset 39D0h
 22326                                  
 22327                                  	; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 22328                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:76FEh
 22329                                  	; (Win ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:7579h) 
 22330                                  
 22331                                  DOS_CLOSE:
 22332 00003612 C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 22333                                  	;mov	bx,[ES:DI+5]
 22334 00003616 268B5D05                	MOV	BX,[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_flags]
 22335                                  
 22336                                  ; Network closes are handled entirely by the net code.
 22337                                  
 22338                                  	;;test	bx,8000h
 22339                                  	;TEST	BX,sf_isnet
 22340                                  	; 17/12/2022
 22341                                  	;test	bh,80h
 22342 0000361A F6C780                  	test	bh,(sf_isnet>>8)
 22343 0000361D 7406                    	JZ	short LocalClose
 22344                                  
 22345                                  	;CallInstall Net_Close,MultNET,6
 22346 0000361F B80611                  	mov     ax,1106h
 22347 00003622 CD2F                    	int     2Fh	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - CLOSE REMOTE FILE
 22348                                  			; ES:DI -> SFT
 22349                                  			; SFT DPB field -> DPB of drive containing file
 22350                                  			; Return: CF set on error, AX = DOS error code
 22351                                  			; CF clear if successful
 22352                                  RET2:		; 03/02/2024
 22353 00003624 C3                      	retn

 23801                                  ;Break	<DOS_READ -- MAIN READ ROUTINE AND DEVICE IN ROUTINES>
 23802                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23803                                  ;
 23804                                  ; Inputs:
 23805                                  ;	ThisSFT set to the SFT for the file being used
 23806                                  ;	[DMAADD] contains transfer address
 23807                                  ;	CX = No. of bytes to read
 23808                                  ;	DS = DOSDATA
 23809                                  ; Function:
 23810                                  ;	Perform read operation
 23811                                  ; Outputs:
 23812                                  ;    Carry clear
 23813                                  ;	SFT Position and cluster pointers updated
 23814                                  ;	CX = No. of bytes read
 23815                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 23816                                  ;    Carry set
 23817                                  ;	AX is error code
 23818                                  ;	CX = 0
 23819                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT

 24739                                  ; Procedure Name : DIRREAD
 24740                                  ;
 24741                                  ; Inputs:
 24742                                  ;	AX = Directory block number (relative to first block of directory)
 24743                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 24744                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = First sector of first cluster of directory
 24745                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster
 24746                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 24747                                  ; Function:
 24748                                  ;	Read the directory block into [CURBUF].
 24749                                  ; Outputs:
 24750                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM] = Next cluster (after the one skipped to)
 24751                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] Set

 24753                                  ;	[CURBUF] Points to Buffer with dir sector

 24756                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24757                                  
 24758                                  ;hkn; called from dir.asm. DS already set up to DOSDATA.

 25179                                  ;Break	<DSKREAD -- PHYSICAL DISK READ>
 25180                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25181                                  ;
 25182                                  ; Procedure Name : DSKREAD
 25183                                  ;
 25184                                  ; Inputs:
 25185                                  ;	DS:BX = Transfer addr
 25186                                  ;	CX = Number of sectors
 25187                                  ;	[HIGH_SECTOR] = Absolute record number (HIGH)
 25188                                  ;	DX = Absolute record number	       (LOW)
 25189                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 25190                                  ; Function:
 25191                                  ;	Call BIOS to perform disk read
 25192                                  ; Outputs:
 25193                                  ;	DI = CX on entry
 25194                                  ;	CX = Number of sectors unsuccessfully transfered
 25195                                  ;	AX = Status word as returned by BIOS (error code in AL if error)
 25196                                  ;	Zero set if OK (from BIOS) (carry clear)
 25197                                  ;	Zero clear if error (carry clear)
 25198                                  ; SI Destroyed, others preserved
 25199                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25200                                  
 25201                                  DSKREAD:

 26133                                  ;Break   <DskRdBufScan -- Disk Read Buffer Scan>
 26134                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26135                                  ;
 26136                                  ; Procedure Name : DskRdBufScan
 26137                                  ;
 26138                                  ; Inputs:
 26139                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors read. (These constitute a block of
 26140                                  ;            sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 26141                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 26142                                  ;       [TEMP_VAR2]:[TEMP_VAR] = Transfer address (destination data address).
 26143                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 26144                                  ;
 26145                                  ; Function:
 26146                                  ;	The Buffer Queue is scanned: the contents of any dirty buffers are
 26147                                  ;	"read" into the transfer memory block, so that the transfer memory
 26148                                  ;	reflects the most recent data.
 26149                                  ;
 26150                                  ; Outputs:
 26151                                  ;       Transfer memory updated as required.
 26152                                  ;
 26153                                  ; Uses:
 26154                                  ;       DS,AX,BX,CX,SI,DI destroyed.
 26155                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 26156                                  ;
 26157                                  ; Notes:
 26158                                  ;       FIRST_BUFF_ADDR is set-up to contain the LAST buffer to check, rather
 26159                                  ;	than the FIRST.
 26160                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26161                                  ;M039: Created
 26162                                  
 26163                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 26164                                  ; DOSCODE:78F0h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 26165                                  
 26166                                  ; 18/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 26167                                  ; DOSCODE:78DCh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 26168                                  
 26169                                  ; 09/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 26170                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8313h
 26171                                  
 26172                                  ;procedure DskRdBufScan,NEAR
 26173                                  ;
 26174                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 26175                                  
 26176                                  DskRdBufScan:
 26177 0000415A 36833E[7100]00          	cmp	word [ss:DirtyBufferCount],0 ; Any dirty buffers?
 26178 00004160 743C                    	je	short bufx		     ; -no, skip all work.
 26179                                  
 26180 00004162 368B1E[0706]            	mov     bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]
 26181 00004167 89DE                    	mov     si,bx
 26182 00004169 01D1                    	add     cx,dx
 26183 0000416B 83D600                  	adc     si,0
 26184                                  
 26185 0000416E E89823                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> 1st buf in queue.
 26186                                  	;mov	ax,[di+2]
 26187 00004171 8B4502                  	mov     ax,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_prev]
 26188 00004174 36A3[1711]              	mov     [ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR],ax
 26189                                  		
 26190                                  	; 18/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 26191                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 26192                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 26193                                  	; 15/12/2022
 26194 00004178 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 26195                                  
 26196                                  ;       BX:DX = Extent start.
 26197                                  ;       SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 26198                                  ;          AL = Drive #.
 26199                                  ;       DS:DI-> 1st buffer in queue.
 26200                                  ;[FIRST_BUFF_ADDR] = Address offset of last buffer in queue.
 26201                                  
 26202                                  bufq:	
 26203                                  	;cmp	al,[di+4]
 26204 0000417C 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 26205 0000417F 7514                    	jne	short bufq1        	;  -no, jump.
 26206                                  
 26207                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 26208                                  ;       ja	short bufq1		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 26209                                  
 26210                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 26211 00004181 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 26212 00004184 7503                    	jne	short bufq01
 26213                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 26214 00004186 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 26215                                  bufq01:
 26216 00004189 770A                    	ja	short bufq1
 26217                                  
 26218                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 26219                                  ;       ja	short bufq2		;Jump if Extent end >= buffer sector.
 26220                                  
 26221                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 26222 0000418B 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]

 27336                                  ;Break   <DskWrtBufPurge -- Disk Write Buffer Purge>
 27337                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27338                                  ;
 27339                                  ; Procedure Name : DskWrtBufPurge
 27340                                  ;
 27341                                  ; Inputs:
 27342                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors to write. (These constitute a block of
 27343                                  ;	     sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 27344                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 27345                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 27346                                  ;
 27347                                  ; Function:
 27348                                  ;       Purge the Buffer Queue and the Secondary Cache of any buffers which
 27349                                  ;	are in Extent; they are being over-written.
 27350                                  ;
 27351                                  ; Outputs:
 27352                                  ;       (Same as Input.)
 27353                                  ; Uses:
 27354                                  ;       All registers except DS,AX,SI,DI preserved.
 27355                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 27356                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27357                                  ;M039: Created
 27358                                  
 27359                                  ;procedure   DskWrtBufPurge,NEAR
 27360                                  ;
 27361                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 27362                                  
 27363                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27364                                  ; DOSCODE:7C0Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27365                                  
 27366                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27367                                  ; DOSCODE:7BD4h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27368                                  
 27369                                  ; 10/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 27370                                  ; DOSCODE:8714h (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 27371                                  
 27372                                  ; NOTE: Secondary (Buffer) Cache is not used in PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 27373                                  
 27374                                  ; (Win ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:BB93h)
 27375                                  ; (MSDOS 6.22 IO.SYS - DOSCODE:7C0Eh)
 27376                                  
 27377                                  DskWrtBufPurge:
 27378                                  	;SaveReg <bx,cx>
 27379 0000452A 53                      	push	bx
 27380 0000452B 51                      	push	cx
 27381                                  
 27382 0000452C 368B1E[0706]            	mov	bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	;BX:DX = Extent start (sector #).
 27383 00004531 89DE                    	mov	si,bx
 27384 00004533 01D1                    	add	cx,dx
 27385 00004535 83D600                  	adc	si,0                    ;SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 27386                                  
 27387                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 27388                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 27389                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 27390                                  	; 15/12/2022
 27391 00004538 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 27392                                  
 27393                                  ; 10/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 27394                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 27395                                  %if 0
 27396                                  
 27397                                  ;	BX:DX = Extent start.
 27398                                  ;	SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 27399                                  ;	AL = Drive #
 27400                                  
 27401                                  	cmp	word [ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT],0 ;Secondary cache in-use?
 27402                                  	je	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 27403                                  
 27404                                  ;	If any of the sectors to be written are in the secondary cache (SC),
 27405                                  ;	invalidate the entire SC. (This is an optimization; we really only
 27406                                  ;	need to invalidate those sectors which intersect, but that's slower.)
 27407                                  
 27408                                  	cmp	al,[ss:CurSC_DRIVE]	;Same drive?
 27409                                  	jne	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 27410                                  
 27411                                  	push    ax
 27412                                  	mov     ax,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR]
 27413                                  	mov     di,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2]	;DI:AX = SC start.
 27414                                  
 27415                                  	;Cmp32	si,cx,di,ax		;Extent end < SC start?
 27416                                  	;jbe	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 27417                                  
 27418                                  	cmp	si,di
 27419                                  	jne	short sc01
 27420                                  	cmp	cx,ax
 27421                                  sc01: 
 27422                                  	jbe	short sc5
 27423                                  
 27424                                  	add	ax,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]
 27425                                  	adc	di,0                    ;DI:AX = SC end + 1.
 27426                                  	
 27427                                  	;Cmp32	bx,dx,di,ax             ;Extent start > SC end?
 27428                                  	;jae	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 27429                                  
 27430                                  	cmp	bx,di
 27431                                  	jne	short sc02
 27432                                  	cmp	dx,ax
 27433                                  sc02:
 27434                                  	jnb	short sc5
 27435                                  
 27436                                  	mov	word [ss:SC_STATUS],0	;Extent intersects SC: invalidate SC.
 27437                                  sc5:	
 27438                                  	pop     ax
 27439                                  
 27440                                  %endif
 27441                                  
 27442                                  ;	Free any buffered sectors which are in Extent; they are being over-
 27443                                  ;	written.
 27444                                  
 27445                                  nosc:	
 27446 0000453C E8CA1F                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> first buffer in queue.
 27447                                  
 27448                                  _bufq:	
 27449                                  	;cmpo	al,[di+4]
 27450 0000453F 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 27451 00004542 7527                    	jne	short bufq5		; -no, jump.
 27452                                  
 27453                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 27454                                  ;       ja	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 27455                                  
 27456                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 27457 00004544 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 27458 00004547 7503                    	jne	short bufq04
 27459                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 27460 00004549 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 27461                                  bufq04:
 27462 0000454C 771D                    	ja	short bufq5
 27463                                  
 27464                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 27465                                  ;       jbe	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent end < buffer sector.
 27466                                  
 27467                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 27468 0000454E 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 27469 00004551 7503                    	jne	short bufq05
 27470                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 27471 00004553 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 27472                                  bufq05:
 27473 00004556 7613                    	jbe	short bufq5
 27474                                  
 27475                                  ;	Buffer's sector is in Extent, so free it; it is being over-written.
 27476                                  
 27477                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 27478 00004558 F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?
 27479 0000455C 7403                    	jz	short bufq4		; -no, jump.
 27480 0000455E E8BF22                  	call	DEC_DIRTY_COUNT		; -yes, decrement dirty count.
 27481                                  bufq4:
 27482                                  	;mov	word [di+4],20FFh
 27483 00004561 C74504FF20              	mov     word [di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID],((buf_visit<<8)|0FFh)
 27484                                  
 27485 00004566 E8B21F                  	call	SCANPLACE
 27486 00004569 EB02                    	jmp     short bufq6
 27487                                  bufq5: 
 27488 0000456B 8B3D                    	mov     di,[di]
 27489                                  	;mov	di,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_next]
 27490                                  bufq6: 
 27491 0000456D 363B3E[1711]            	cmp	di,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR]	;Scanned entire buffer queue?
 27492 00004572 75CB                    	jne	short _bufq		; --no, go do next buffer.
 27493                                  	
 27494                                  	;RestoreReg <cx,bx>
 27495 00004574 59                      	pop	cx
 27496 00004575 5B                      	pop	bx
 27497 00004576 C3                      	retn
 27498                                  
 27499                                  ;EndProc DskWrtBufPurge
 27500                                  
 27501                                  ;Break   <DIV32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT DIVIDE>
 27502                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27503                                  ;
 27504                                  ; Procedure Name : DIV32
 27505                                  ;
 27506                                  ; Inputs:
 27507                                  ;       DX:AX = 32 bit dividend   BX= divisor
 27508                                  ; Function:
 27509                                  ;       Perform 32 bit division:  DX:AX/BX = CX:AX + DX (rem.)
 27510                                  ; Outputs:
 27511                                  ;       CX:AX = quotient , DX= remainder
 27512                                  ; Uses:
 27513                                  ;       All registers except AX,CX,DX preserved.
 27514                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27515                                  ;M039: DIV32 optimized for divisor of 512 (common sector size).
 27516                                  
 27517                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27518                                  ; DOSCODE:7C94h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27519                                  
 27520                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27521                                  ; DOSCODE:7C5Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 27522                                  
 27523                                  DIV32:
 27524 00004577 81FB0002                	cmp	bx,512
 27525 0000457B 7515                    	jne	short div5
 27526                                  
 27527 0000457D 89D1                    	mov	cx,dx
 27528 0000457F 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax           ; CX:AX = Dividend
 27529 00004581 81E2FF01                	and	dx,(512-1)      ; DX = Remainder
 27530 00004585 88E0                    	mov	al,ah
 27531 00004587 88CC                    	mov	ah,cl
 27532 00004589 88E9                    	mov	cl,ch
 27533 0000458B 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch
 27534 0000458D D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 27535 0000458F D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1
 27536 00004591 C3                      	retn
 27537                                  div5:	
 27538 00004592 89C1                    	mov	cx,ax
 27539 00004594 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx
 27540 00004596 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 27541 00004598 F7F3                    	div	bx              ; 0:AX/BX
 27542 0000459A 91                      	xchg	cx,ax
 27543 0000459B F7F3                    	div	bx              ; DX:AX/BX
 27544 0000459D C3                      	retn
 27545                                  
 27546                                  ;Break   <SHR32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT SHIFT RIGHT>
 27547                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27548                                  ;
 27549                                  ; Procedure Name : SHR32
 27550                                  ;
 27551                                  ; Inputs:
 27552                                  ;	DX:AX = 32 bit sector number
 27553                                  ; Function:
 27554                                  ;       Perform 32 bit shift right
 27555                                  ; Outputs:
 27556                                  ;	AX = cluster number
 27557                                  ;	ZF = 1 if no error
 27558                                  ;	   = 0 if error (cluster number > 64k)
 27559                                  ; Uses:
 27560                                  ;       DX,CX
 27561                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27562                                  ; M017	- SHR32 rewritten for better performance
 27563                                  ; M039	- Additional optimization
 27564                                  
 27565                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27566                                  ; DOSCODE:7CBBh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27567                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27568                                  ; DOSCODE:7C81h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 27569                                  
 27570                                  SHR32:
 27571                                  	;mov	cl,[es:bp+5]
 27572 0000459E 268A4E05                	mov	cl,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_SHIFT]
 27573 000045A2 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch	    ;ZF=1
 27574 000045A4 E306                    	jcxz	norota
 27575                                  rotashft2:
 27576 000045A6 D1EA                    	shr	dx,1	    ;ZF reflects state of DX.
 27577 000045A8 D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1	    ;ZF not affected.
 27578 000045AA E2FA                    	loop	rotashft2
 27579                                  norota:
 27580 000045AC C3                      	retn

 27591                                  ;Break	<FINDENTRY -- LOOK FOR AN ENTRY>
 27592                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27593                                  ;
 27594                                  ; Procedure Name : FINDENTRY,SEARCH
 27595                                  ;
 27596                                  ; Inputs:
 27597                                  ;	[THISDPB] set
 27598                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 27599                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Starting directory sector number
 27600                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster of directory
 27601                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 27602                                  ;	[NAME1] = Name to look for
 27603                                  ; Function:
 27604                                  ;	Find file name in disk directory.
 27605                                  ;	"?" matches any character.
 27606                                  ; Outputs:
 27607                                  ;	Carry set if name not found
 27608                                  ;	ELSE
 27609                                  ;	Zero set if attributes match (always except when creating)
 27610                                  ;	AH = Device ID (bit 7 set if not disk)
 27611                                  ;	[THISDPB] = Base of drive parameters
 27612                                  ;	DS = DOSGROUP
 27613                                  ;	ES = DOSGROUP
 27614                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer into directory buffer
 27615                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:SI = Pointer to First Cluster field in directory entry
 27616                                  ;	[CURBUF] has directory record with match
 27617                                  ;	[NAME1] has file name
 27618                                  ;	[LASTENT] is entry number of the entry
 27619                                  ; All other registers destroyed.
 27620                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27621                                  
 27622                                  ;hkn; called from rename.asm and dir2.asm. DS must be already set up at
 27623                                  ;hkn; this point.
 27624                                  
 27625                                  SEARCH:
 27626                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27627                                  	; DOSCODE:7C90h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27628                                  
 27629                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27630                                  	; DOSCODE:7CCAh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27631                                  
 27632                                  	; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 27633                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3) - Offset 45B3h
 27634                                  	; 15/03/2018 - Retro DOS v2.0
 27635                                  
 27636                                  	; 24/01/2024
 27637                                  
 27638                                  	; 13/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 27639                                  	; DOSCODE:8797h (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 27640                                  
 27641                                  	;entry	FindEntry
 27642                                  FINDENTRY:
 27643 000045AD E8D405                  	call	STARTSRCH
 27644 000045B0 A0[6B05]                	MOV	AL,[ATTRIB]
 27645                                  	;and	al,9Eh
 27646 000045B3 24DE                    	AND	AL,~attr_ignore		; Ignore useless bits
 27647                                  	;cmp	al,8
 27648 000045B5 3C08                    	CMP	AL,attr_volume_id	; Looking for vol ID only ?
 27649 000045B7 7503                    	JNZ	short NOTVOLSRCH	; No
 27650 000045B9 E83402                  	CALL	SETROOTSRCH		; Yes force search of root
 27651                                  NOTVOLSRCH:

 27999                                  ;
 28000                                  ; Procedure Name : GETENTRY
 28001                                  ;
 28002                                  ; Inputs:
 28003                                  ;	[LASTENT] has directory entry
 28004                                  ;	ES:BP points to drive parameters
 28005                                  ;	[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[ENTLAST] set for DIR involved
 28006                                  ; Function:
 28007                                  ;	Locates directory entry in preparation for search
 28008                                  ;	GETENT provides entry for passing desired entry in AX
 28009                                  ; Outputs:
 28010                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer to next directory entry in CURBUF
 28011                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:DX = Pointer to first byte after end of CURBUF
 28012                                  ;	[LASTENT] = New directory entry number
 28013                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS] set via DIRREAD
 28014                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 28015                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28016                                  
 28017                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 28018                                  GETENTRY:
 28019                                  	; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 28020 0000470B A1[4803]                	MOV	AX,[LASTENT]
 28021                                  
 28022                                  	;entry	GETENT
 28023                                  GETENT:
 28024 0000470E A3[4803]                	MOV	[LASTENT],AX
 28025                                  ;
 28026                                  ; Convert the entry number in AX into a byte offset from the beginning of the
 28027                                  ; directory.
 28028                                  ;
 28029 00004711 B105                    	mov	cl,5			; shift left by 5 = mult by 32
 28030 00004713 D3C0                    	rol	ax,cl			; keep hight order bits
 28031 00004715 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax
 28032                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 28033                                  	;and	ax,0FFE0h
 28034                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 28035                                  	;and	ax,~(32-1)		; mask off high order bits
 28036                                  	; 16/12/2022
 28037 00004717 24E0                    	and	al,0E0h ; ~31
 28038 00004719 83E21F                  	and	dx,1Fh
 28039                                  	;and	dx,32-1			; mask off low order bits
 28040                                  ;
 28041                                  ; DX:AX contain the byte offset of the required directory entry from the
 28042                                  ; beginning of the directory. Convert this to a sector number. Round the
 28043                                  ; sector size down to a multiple of 32.
 28044                                  ;
 28045                                  	;mov	bx,[es:bp+2]
 28046 0000471C 268B5E02                	MOV	BX,[ES:BP+DPB.SECTOR_SIZE]
 28047 00004720 80E3E0                  	and	bl,0E0h
 28048                                  	;AND	BL,255-31		; Must be multiple of 32
 28049 00004723 F7F3                    	DIV	BX
 28050                                  	; 14/02/2024
 28051                                  	;MOV	BX,DX			; Position within sector
 28052                                  				; NOTE: This BX value is not used in DIRREAD
 28053                                  				; Erdogan Tan - 14/02/2024
 28054                                  	;PUSH	BX

 28056                                  	;
 28057 00004726 E84BF6                  	call	DIRREAD
 28058 00004729 5B                      	POP	BX

 28477                                  ; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0

 28480                                  
 28481                                  ;	TITLE	DIR2 - Directory and path cracking
 28482                                  ;	NAME	Dir2
 28483                                  
 28484                                  ;Break	<GETPATH -- PARSE A WFP>
 28485                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28486                                  ;
 28487                                  ; Procedure Name : GETPATH
 28488                                  ;
 28489                                  ; Inputs:
 28490                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:\" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 28491                                  ;		terminated; d:/ (note forward slash) indicates a real device).
 28492                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 28493                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 28494                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 28495                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 28496                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 28497                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 28498                                  ;	[THISDPB] set to DPB if disk otherwise garbage.
 28499                                  ; Function:
 28500                                  ;	Crack the path
 28501                                  ; Outputs:
 28502                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk if disk file
 28503                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Unk if char device
 28504                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 28505                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 28506                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 28507                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 28508                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 28509                                  ;	   Zero set
 28510                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 28511                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 28512                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 28513                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 28514                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 28515                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 28516                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 28517                                  ;	   Zero reset
 28518                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path or attribute mismatch
 28519                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 28520                                  ;	ELSE
 28521                                  ;	   [CurBuf] = -1 if root directory
 28522                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 28523                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 28524                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points into [CURBUF] to dir_first field for entry
 28525                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 28526                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 28527                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 28528                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 28529                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 28530                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 28531                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 28532                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it.
 28533                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 28534                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 28535                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 28536                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 28537                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 28538                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 28539                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 28540                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 28541                                  ; DS preserved, Others destroyed
 28542                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28543                                  
 28544                                  ;hkn; called from delete.asm, finfo.asm, mknode.asm and rename.asm.
 28545                                  ;hkn; DS already set up at this point.
 28546                                  
 28547                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 28548                                  
 28549                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 28550                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8B99h
 28551                                  
 28552                                  GETPATH:
 28553                                  	;mov	word [CREATING],0E500h
 28554 00004978 C706[7E05]00E5          	MOV	WORD [CREATING],DIRFREE*256+0 ; Not Creating, not DEL *.*
 28555

 28567                                  ; See if the input indicates a device that has already been detected. If so,
 28568                                  ; go build the guy quickly. Otherwise, let findpath find the device.

 28854

 28883                                  ; Inputs:
 28884                                  ;	[ATTRIB] Set to get through directories
 28885                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Set to find last element
 28886                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 28887                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path (no leading '/').
 28888                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 28889                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Phys sec # of first sector of directory
 28890                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Cluster # of next cluster
 28891                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors per cluster
 28892                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 28893                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 28894                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 28895                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 28896                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 28897                                  ;	[CREATING] and [DELALL] set
 28898                                  ; Function:
 28899                                  ;	Parse path name
 28900                                  ; Outputs:
 28901                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 28902                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 28903                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 28904                                  ;	[THISDPB] = ES:BP
 28905                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 28906                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 28907                                  ;	   Zero set
 28908                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 28909                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 28910                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 28911                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 28912                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 28913                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 28914                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 28915                                  ;	   Zero reset
 28916                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path
 28917                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 28918                                  ;	ELSE
 28919                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 28920                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 28921                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to fcb_FIRCLUS field for entry
 28922                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 28923                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 28924                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 28925                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 28926                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 28927                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 28928                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 28929                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it,
 28930                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 28931                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 28932                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 28933                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 28934                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 28935                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 28936                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 28937                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 28938                                  ; Destroys all other registers
 28939                                  
 28940                                  	; 11/05/2025 (MiniDOS v1.0)
 28941                                  
 28942                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 28944

 29764                                  ;Break	<CheckThisDevice - Check for being a device>
 29765                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29766                                  ;
 29767                                  ;   CheckThisDevice - Examine the area at DS:SI to see if there is a valid
 29768                                  ;   device specified. We will return carry if there is a device present. 
 29769                                  ;   The forms of devices we will recognize are:
 29770                                  ;
 29771                                  ;	[path]device
 29772                                  ;
 29773                                  ;   Note that the drive letter has *already* been removed. All other forms
 29774                                  ;   are not considered to be devices. If such a device is found we change
 29775                                  ;   the source pointer to point to the device component.
 29776                                  ;
 29777                                  ;   Inputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 29778                                  ;		DS:SI contains name
 29779                                  ;   Outputs:	ES is DOSDATA

 29782                                  ;		Carry flag reset otherwise

 29784                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29785

 29796 00004D09 46                      	INC	SI			; simulate LODSB
 29797                                  
 29798                                  ; We have the leading path separator. Look for DEV part.
 29799                                  
 29800 00004D0A AD                      	LODSW
 29801 00004D0B 0D2020                  	OR	AX,2020h
 29802 00004D0E 3D6465                  	cmp	ax,"de"

 29805 00004D13 AC                      	LODSB

 29807 00004D16 3C76                    	CMP	AL,"v"                  ; Not "v", assume not device
 29808 00004D18 7526                    	JNZ	short NotDevice
 29809 00004D1A AC                      	LODSB
 29810 00004D1B E81C0D                  	call	PATHCHRCMP		; do we have the last path separator?
 29811 00004D1E 7520                    	JNZ	short NotDevice		; no. go for it.
