 31260                                  ;Break   <MAKENODE -- CREATE A NEW NODE>
 31261                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31262                                  ;
 31263                                  ; Procedure Name : MakeNode
 31264                                  ;
 31265                                  ; Inputs:
 31266                                  ;       AL - attribute to create
 31267                                  ;       AH = 0 if it is ok to truncate a file already by this name
 31268                                  ;	AH != 0 if truncation not allowed (prexisting file is an error)
 31269                                  ;               (AH ignored on dirs and devices)
 31270                                  ;
 31271                                  ;        NOTE: When making a DIR or volume ID, AH need not be set since
 31272                                  ;               a name already existant is ALWAYS an error in these cases.
 31273                                  ;
 31274                                  ;       [WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 31275                                  ;               terminated)
 31276                                  ;       [CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 31277                                  ;               ( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 31278                                  ;                Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 31279                                  ;       [THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 31280                                  ;       [THISSFT] Points to an empty SFT. EXCEPT sf_mode filled in.
 31281                                  ; Function:
 31282                                  ;       Make a new node
 31283                                  ; Outputs:
 31284                                  ;       Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk or errLOC_Unk via GetPathNoset
 31285                                  ;       CARRY SET IF ERROR
 31286                                  ;          AX = 1 A node by this name exists and is a directory
 31287                                  ;          AX = 2 A new node could not be created
 31288                                  ;          AX = 3 A node by this name exists and is a disk file
 31289                                  ;               (AH was NZ on input)
 31290                                  ;          AX = 4 Bad Path
 31291                                  ;               SI return from GetPath maintained
 31292                                  ;          AX = 5 Attribute mismatch
 31293                                  ;          AX = 6 Sharing Violation
 31294                                  ;               (INT 24 generated ALWAYS since create is always compat mode
 31295                                  ;          AX = 7 file not found for Extended Open (not exists and fails)
 31296                                  ;       ELSE
 31297                                  ;          AX = 0 Disk Node
 31298                                  ;          AX = 3 Device Node (error in some cases)
 31299                                  ;          [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSFAC],[CLUSNUM] set to directory
 31300                                  ;               containing new node.
 31301                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:BX Points to entry
 31302                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to entry.dir_first
 31303                                  ;          [THISSFT] is filled in
 31304                                  ;               sf_mode = unchanged.
 31305                                  ;          Attribute byte in entry is input AL
 31306                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 31307                                  ;
 31308                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31309                                  
 31310                                  ; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31311                                  ; DOSCODE:8925h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 31312                                  
 31313                                  ; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31314                                  ; DOSCODE:88EAh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 31315                                  
 31316                                  ; 23/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 31317                                  ; DOSCODE:951Ah (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 31318

 31559                                  ; Inputs:

 32155                                  ;
 32156                                  ; Procedure Name : CHECK_VIRT_OPEN
 32157                                  ;
 32158                                  ; CHECK_VIRT_OPEN checks to see if we had performed a "virtual open" (by
 32159                                  ; examining the flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN] to see if it is 1). If we did, then
 32160                                  ; it calls Dev_Close_SFT to decrement the ref. count. It also resets the
 32161                                  ; flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN].
 32162                                  ; No registers affected (including flags).
 32163                                  ; On input, [THISSFT] points to current SFT.
 32164                                  ;
 32165                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32166                                  
 32167                                  CHECK_VIRT_OPEN:
 32168                                  	PUSH	AX
 32169                                  	lahf			; preserve flags
 32170                                  	CMP	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0
 32171                                  	JZ	short ALL_CLOSED
 32172                                  	mov	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0 ; reset flag
 32173                                  	push	es
 32174                                  	push	di
 32175                                  	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 32176                                  	call	DEV_CLOSE_SFT
 32177                                  	pop	di
 32178                                  	pop	es
 32179                                  
 32180                                  ALL_CLOSED:
 32181                                  	sahf			; restore flags
 32182                                  	POP	AX
 32183                                  	retn
 32184                                  
 32185                                  %endif

 32439                                  ;Break  <BUFSEC -- BUFFER A SECTOR AND SET UP A TRANSFER>
 32440                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32441                                  ;
 32442                                  ; Procedure Name : BUFSEC
 32443                                  ;
 32444                                  ; Inputs:
 32445                                  ;       AH = priority of buffer
 32446                                  ;       AL = 0 if buffer must be read, 1 if no pre-read needed
 32447                                  ;       ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 32448                                  ;       [CLUSNUM] = Physical cluster number
 32449                                  ;       [SECCLUSPOS] = Sector position of transfer within cluster
 32450                                  ;       [BYTCNT1] = Size of transfer
 32451                                  ; Function:
 32452                                  ;       Insure specified sector is in buffer, flushing buffer before
 32453                                  ;       read if necessary.
 32454                                  ; Outputs:
 32455                                  ;       ES:DI = Pointer to buffer
 32456                                  ;       SI = Pointer to transfer address
 32457                                  ;       CX = Number of bytes

 32460                                  ;       Carry set if error (user FAILed to I 24)
 32461                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32462                                  
 32463                                  	; 25/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 32464                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:98C2h
 32465                                  
 32466                                  	; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8BF1h) - Retro DOS v4.0 (& v4.1)
 32467                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8C2Ch) - Retro DOS v4.2
 32468                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0BE33h)
 32469                                  
 32470                                  BUFSEC:
 32471                                  	; 25/02/2024
 32472                                  	;;;
 32473                                  	;push	word [CLUSTNUM_HW]

 33059                                  ; 30/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0

 33061                                  
 33062                                  ;Break   <ALLOCATE -- Assign disk space>
 33063                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33064                                  ;
 33065                                  ; Procedure Name : ALLOCATE - Allocate Disk Space
 33066                                  ;
 33067                                  ;   ALLOCATE is called to allocate disk clusters. The new clusters are
 33068                                  ;   FAT-chained onto the end of the existing file.
 33069                                  ;
 33070                                  ;   The DPB contains the cluster # of the last free cluster allocated
 33071                                  ;   (dpb_next_free). We start at this cluster and scan towards higher
 33072                                  ;   numbered clusters, looking for the necessary free blocks.
 33073                                  ;
 33074                                  ;   Once again, fancy terminology gets in the way of correct coding. When
 33075                                  ;   using next_free, start scanning AT THAT POINT and not the one following it.
 33076                                  ;   This fixes the boundary condition bug when only free = next_free = 2.
 33077                                  ;
 33078                                  ;       If we get to the end of the disk without satisfaction:
 33079                                  ;
 33080                                  ;           if (dpb_next_free == 2) then we've scanned the whole disk.
 33081                                  ;               return (insufficient_disk_space)
 33082                                  ;           ELSE
 33083                                  ;               dpb_next_free = 2; start scan over from the beginning.
 33084                                  ;
 33085                                  ;   Note that there is no multitasking interlock. There is no race when
 33086                                  ;   examining the entrys in an in-core FAT block since there will be no
 33087                                  ;   context switch. When UNPACK context switches while waiting for a FAT read
 33088                                  ;   we are done with any in-core FAT blocks, so again there is no race. The
 33089                                  ;   only special concern is that V2 and V3 MSDOS left the last allocated
 33090                                  ;   cluster as "00"; marking it EOF only when the entire alloc request was
 33091                                  ;   satisfied. We can't allow another activation to think this cluster is
 33092                                  ;   free, so we give it a special temporary mark to show that it is, indeed,
 33093                                  ;   allocated.
 33094                                  ;
 33095                                  ;   Note that when we run out of space this algorithem will scan from
 33096                                  ;   dpb_next_free to the end, then scan from cluster 2 through the end,
 33097                                  ;   redundantly scanning the later part of the disk. This only happens when
 33098                                  ;   we run out of space, so sue me.
 33099                                  ;
 33100                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 33101                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 33102                                  ;                                                                          ;
 33103                                  ;   The use of FATBYT and RESTFATBYT is somewhat mysterious. Here is the
 33104                                  ;   explanation:
 33105                                  ;
 33106                                  ;   In the NUL file case (sf_firclus currently 0) ALLOCATE is called with
 33107                                  ;   entry BX = 0. What needs to be done in this case is to stuff the cluster
 33108                                  ;   number of the first cluster allocated in sf_firclus when the ALLOCATE is
 33109                                  ;   complete. THIS VALUE IS SAVED TEMPORARILY IN CLUSTER 0, HENCE THE CURRENT
 33110                                  ;   VALUE IN CLUSTER 0 MUST BE SAVED AND RESTORED. This is a side effect of
 33111                                  ;   the fact that PACK and UNPACK don't treat requests for clusters 0 and 1 as
 33112                                  ;   errors. This "stuff" is done by the call to PACK which is right before
 33113                                  ;   the
 33114                                  ;           LOOP   findfre         ; alloc more if needed
 33115                                  ;   instruction when the first cluster is allocated to the nul file. The
 33116                                  ;   value is recalled from cluster 0 and stored at sf_firclus at ads4:
 33117                                  ;
 33118                                  ;   This method is obviously useless (because it is non-reentrant) for
 33119                                  ;   multitasking, and will have to be changed. Storing the required value on
 33120                                  ;   the stack is recommended. Setting sf_firclus at the PACK of cluster 0
 33121                                  ;   (instead of actually doing the PACK) is BAD because it doesn't handle
 33122                                  ;   problems with INT 24 well.
 33123                                  ;
 33124                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 33125                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 33126                                  ;                                                                          ;
 33127                                  ;       ENTRY   BX = Last cluster of file (0 if null file)
 33128                                  ;               CX = No. of clusters to allocate
 33129                                  ;               ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 33130                                  ;               [THISSFT] = Points to SFT
 33131                                  ;
 33132                                  ;       EXIT   'C' set if insufficient space
 33133                                  ;                [FAILERR] can be tested to see the reason for failure
 33134                                  ;                CX = max. no. of clusters that could be added to file
 33135                                  ;              'C' clear if space allocated
 33136                                  ;                BX = First cluster allocated
 33137                                  ;                FAT is fully updated
 33138                                  ;                sf_FIRCLUS field of SFT set if file was null
 33139                                  ;
 33140                                  ;       USES    ALL but SI, BP
 33141                                  
 33142                                  ;callmagic  proc near
 33143                                  ;       push    ds                             ;push segment of routine 
 33144                                  ;       push    Offset MagicPatch              ;push offset for routine
 33145                                  ;       retf                                   ;simulate jmp far
 33146                                  ;                                              ;far return address is on
 33147                                  ;                                              ;stack, so far return from
 33148                                  ;                                              ;call will return this routine
 33149                                  ;callmagic  endp

 33775                                  ;Break	<RELEASE -- DEASSIGN DISK SPACE>

 33777                                  ;
 33778                                  ; Procedure Name : RELEASE
 33779                                  ;
 33780                                  ; Inputs:
 33781                                  ;       BX = Cluster in file
 33782                                  ;       ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 33783                                  ; Function:
 33784                                  ;       Frees cluster chain starting with [BX]
 33785                                  ;       Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 33786                                  ; AX,BX,DX,DI all destroyed. Other registers unchanged.
 33787                                  ;
 33788                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33789                                  
 33790                                  	; 28/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 33791                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:9D13h
 33792                                  
 33793                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8E86h)
 33794                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0C27Fh)
 33795                                  
 33796                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 33797                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 33853                                          JZ	short NO_DEALLOC	; No
 33854                                          INC	word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT] ; Increase free count by 1
 33855                                  NO_DEALLOC:
 33856                                          MOV     BX,AX
 33857                                          dec     ax              	; check for "1"
 33858                                  	jz	short RELEASE_flush	; is last cluster of incomplete chain
 33859                                  %else

 33911                                  	push	cx		;  them to be preserved.

 34288                                  ;	PUBLIC	CharType
 34289                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34290                                  
 34291                                  ; Character type table for file name scanning
 34292                                  ; Table provides a mapping of characters to validity bits.
 34293                                  ; Four bits are provided for each character. Values 7Dh and above
 34294                                  ; have all bits set, so that part of the table is chopped off, and
 34295                                  ; the translation routine is responsible for screening these values.
 34296                                  ; The bit values are defined in DOSSYM.INC
 34297                                  
 34298                                  ;	      ; ^A and NUL
 34299                                  ;CharType:
 34300                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34301                                  ;	      ; ^C and ^B
 34302                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34303                                  ;	      ; ^E and ^D
 34304                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34305                                  ;	      ; ^G and ^F
 34306                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34307                                  ;	      ; TAB and BS
 34308                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34309                                  ;	      ; ^K and ^J
 34310                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34311                                  ;	      ; ^M and ^L
 34312                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34313                                  ;	      ; ^O and ^N
 34314                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34315                                  ;	      ; ^Q and ^P
 34316                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34317                                  ;	      ; ^S and ^R
 34318                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34319                                  ;	      ; ^U and ^T
 34320                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34321                                  ;	      ; ^W and ^V
 34322                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34323                                  ;	      ; ^Y and ^X
 34324                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34325                                  ;	      ; ESC and ^Z
 34326                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34327                                  ;	      ; ^] and ^;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34329                                  ;	      ; ^_ and ^^
 34330                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34331                                  ;	      ; ! and SPACE
 34332                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK)
 34333                                  ;	      ; # and "
 34334                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK)
 34335                                  ;	      ; $ - )
 34336                                  ;	 db   3 dup (0FFh)
 34337                                  ;	      ; + and *
 34338                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR 0Fh
 34339                                  ;	      ; - and '
 34340                                  ;	 db   NOT (FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM)
 34341                                  ;	      ; / and .
 34342                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34343                                  ;	      ; 0 - 9
 34344                                  ;	 db   5 dup (0FFh)
 34345                                  ;	      ; ; and :
 34346                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) AND 0Fh
 34347                                  ;	      ; = and <
 34348                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) AND 0Fh
 34349                                  ;	      ; ? and >
 34350                                  ;	 db   NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM
 34351                                  ;	      ; A - Z
 34352                                  ;	 db   13 dup (0FFh)
 34353                                  ;	      ; \ and [
 34354                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR 0Fh
 34355                                  ;	      ; ^ and ]
 34356                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34357                                  ;	      ; _ - {

 34360                                  ;	 db   NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM

 34432                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34433                                  ;
 34434                                  ; Procedure Names : GetLet, UCase, GetLet3
 34435                                  ;
 34436                                  ; These routines take a character, convert it to upper case, and check
 34437                                  ; for delimiters.  Three different entry points:
 34438                                  ;	GetLet -  DS:[SI] = character to convert
 34439                                  ;	UCase  -  AL = character to convert
 34440                                  ;	GetLet3 - AL = character
 34441                                  ;		  [BX] = translation table to use
 34442                                  ;
 34443                                  ;	Exit (in all cases) : AL = upper case character
 34444                                  ;			      CY set if char is control char other than TAB
 34445                                  ;			      ZF set if char is a delimiter
 34446                                  ;	Uses : AX, flags
 34447                                  ;
 34448                                  ; NOTE: This routine exists in a fast table lookup version, and a slow
 34449                                  ; inline version.  Return with carry set is only possible in the inline
 34450                                  ; version. The table lookup version is the one in use.
 34451                                  ;
 34452                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34453                                  
 34454                                  ; This entry point has character at [SI]
 34455                                  
 34456                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 5517h
 34457                                  GETLET:	
 34458 000059E6 AC                      	LODSB
 34459                                  
 34460                                  ; This entry point has character in AL
 34461                                  
 34462                                  	;entry	UCase

 34464                                  	; 09/08/2018
 34465                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 5518h
 34466                                  _UCase:
 34467 000059E7 53                      	PUSH	BX
 34468 000059E8 BB[7E0B]                	MOV	BX,FILE_UCASE_TAB+2
 34469                                  
 34470                                  ; Convert the character in AL to upper case
 34471                                  
 34472                                  gl_0:
 34473 000059EB 3C61                    	CMP	AL,"a"
 34474 000059ED 7214                    	JB	short gl_2	; Already upper case, go check type
 34475 000059EF 3C7A                    	CMP	AL,"z"
 34476 000059F1 7702                    	JA	short gl_1
 34477 000059F3 2C20                    	SUB	AL,20H		; Convert to upper case
 34478                                  
 34479                                  ; Map European character to upper case
 34480                                  
 34481                                  gl_1:
 34482 000059F5 3C80                    	CMP	AL,80H
 34483 000059F7 720A                    	JB	short gl_2	; Not EuroChar, go check type
 34484 000059F9 2C80                    	SUB	AL,80H		; translate to upper case with this index
 34485                                  
 34486                                  	; M048 - Start 
 34487                                  	; Lantastic call Ucase thru int 2f without setting SS to DOSDATA.
 34488                                  	; So we shall set up DS and to access FILE_UCASE_TAB in BX and also 
 34489                                  	; preserve it.
 34490                                  
 34491                                  	; 09/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 34492                                  	; MSDOS 3.3
 34493                                  	;;XLAT	BYTE [CS:BX]	; ds as file_ucase_tab is in DOSDATA
 34494                                  	;CS	XLAT

 34501 000059FC 2E8E1E[0700]            	mov	ds,[cs:DosDSeg]
 34502 00005A01 D7                      	XLAT			; ds as file_ucase_tab is in DOSDATA
 34503 00005A02 1F                      	pop	ds
 34504                                  
 34505                                  	; M048 - End
 34506                                  
 34507                                  ; Now check the type
 34508                                  
 34509                                  ;If TableLook
 34510                                  gl_2:
 34511                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 34512 00005A03 50                      	PUSH	AX
 34513

 34515                                  	;mov	bx,CharType

 34518                                  	;cs	xlat	
 34519                                  	
 34520                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 34521 00005A04 E81800                  	CALL	GetCharType	; returns type flags in AL
 34522                                  	
 34523                                  	;test	al,1	
 34524 00005A07 A801                    	TEST	AL,FCHK 	; test for normal character
 34525 00005A09 58                      	POP	AX
 34526                                  
 34527 00005A0A 5B                      	POP	BX
 34528 00005A0B C3                      	RETN
 34529                                  
 34530                                  ; This entry has character in AL and lookup table in BX
 34531                                  
 34532                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 34533                                  ;	;entry GetLet3

 34542                                  ;	retz

 34641                                  
 34642                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34643                                  ;
 34644                                  ;  GetCharType - return flag bits indicating character type
 34645                                  ;	Bits are defined in DOSSYM.INC. Uses lookup table
 34646                                  ;	defined above at label CharType.
 34647                                  ;
 34648                                  ;	Entry : AL = character to return type flags for
 34649                                  ;	Exit  : AL = type flags
 34650                                  ;	Uses  : AL, flags
 34651                                  ;
 34652                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34653                                  
 34654                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 34655                                  
 34656                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 34657                                  
 34658                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 34659                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 34660                                  
 34661                                  GetCharType:
 34662                                  	;cmp	al,7Eh
 34663 00005A1F 3C7E                    	cmp	al,CharType_last 	; beyond end of table?
 34664 00005A21 7314                    	jae	short gct_90		; return standard value
 34665                                  
 34666 00005A23 53                      	push	bx
 34667 00005A24 BB[A759]                	mov	bx,CharType		; load lookup table
 34668 00005A27 D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; adjust for half-byte table entry size
 34669                                  	;xlat	cs:[bx] 		; get flags
 34670 00005A29 2ED7                    	cs	xlat	
 34671 00005A2B 5B                      	pop	bx
 34672                                  
 34673                                  ; carry clear from previous shift means we want the low nibble.  Otherwise
 34674                                  ; we have to shift the flags down to the low nibble
 34675                                  
 34676 00005A2C 7306                    	jnc	short gct_80		; carry clear, no shift needed
 34677                                  
 34678                                  ; 29/02/2024
 34679                                  %if 0
 34680                                  	shr	al,1			; we want high nibble, shift it down
 34681                                  	shr	al,1
 34682                                  	shr	al,1
 34683                                  	shr	al,1
 34684                                  %else
 34685                                  	; 29/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 34686                                  	;;;
 34687 00005A2E 51                      	push	cx
 34688 00005A2F B104                    	mov	cl,4			; we want high nibble, shift it down
 34689 00005A31 D2E8                    	shr	al,cl
 34690 00005A33 59                      	pop	cx
 34691                                  	;;;
 34692                                  %endif
 34693                                  
 34694                                  gct_80:
 34695 00005A34 240F                    	and	al,0Fh			; clear the unused nibble
 34696 00005A36 C3                      	retn
 34697                                  gct_90:
 34698 00005A37 B00F                    	mov	al,0Fh			; set all flags
 34699 00005A39 C3                      	retn

 34749                                  ;
 34750                                  ;	    AN000	version 4.0   Jan 1988
 34751                                  ;	    A002	PTM    -- dir >lpt3 hangs
 34752                                  ;	    A003	PTM 3957- fake version for IBMCAHE.COM
 34753                                  ;
 34754                                  ; 	M011: NEC's 8086 clone chip uses Intel's undocumented bit number in
 34755                                  ;	      flags register. In order to return to user normally DOS used to
 34756                                  ;	      move F202 into flags, which sets bit number 1 in flags uncondit-
 34757                                  ;	      ionally. Now it is modified to maintain the state of bit 1.

 35068                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35069                                  ;
 35070                                  ; Procedure Name : CNTHAND ( CTRLC_C HANDLER )
 35071                                  ;
 35072                                  ; "^C" and CR/LF is printed. Then the user registers are restored and the
 35073                                  ; user CTRL-C handler is executed. At this point the top of the stack has 1)
 35074                                  ; the interrupt return address should the user CTRL-C handler wish to allow
 35075                                  ; processing to continue; 2) the original interrupt return address to the code
 35076                                  ; that performed the function call in the first place. If the user CTRL-C
 35077                                  ; handler wishes to continue, it must leave all registers unchanged and RET
 35078                                  ; (not IRET) with carry CLEAR. If carry is SET then an terminate system call
 35079                                  ; is simulated.
 35080                                  ;
 35081                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35082                                  
 35083                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 35084                                  
 35085                                  CNTCHAND:
 35086                                  	; MSDOS 6.0			; SS override
 35087                                  					; AN002; from RAWOUT
 35088                                  	;TEST	word [SS:DOS34_FLAG],CTRL_BREAK_FLAG  
 35089                                  	;JNZ	short around_deadlock 	; AN002;
 35090                                  
 35091                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 35092                                  	; (MSDOS 6.21 MSDOS.SYS DOSCODE:91C4h, 29/12/2022)
 35093 00005B8F 36F606[1206]02          	TEST	byte [SS:DOS34_FLAG+1],(CTRL_BREAK_FLAG>>8)  ; 2 
 35094 00005B95 7508                    	JNZ	short around_deadlock 	; AN002;
 35095                                  
 35096 00005B97 B003                            MOV     AL,3			; Display "^C"
 35097 00005B99 E8DFC0                          CALL	BUFOUT
 35098 00005B9C E874BF                          CALL	CRLF
 35099                                  around_deadlock:
 35100 00005B9F 16                              PUSH    SS
 35101 00005BA0 1F                              POP     DS
 35102 00005BA1 803E[5703]00                    CMP     BYTE [CONSWAP],0
 35103 00005BA6 7403                            JZ      SHORT NOSWAP
 35104 00005BA8 E837DE                          CALL	SWAPBACK
 35105                                  NOSWAP:

 35108 00005BB0 8B26[8405]              	MOV	SP,[USER_SP]
 35109 00005BB4 E89EA8                          CALL	restore_world       ; User registers now restored
 35110

 35116                                          ;MOV	[CS:ConC_Spsave],SP

 35119                                  	;;int	23h	; DOS - CONTROL "C" EXIT ADDRESS

 35121                                  			; DOS will abort program with errorlevel 0
 35122                                  			; else
 35123                                  			; interrupted DOS call continues

 35129

 35161                                  ; The user has returned to us. The circumstances we allow are:
 35162                                  ;
 35163                                  ;   IRET	We retry the operation by redispatching the system call
 35164                                  ;   CLC/RETF	POP the stack and retry

 35784                                  ;** --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35785                                  ;
 35786                                  ; reset_environment checks the DS value against the CurrentPDB. If they are
 35787                                  ; different, then an old-style return is performed. If they are the same,
 35788                                  ; then we release jfns and restore to parent. We still use the PDB at DS:0 as
 35789                                  ; the source of the terminate addresses.
 35790                                  ;
 35791                                  ; Some subtlety: We are about to issue a bunch of calls that *may* generate
 35792                                  ; INT 24s. We *cannot* allow the user to restart the abort process; we may
 35793                                  ; end up aborting the wrong process or turn a terminate/stay/resident into a
 35794                                  ; normal abort and leave interrupt handlers around. What we do is to set a
 35795                                  ; flag that will indicate that if any abort code is seen, we just continue the
 35796                                  ; operation. In essence, we dis-allow the abort response.
 35797                                  ;
 35798                                  ; output:   none.
 35799                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 36027                                  ;	TITLE	FAT - FAT maintenance routines
 36028                                  ;	NAME	FAT
 36029                                  
 36030                                  ;**	FAT.ASM
 36031                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36032                                  ;	Low level local device routines for performing disk change sequence,
 36033                                  ;	setting cluster validity, and manipulating the FAT
 36034                                  ;
 36035                                  ;	IsEof
 36036                                  ;	UNPACK
 36037                                  ;	PACK
 36038                                  ;	MAPCLUSTER
 36039                                  ;	FATREAD_SFT
 36040                                  ;	FATREAD_CDS
 36041                                  ;	FAT_operation
 36042                                  ;
 36043                                  ;	Revision history:
 36044                                  ;
 36045                                  ;	  AN000  version Jan. 1988
 36046                                  ;	   A001  PTM	      -- disk changed for look ahead buffers
 36047                                  ;
 36048                                  ;	M014 - if a request for pack\unpack cluster 0 is made we write\read
 36049                                  ;	       from CL0FATENTRY rather than disk.
 36050                                  
 36051                                  ; DOSCODE:94FAh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 36052                                  
 36053                                  ; 02/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 36054                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:A40Ch
 36055                                  
 36056                                  ;Break <IsEOF - check the quantity in BX for EOF>
 36057                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36058                                  ;
 36059                                  ; Procedure Name : IsEOF
 36060                                  ;
 36061                                  ; IsEOF - check the fat value in BX for eof.
 36062                                  ;
 36063                                  ;   Inputs:	ES:BP point to DPB
 36064                                  ;		BX has fat value
 36065                                  ;   Outputs:	JAE eof
 36066                                  ;   Registers modified: none
 36067                                  ;
 36068                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36069                                  
 36070                                  IsEOF:
 36071                                  	; 02/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 36072                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 36073                                  	;;;
 36074 00005F08 E89801                  	call	IsFAT32			; is it FAT32 drive ?
 36075 00005F0B 730D                    	jnc	short IsEOF_FAT		; no, it has 12 or 16 bit FAT
 36076                                  
 36077                                  	; FAT32 fs
 36078 00005F0D 36813E[E80A]FF0F        	cmp	word [ss:CLUSTNUM_HW],0FFFh
 36079 00005F14 7503                    	jnz     short IsEOF_other1	; not EOF
 36080 00005F16 83FBF8                  	cmp     bx,0FFF8h		; 32 bit compare
 36081                                  IsEOF_other1:
 36082 00005F19 C3                      	retn 				; cf=0 -> EOF, cf=1 -> not EOF
 36083                                  
 36084                                  IsEOF_FAT:
 36085                                  	;;;
 36086                                  
 36087                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+0Dh],0FF6h
 36088 00005F1A 26817E0DF60F            	CMP	word [ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER],4096-10 ; is this 16 bit fat?
 36089 00005F20 730B                    	JAE	short EOF16			; yes, check for eof there
 36090                                  
 36091                                  ;J.K. 8/27/86
 36092                                  ;Modified to accept 0FF0h as an eof. This is to handle the diskfull case
 36093                                  ;of any media that has "F0"(Other) as a MediaByte.
 36094                                  ;Hopely, this does not create any side effect for those who may use any value
 36095                                  ;other than "FF8-FFF" as an EOF for their own file.
 36096                                  
 36097 00005F22 81FBF00F                	cmp	bx,0FF0h
 36098 00005F26 7404                    	je	short IsEOF_other
 36099                                  
 36100 00005F28 81FBF80F                	CMP	BX,0FF8h		; do the 12 bit compare
 36101                                  IsEOF_other:
 36102 00005F2C C3                      	retn
 36103                                  EOF16:
 36104 00005F2D 83FBF8                  	CMP	BX,0FFF8h		; 16 bit compare
 36105 00005F30 C3                      	retn				; cf=0 -> EOF, cf=1 -> not EOF
 36106                                  
 36107                                  ; DOSCODE:9511h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 36108                                  
 36109                                  ;Break	<UNPACK -- UNPACK FAT ENTRIES>
 36110                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36111                                  ;
 36112                                  ; Procedure Name : UNPACK
 36113                                  ;
 36114                                  ; Inputs:
 36115                                  ;	BX = Cluster number (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 36116                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 36117                                  ; Outputs:
 36118                                  ;	DI = Contents of FAT for given cluster (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 36119                                  ;	Zero set means DI=0 (free cluster)
 36120                                  ;	Carry set means error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 36121                                  ; SI Destroyed, No other registers affected. Fatal error if cluster too big.
 36122                                  ;
 36123                                  ; NOTE: if BX = 0 then DI = contents of CL0FATENTRY
 36124                                  ;
 36125                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36126                                  
 36127                                  	; 02/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 36128                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0A44Eh
 36129                                  	;
 36130                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS .SYS - DOSCODE:9511h)

 36546                                  ;
 36547                                  ; Procedure Name : MAPCLUSTER
 36548                                  ;
 36549                                  ; Inputs:
 36550                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 36551                                  ;	BX Is cluster number
 36552                                  ; Function:
 36553                                  ;	Get a pointer to the cluster
 36554                                  ; Outputs:
 36555                                  ;	DS:DI Points to contents of FAT for given cluster
 36556                                  ;	DS:SI Points to start of buffer
 36557                                  ;	Zero Not set if cluster data is in high 12 bits of word
 36558                                  ;	Zero set if cluster data is in low 12 or 16 bits
 36559                                  ;	Carry set if failed.
 36560                                  ; SI is destroyed.
 36561                                  ;
 36562                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36563                                  
 36564                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 36565                                  	; DOSCODE:9601h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 36566                                  	; 27/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 36862                                  ; Procedure Name : FATREAD_SFT
 36863                                  ;
 36864                                  ; Inputs:
 36865                                  ;	ES:DI points to an SFT for the drive of interest (local only,
 36866                                  ;		giving a NET SFT will produce system crashing results).
 36867                                  ;	DS DOSDATA
 36868                                  ; Function:
 36869                                  ;	Can be used by an SFT routine (like CLOSE) to invalidate buffers
 36870                                  ;	if disk changed.
 36871                                  ;	In other respects, same as FATREAD_CDS.
 36872                                  ;	(note ES:DI destroyed!)
 36873                                  ; Outputs:
 36874                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 36875                                  ; NOTE: This routine may cause FATREAD_CDS to "miss" a disk change
 36876                                  ;	as far as invalidating curdir_ID is concerned.
 36877                                  ;	Since getting a true disk changed on this call is a screw up
 36878                                  ;	anyway, that's the way it goes.
 36879                                  ;
 36880                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36881                                  
 36882                                  FATREAD_SFT:
 36883 0000619A 26C46D07                	LES	BP,[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_devptr]
 36884                                  
 36885                                  fatread_gotdpb:	; 03/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 36886                                  	; 27/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 36887                                  	;MOV	AL,[ES:BP+DPB.DRIVE] ; [es:bp+0]
 36888                                  	; 15/12/2022

 36892                                  	;CALL	FAT_GOT_DPB
 36893                                  	; 17/12/2022
 36894 000061A8 E99C00                  	jmp	FAT_GOT_DPB
 36895                                  ;fatread_sft_retn:
 36896                                  	;retn

 36900                                  ; Procedure Name : FATREAD_CDS
 36901                                  ;
 36902                                  ; Inputs:
 36903                                  ;	DS:DOSDATA
 36904                                  ;	ES:DI points to an CDS for the drive of interest (local only,
 36905                                  ;		giving a NET or NUL CDS will produce system crashing results).
 36906                                  ; Function:
 36907                                  ;	If disk may have been changed, media is determined and buffers are
 36908                                  ;	flagged invalid. If not, no action is taken.

 37871                                  ;Break	<GETCURHEAD -- Get current buffer header>

 37873                                  ; Procedure Name : GetCurHead
 37874                                  ; Inputs:
 37875                                  ;	 No Inputs
 37876                                  ; Function:
 37877                                  ;	Returns the pointer to the first buffer in Queue
 37878                                  ;	and updates FIRST_BUFF_ADDR

 37880                                  ; Outputs:
 37881                                  ;	DS:DI = pointer to the first buffer in Queue

 37883                                  ;       LASTBUFFER = -1

 37887                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 37888                                  ; DOSCODE:98D2h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 37890                                  ; DOSCODE:9876h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 37891

 37893                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0AA4Bh
 37894

 37898 00006515 36893E[1711]            	mov	[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR],di	; save first buffer address
 37899 0000651A C3                      	retn

 38163                                  ;Break	<GETBUFFR, GETBUFFRB -- GET A SECTOR INTO A BUFFER>
 38164                                  
 38165                                  ;**	GetBuffr - Get a non-FAT Sector into a Buffer
 38166                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38167                                  ;	GetBuffr does normal ( non-FAT ) sector buffering
 38168                                  ;	It gets the specified local sector into one of the I/O buffers
 38169                                  ;	and shuffles the queue
 38170                                  ; 
 38171                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = 0 means sector must be pre-read
 38172                                  ;		       ELSE no pre-read
 38173                                  ;		(DX) = Desired physical sector number	      (LOW)
 38174                                  ;		HIGH_SECTOR = Desired physical sector number (HIGH)
 38175                                  ;		(ES:BP) = Pointer to drive parameters
 38176                                  ;		ALLOWED set in case of INT 24
 38177                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error (user FAIL response to INT24)
 38178                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 38179                                  ;		CURBUF Points to the Buffer for the sector
 38180                                  ;		    the buffer type bits OF buf_flags = 0, caller must set it
 38181                                  ;	USES	AX, BX, CX, SI, DI, Flags
 38182                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38183                                  
 38184                                  ;**	GetBuffrb - Get a FAT Sector into a Buffer
 38185                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38186                                  ;	GetBuffrb reads a sector from the FAT file system's FAT table.
 38187                                  ;	It gets the specified sector into one of the I/O buffers
 38188                                  ;	and shuffles the queue. We need a special entry point so that
 38189                                  ;	we can read the alternate FAT sector if the first read fails, also
 38190                                  ;	so we can mark the buffer as a FAT sector.
 38191                                  ; 
 38192                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = 0 means sector must be pre-read
 38193                                  ;		       ELSE no pre-read
 38194                                  ;		(DX) = Desired physical sector number	     (LOW)
 38195                                  ;		(SI) != 0
 38196                                  ;		HIGH_SECTOR = Desired physical sector number (HIGH)
 38197                                  ;		(ES:BP) = Pointer to drive parameters
 38198                                  ;		ALLOWED set in case of INT 24
 38199                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error (user FAIL response to INT24)
 38200                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 38201                                  ;		CURBUF Points to the Buffer for the sector
 38202                                  ;		    the buffer type bits OF buf_flags = 0, caller must set it
 38203                                  ;	USES	AX, BX, CX, SI, DI, Flags

 39196                                  ;	TITLE	MSPROC - process maintenance
 39197                                  ;	NAME	MSPROC
 39198                                  
 39199                                  ; =========================================================================
 39200                                  ;**	Process related system calls and low level routines for DOS 2.X.
 39201                                  ;	I/O specs are defined in DISPATCH.
 39202                                  ;
 39203                                  ;	$WAIT
 39204                                  ;	$EXEC
 39205                                  ;	$Keep_process
 39206                                  ;	Stay_resident
 39207                                  ;	$EXIT
 39208                                  ;	$ABORT
 39209                                  ;	abort_inner
 39210                                  ;
 39211                                  ;	Modification history:
 39212                                  ;
 39213                                  ;		Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 39214                                  ;		AN000	version 4.0 jan. 1988
 39215                                  ;		A007	PTM 3957 - fake vesrion for IBMCACHE.COM
 39216                                  ;		A008	PTM 4070 - fake version for MS WINDOWS
 39217                                  ;
 39218                                  ;		M000	added support for loading programs into UMBs 7/9/90
 39219                                  ;
 39220                                  ;		M004 - MS PASCAL 3.2 support. Please see under tag M003 in 
 39221                                  ;		       dossym.inc. 7/30/90
 39222                                  ;		M005 - Support for EXE programs with out STACK segment and 
 39223                                  ;		       with resident size < 64K - 256 bytes. A 256 byte 
 39224                                  ;		       stack is provided at the end of the program. Note that
 39225                                  ;		       only SP is changed.
 39226                                  ;		M020 - Fix for Rational bug for details see exepatch.asm
 39227                                  ;
 39228                                  ;		M028 - 4b04 implementation
 39229                                  ;
 39230                                  ;		M029 - Support for EXEs without stack rewritten. If EXE is
 39231                                  ;			in memory block >= 64K, sp = 0. If memory block
 39232                                  ;			obtained is <64K, point sp at the end of the memory
 39233                                  ;			block. For EXEs smaller than 64K, 256 bytes are still
 39234                                  ;			added for a stack segment which may be needed if it
 39235                                  ;			is loaded in low memory situations.
 39236                                  ;
 39237                                  ;		M030 - Fixing bug in EXEPACPATCH & changing 4b04 to 4b05
 39238                                  ;
 39239                                  ;		M040 - Bug #3052. The environment sizing code would flag a
 39240                                  ;			a bad environment if it reached 32767 bytes. Changed
 39241                                  ;			to allow 32768 bytes of environment.
 39242                                  ;
 39243                                  ;		M047 - Release the allocated UMB when we failed to load a 
 39244                                  ;		       COM file high. Also ensure that if the biggest block
 39245                                  ;		       into which we load the com file is less than 64K then
 39246                                  ;		       we provide atleast 256 bytes of stack to the user.
 39247                                  ;
 39248                                  ;		M050 - Made Lie table search CASE insensitive
 39249                                  ;
 39250                                  ;		M060 - Removed special version table from the kernal and
 39251                                  ;                      put it in a device drive which puts the address
 39252                                  ;                      in the DOS DATA area location UU_IFS_DOS_CALL
 39253                                  ;		       as a DWORD.
 39254                                  ;
 39255                                  ;		M063 - Modified UMB support. If the HIGH_ONLY bit is set on
 39256                                  ;		       entry do not try to load low if there is no space in
 39257                                  ;		       UMBs.
 39258                                  ;
 39259                                  ;		M068 - Support for copy protect apps. Call ChkCopyProt to 
 39260                                  ;		       set a20off_count. Set bit EXECA20BIT in DOS_FLAG. Also
 39261                                  ;		       change return address to LeaveDos if AL=5.
 39262                                  ;
 39263                                  ;               20-Jul-1992 bens  Added ifdef RESTRICTED_BUILD code that
 39264                                  ;                      controls building a version of MSDOS.SYS that only
 39265                                  ;                      runs programs from a fixed list (defined in the
 39266                                  ;                      file RESTRICT.INC).  Search for "RESTRICTED_BUILD"
 39267                                  ;                      for details.  This feature is used to build a
 39268                                  ;                      "special" version of DOS that can be handed out to
 39269                                  ;                      OEM/ISV customers as part of a "service" disk.
 39270                                  ;

 39309                                  ; =========================================================================
 39310                                  ;BREAK <$exec - load/go a program>
 39311                                  ;	EXEC.ASM - EXEC System Call
 39312                                  ;
 39313                                  ;
 39314                                  ; Assembler usage:
 39315                                  ;	    lds     DX, Name
 39316                                  ;	    les     BX, Blk
 39317                                  ;	    mov     AH, Exec
 39318                                  ;	    mov     AL, FUNC
 39319                                  ;	    int     INT_COMMAND
 39320                                  ;
 39321                                  ;	AL  Function
 39322                                  ;	--  --------
 39323                                  ;	 0  Load and execute the program.
 39324                                  ;	 1  Load, create the program header but do not
 39325                                  ;	    begin execution.
 39326                                  ;	 3  Load overlay. No header created.
 39327                                  ;
 39328                                  ;	    AL = 0 -> load/execute program
 39329                                  ;
 39330                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39331                                  ;	    | WORD segment address of	|
 39332                                  ;	    | environment.		|
 39333                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39334                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to ASCIZ	|
 39335                                  ;	    | command line at 80h	|
 39336                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39337                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39338                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 5Ch	|
 39339                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39340                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39341                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 6Ch	|
 39342                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39343                                  ;
 39344                                  ;	    AL = 1 -> load program
 39345                                  ;
 39346                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39347                                  ;	    | WORD segment address of	|
 39348                                  ;	    | environment.		|
 39349                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39350                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to ASCIZ	|
 39351                                  ;	    | command line at 80h	|
 39352                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39353                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39354                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 5Ch	|
 39355                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39356                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39357                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 6Ch	|
 39358                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39359                                  ;	    | DWORD returned value of	|
 39360                                  ;	    | CS:IP			|
 39361                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39362                                  ;	    | DWORD returned value of	|
 39363                                  ;	    | SS:IP			|
 39364                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39365                                  ;
 39366                                  ;	    AL = 3 -> load overlay
 39367                                  ;
 39368                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39369                                  ;	    | WORD segment address where|
 39370                                  ;	    | file will be loaded.	|
 39371                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39372                                  ;	    | WORD relocation factor to |
 39373                                  ;	    | be applied to the image.	|
 39374                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39375                                  ;
 39376                                  ; Returns:
 39377                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_function
 39378                                  ;	       = error_bad_format
 39379                                  ;	       = error_bad_environment
 39380                                  ;	       = error_not_enough_memory
 39381                                  ;	       = error_file_not_found
 39382                                  ; =========================================================================
 39383                                  ;
 39384                                  ;   Revision history:
 39385                                  ;
 39386                                  ;	 A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 39387                                  ;
 39388                                  ; =========================================================================
 39389

 39474                                  	; Reset the A20OFF_COUNT to 0. This is done as there is a
 39475                                  	; possibility that the count may not be decremented all the way to
 39476                                  	; 0. A typical case is if the program for which we intended to keep
 39477                                  	; the A20 off for a sufficiently long time (A20OFF_COUNT int 21 
 39478                                  	; calls), exits pre-maturely due to error conditions.
 39479                                  
 39480                                  	; MSDOS 6.0

 39484                                  	; to be LeaveDos in msdisp.asm. This ensures that the EXECA20OFF

 41078                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41079                                  ;SUBTTL Terminate and stay resident handler
 41080                                  ;
 41081                                  ; Input:    DX is an offset from CurrentPDB at which to
 41082                                  ;	    truncate the current block.
 41083                                  ;
 41084                                  ; output:   The current block is truncated (expanded) to be [DX+15]/16
 41085                                  ;	    paragraphs long. An exit is simulated via resetting CurrentPDB
 41086                                  ;	    and restoring the vectors.
 41087                                  ;
 41088                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41089

 41091                                  	; DOSCODE:A19Bh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 41099                                  _$KEEP_PROCESS:
 41100 00006E44 50                      	push	AX			; keep exit code around
 41101                                  	;mov	byte [SS:EXIT_TYPE],3
 41102 00006E45 36C606[7C05]03          	mov	BYTE [SS:EXIT_TYPE],EXIT_KEEP_PROCESS
 41103 00006E4B 368E06[3003]            	mov	ES,[SS:CurrentPDB]
 41104 00006E50 83FA06                  	cmp	DX,6h			; keep enough space around for system
 41105 00006E53 7303                    	jae	short Keep_Shrink	; info
 41106                                  
 41107 00006E55 BA0600                  	mov	DX,6h

 41111 00006E5A 53                      	push	BX

 41114 00006E5F 1F                      	pop	DS
 41115 00006E60 5B                      	pop	BX
 41116 00006E61 7207                    	jc	short Keep_Done		; failed on modification
 41117

 41200                                  	; to be correct as the one that is terminating.

 41417                                  ;**	Arena_Next - Find Next item in Arena
 41418                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41419                                  ;	ENTRY	DS - pointer to block head
 41420                                  ;		(di) = 0
 41421                                  ;	EXIT	AX,ES - pointers to next head
 41422                                  ;		'C' set iff arena damaged
 41423                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41424                                  
 41425                                  arena_next:
 41426 00006F04 8CD8                            MOV     AX,DS                   ; AX <- current block
 41427 00006F06 03060300                        ADD     AX,[ARENA.SIZE]		; AX <- AX + current block length
 41428 00006F0A 40                              INC     AX                      ; remember that header!
 41429                                  
 41430                                  ;       fall into check_signature and return
 41431                                  ;
 41432                                  ;       CALL    check_signature         ; ES <- AX, carry set if error
 41433                                  ;       RETN
 41434                                  
 41435                                  ;**	Check_Signature - Check Memory Block Signature
 41436                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41437                                  ;	ENTRY	(AX) = address of block header
 41438                                  ;		(di) = 0
 41439                                  ;	EXIT	 ES = AX
 41440                                  ;		'C' clear if signature good
 41441                                  ;		'C' set if signature bad
 41442                                  ;	USES	ES, Flags
 41443                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41444                                  
 41445                                  check_signature:        
 41446                                  
 41447 00006F0B 8EC0                    	MOV     ES,AX                   ; ES <- AX
 41448                                  	;cmp	byte [es:di],4Dh ; 'M'
 41449 00006F0D 26803D4D                        CMP     BYTE [ES:DI],arena_signature_normal
 41450                                                                          ; IF next signature = not_end THEN
 41451 00006F11 7407                            JZ      SHORT check_signature_ok ;   GOTO ok
 41452                                  	;cmp 	byte [es:di],5Ah ; 'Z'
 41453 00006F13 26803D5A                        CMP     BYTE [ES:DI],arena_signature_end
 41454                                                                          ; IF next signature = end then
 41455 00006F17 7401                            JZ      SHORT check_signature_ok ;   GOTO ok
 41456 00006F19 F9                              STC                             ; set error
 41457                                  ret_label: ; MSDOS 6.0
 41458                                  ;AFP_RETN:	; 10/03/2024
 41459                                   	; Retro DOS v2.0 - 05/03/2018
 41460                                  check_signature_ok:
 41461                                  COALESCE_RETN:
 41462 00006F1A C3                      	RETN
 41463                                  
 41464                                  ;**	Coalesce - Combine free blocks ahead with current block
 41465                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41466                                  ;	Coalesce adds the block following the argument to the argument block,
 41467                                  ;	iff it's free.  Coalesce is usually used to join free blocks, but
 41468                                  ;	some callers (such as $setblock) use it to join a free block to it's
 41469                                  ;	preceeding allocated block.
 41470                                  ;
 41471                                  ;	ENTRY	(ds) = pointer to the head of a free block
 41472                                  ;		(di) = 0
 41473                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 41474                                  ;		  (ds) unchanged, this block updated
 41475                                  ;		  (ax) = address of next block, IFF not at end
 41476                                  ;		'C' set if arena trashed
 41477                                  ;	USES	(cx)
 41478                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41479                                          
 41480                                  Coalesce:
 41481                                  	;cmp	byte [di],5Ah ; 'Z'
 41482 00006F1B 803D5A                  	CMP     BYTE [DI],arena_signature_end
 41483                                                                          ; IF current signature = END THEN
 41484                                          ;retz				;   GOTO ok
 41485 00006F1E 74FA                            jz	short COALESCE_RETN
 41486 00006F20 E8E1FF                  	CALL    arena_next              ; ES, AX <- next block, Carry set if error
 41487                                          ;retc				; IF no error THEN GOTO check
 41488 00006F23 72F5                    	jc	short COALESCE_RETN
 41489                                  
 41490                                  coalesce_check:
 41491                                  	;cmp	[es:1],di
 41492 00006F25 26393E0100                      CMP     [ES:ARENA.OWNER],DI
 41493                                          ;retnz				; IF next block isnt free THEN return
 41494 00006F2A 75EE                            JNZ	SHORT COALESCE_RETN
 41495                                  	;mov	cx,[ES:3]
 41496 00006F2C 268B0E0300              	MOV     CX,[ES:ARENA.SIZE]	; CX <- next block size
 41497 00006F31 41                              INC     CX                      ; CX <- CX + 1 (for header size)
 41498                                          ;ADD	[3],CX
 41499 00006F32 010E0300                	ADD     [ARENA.SIZE],CX		; current size <- current size + CX
 41500 00006F36 268A0D                          MOV     CL,[ES:DI]              ; move up signature
 41501 00006F39 880D                            MOV     [DI],CL
 41502 00006F3B EBDE                            JMP     SHORT Coalesce		; try again

 41504                                  ; 04/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
