 41507                                  ;	BREAK  <$Alloc - allocate space in memory>
 41508                                  
 41509                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 41510                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41511                                  ;**	$Alloc - Allocate Memory Space
 41512                                  ;
 41513                                  ;	$Alloc services the INT21 that allocates memory space to a program.
 41514                                  ;	Alloc returns a pointer to a free block of memory that
 41515                                  ;	has the requested size in paragraphs.
 41516                                  ;
 41517                                  ;	If the allocation strategy is HIGH_FIRST or HIGH_ONLY memory is 
 41518                                  ;	scanned from umb_head if not from arena_head. If the strategy is
 41519                                  ; 	HIGH_FIRST the scan is continued from arena_head if a block of 
 41520                                  ;	appropriate size is not found in the UMBs. If the strategy is 
 41521                                  ;	HIGH_FIRST+HIGH_ONLY only the UMBs are scanned for memory.
 41522                                  ;
 41523                                  ;	In either case if bit 0 of UmbFlag is not initialized then the scan
 41524                                  ;	starts from arena_head.
 41525                                  ;
 41526                                  ;	Assembler usage:
 41527                                  ;           MOV     BX,size
 41528                                  ;           MOV     AH,Alloc
 41529                                  ;           INT     21h
 41530                                  ;
 41531                                  ;	BUGBUG - a lot can be done to improve performance. We can set marks
 41532                                  ;	so that we start searching the arena at it's first non-trivial free
 41533                                  ;	block, we can peephole the code, etc. (We can move some subr calls
 41534                                  ;	inline, etc.) I assume that this is called rarely and that the arena
 41535                                  ;	doesn't have too many memory objects in it beyond the first free one.
 41536                                  ;	verify that this is true; if so, this can stay as is
 41537                                  ;
 41538                                  ;	ENTRY	(bx) = requested size, in bytes
 41539                                  ;		(DS) = (ES) = DOSGROUP
 41540                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if memory allocated
 41541                                  ;		  (ax:0) = address of requested memory
 41542                                  ;		'C' set if request failed
 41543                                  ;		  (AX) = error_not_enough_memory
 41544                                  ;		    (bx) = max size we could have allocated
 41545                                  ;		  (ax) = error_arena_trashed
 41546                                  ;	USES	All
 41547                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41548                                  
 41549                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 41550                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41551                                  ;SUBTTL $Alloc - allocate space in memory
 41552                                  ;
 41553                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 41554                                  ;           MOV     BX,size
 41555                                  ;           MOV     AH,Alloc
 41556                                  ;           INT     21h
 41557                                  ;         AX:0 is pointer to allocated memory
 41558                                  ;         BX is max size if not enough memory
 41559                                  ;
 41560                                  ;   Description:
 41561                                  ;           Alloc returns  a  pointer  to  a  free  block of
 41562                                  ;       memory that has the requested  size  in  paragraphs.
 41563                                  ;
 41564                                  ;   Error return:
 41565                                  ;           AX = error_not_enough_memory
 41566                                  ;              = error_arena_trashed
 41567                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41568                                  
 41569                                  ; DOSCODE:A28Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 41907                                  ;	BREAK $SETBLOCK - change size of an allocated block (if possible)
 41908                                  
 41909                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 41910                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41911                                  ;**	$SETBLOCK - Change size of an Allocated Block
 41912                                  ;
 41913                                  ;	Setblock changes the size of an allocated block. First, we coalesce
 41914                                  ;	any following free space onto this block; then we try to trim the
 41915                                  ;	block down to the size requested.
 41916                                  ;
 41917                                  ;	Note that if the guy wants to grow the block but that growth fails,
 41918                                  ;	we still go ahead and coalesce any trailing free blocks onto it.
 41919                                  ;	Thus the maximum-size-possible value that we return has already
 41920                                  ;	been allocated! This is a bug, dare we fix it? BUGBUG
 41921                                  ;
 41922                                  ;	NOTE - $SETBLOCK is in bed with $ALLOC and jumps into $ALLOC to
 41923                                  ;		finish it's work. For this reason we build the allocsf
 41924                                  ;		structure on the frame, to make us compatible with $ALLOCs
 41925                                  ;		code.
 41926                                  ;
 41927                                  ;	ENTRY	(es) = segment of old block
 41928                                  ;		(bx) = newsize
 41929                                  ;		(ah) = SETBLOCK
 41930                                  ;
 41931                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 41932                                  ;		'C' set if error
 41933                                  ;		  (ax) = error_invalid_block
 41934                                  ;		       = error_arena_trashed
 41935                                  ;		       = error_not_enough_memory
 41936                                  ;		       = error_invalid_function
 41937                                  ;		  (bx) = maximum size possible, iff (ax) = error_not_enough_memory
 41938                                  ;	USES	???? BUGBUG
 41939                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41940                                  
 41941                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 41942                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41943                                  ;SUBTTL $SETBLOCK - change size of an allocated block (if possible)
 41944                                  ;
 41945                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 41946                                  ;           MOV     ES,block
 41947                                  ;           MOV     BX,newsize
 41948                                  ;           MOV     AH,setblock
 41949                                  ;           INT     21h
 41950                                  ;         if setblock fails for growing, BX will have the maximum
 41951                                  ;         size possible
 41952                                  ;   Error return:
 41953                                  ;           AX = error_invalid_block
 41954                                  ;              = error_arena_trashed
 41955                                  ;              = error_not_enough_memory
 41956                                  ;              = error_invalid_function
 41957                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41958                                  
 41959                                  _$SETBLOCK:        
 41960                                  	; 04/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 41961                                  	;EnterCrit   critMem
 41962 0000708E E807A8                  	call	ECritMEM ; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0

 42054                                  ;	BREAK $AllocOper - get/set allocation mechanism
 42055                                  
 42056                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 42057                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42058                                  ;**	$AllocOper - Get/Set Allocation Mechanism
 42059                                  ;
 42060                                  ;	Assembler usage:
 42061                                  ;           MOV     AH,AllocOper
 42062                                  ;           MOV     BX,method
 42063                                  ;           MOV     AL,func
 42064                                  ;           INT     21h
 42065                                  ;
 42066                                  ;	ENTRY	
 42067                                  ;		(al) = 0
 42068                                  ;		  Get allocation Strategy in (ax)
 42069                                  ;
 42070                                  ;		(al) = 1, (bx) = method = zw0000xy
 42071                                  ;		  Set allocation strategy.
 42072                                  ;		   w  = 1  => HIGH_ONLY
 42073                                  ;		   z  = 1  => HIGH_FIRST
 42074                                  ;		   xy = 00 => FIRST_FIT
 42075                                  ;		      = 01 => BEST_FIT
 42076                                  ;		      = 10 => LAST_FIT
 42077                                  ;
 42078                                  ;		(al) = 2
 42079                                  ;		  Get UMB link state in (al)
 42080                                  ;
 42081                                  ;		(al) = 3
 42082                                  ;		  Set UMB link state
 42083                                  ;		   (bx) = 0 => Unlink UMBs
 42084                                  ;		   (bx) = 1 => Link UMBs
 42085                                  ;
 42086                                  ;
 42087                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 42088                                  ;
 42089                                  ;		 if (al) = 0
 42090                                  ;		  (ax) = existing method
 42091                                  ;		 if (al) = 1
 42092                                  ;		  Sets allocation strategy
 42093                                  ;		 if (al) = 2
 42094                                  ;		  (al) = 0 => UMBs not linked
 42095                                  ;		  (al) = 1 => UMBs linked in
 42096                                  ;		 if (al) = 3
 42097                                  ;		  Links/Unlinks the UMBs into DOS chain
 42098                                  ;
 42099                                  ;		'C' set if error
 42100                                  ;		  AX = error_invalid_function
 42101                                  ;
 42102                                  ;	Rev. M000 - added support for HIGH_FIRST in (al) = 1. 7/9/90
 42103                                  ; 	Rev. M003 - added functions (al) = 2 and (al) = 3. 7/18/90
 42104                                  ;	Rev. M009 - (al) = 3 will return 'invalid function' in ax if
 42105                                  ;		    umbhead has'nt been initialized by sysinit and 'trashed
 42106                                  ;		    arena' if an arena sig is damaged.
 42107                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42108                                  
 42109                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 42110                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 42112                                  ;

 42343                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42344                                  ; Procedure Name : GetLastArena		-  M003
 42345                                  ;
 42346                                  ; Inputs	 : cx = umb_head
 42347                                  ;
 42348                                  ;
 42349                                  ; Outputs	 : If UMBs are linked
 42350                                  ;			ES = umb_head
 42351                                  ;			DS = arena before umb_head
 42352                                  ;		   else
 42353                                  ;			DS = last arena
 42354                                  ;			ES = next arena. will be umb_head if NC.
 42355                                  ;
 42356                                  ;		   CY if error
 42357                                  ;
 42358                                  ; Uses		 : DS, ES, DI, BX
 42359                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42360                                  
 42361                                  ; 14/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 42362                                  ; DOSCODE:A4D6h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 42363                                  
 42364                                  ; 01/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42365                                  ; DOSCODE:A476h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42366                                  
 42367                                  	; 10/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 42368                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0B6D9h
 42369                                  
 42370                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0A4D6h)

 42375

 42378 0000715E 31FF                    	xor	di,di

 42381                                  					; Q: is this the last arena

 42383

 42396                                  					;    umb_head

 42400                                  	;;;

 42536                                  ;	AL=3	Close all files for DPL_UID

 42879                                  ;	BREAK	<pJFNFromHandle - return pointer to JFN table entry>
 42880                                  
 42881                                  ;**	pJFNFromHandle - Translate Handle to Pointer to JFN
 42882                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42883                                  ;	pJFNFromHandle takes a file handle and turns that into a pointer to
 42884                                  ;	the JFN entry (i.e., to a byte holding the internal file handle #)
 42885                                  ;
 42886                                  ;	NOTE:
 42887                                  ;	  This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK which is called
 42888                                  ;	  at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 42889                                  ;
 42890                                  ;	ENTRY	(bx) = handle
 42891                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if ok
 42892                                  ;		  (es:di) = address of JFN value
 42893                                  ;		'C' set if error
 42894                                  ;		  (ax) = error code
 42895                                  ;	USES	AX, DI, ES, Flags
 42896                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42897                                  
 42898                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42899                                  	; 11/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 42900                                  
 42901                                  pJFNFromHandle:
 42902                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 42903                                  	;getdseg <es>			; es -> dosdata
 42904 000072E5 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 42905                                  	
 42906                                  	;MOV	ES,[cs:CurrentPDB]	; get user process data block
 42907 000072EA 268E06[3003]            	mov	es,[es:CurrentPDB]
 42908                                  
 42909                                  	;cmp	bx,[ES:32h]
 42910 000072EF 263B1E3200              	CMP	BX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]	; is handle greater than allocated
 42911 000072F4 7204                    	JB	short pjfn10		; no, get offset
 42912                                  ReturnCarry_inv_hndl: ; 05/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 42913                                  	;mov	al,6
 42914 000072F6 B006                    	MOV     AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 42915                                  ReturnCarry:
 42916 000072F8 F9                      	STC                             ; signal error
 42917 000072F9 C3                      	retn				; go back
 42918                                  pjfn10: 
 42919                                  	;les	di,[es:34h]
 42920 000072FA 26C43E3400              	LES	DI,[ES:PDB.JFN_Pointer]	; get pointer to beginning of table
 42921 000072FF 01DF                    	ADD	DI,BX			; add in offset, clear 'C'
 42922                                  	;clc
 42923                                  pJFNFromHandle_error:
 42924 00007301 C3                      	retn

 42926                                  ;BREAK <SFFromHandle - return pointer (or error) to SF entry from handle>
 42927                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42928                                  ;
 42929                                  ; Procedure Name : SFFromHandle
 42930                                  ;
 42931                                  ; SFFromHandle - Given a handle, get JFN and then index into SF table
 42932                                  ;
 42933                                  ;   Input:      BX has handle
 42934                                  ;   Output:     Carry Set
 42935                                  ;                   AX has error code
 42936                                  ;               Carry Reset
 42937                                  ;                   ES:DI has pointer to SF entry
 42938                                  ;   Registers modified: If error, AX,ES, else ES:DI
 42939                                  ; NOTE:
 42940                                  ;   This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK which is called
 42941                                  ;       at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 42942                                  ;
 42943                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42944                                  
 42945                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42946                                  	; 11/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 42947                                  
 42948                                  SFFromHandle:
 42949 00007302 E8E0FF                  	CALL	pJFNFromHandle		; get jfn pointer
 42950                                  	;retc				; return if error
 42951 00007305 72FA                    	jc	short pJFNFromHandle_error
 42952 00007307 26803DFF                	CMP     BYTE [ES:DI],-1		; unused handle
 42953                                  	;JNZ	short GetSF		; nope, suck out SF
 42954                                  	;;mov	al,6
 42955                                  	;MOV	AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 42956                                  	;jmp	short ReturnCarry	; signal it
 42957                                  	; 17/12/2022
 42958                                  	; 02/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42959 0000730B 74E9                    	jz	short ReturnCarry_inv_hndl ; Retro DOS v3.0 modification
 42960                                  	;JNZ	short GetSF		; nope, suck out SF
 42961                                  	;;mov	al,6
 42962                                  	;MOV	AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 42963                                  	;jmp	short ReturnCarry	; signal it
 42964                                  GetSF:
 42965 0000730D 53                      	push	bx			; save handle
 42966 0000730E 268A1D                  	MOV     BL,[ES:DI]		; get SFN
 42967 00007311 30FF                    	XOR     BH,BH                   ; ignore upper half
 42968 00007313 E80200                  	CALL    SFFromSFN               ; get real sf spot
 42969 00007316 5B                      	pop	bx			; restore
 42970 00007317 C3                      	retn                        	; say goodbye

 42972                                  ;BREAK <SFFromSFN - index into SF table for SFN>
 42973                                  
 42974                                  ;**	SFFromSFN - Get an SF Table entry from an SFN
 42975                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42976                                  ;	SFFromSfn uses an SFN to index an entry into the SF table. This
 42977                                  ;	is more than just a simple index instruction because the SF table
 42978                                  ;	can be made up of multiple pieces chained together. We follow the
 42979                                  ;	chain to the right piece and then do the index operation.
 42980                                  ;
 42981                                  ;   NOTE:
 42982                                  ;	This routine is called from SFFromHandle which is called
 42983                                  ;       at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 42984                                  ;
 42985                                  ;	ENTRY	BX has SF index
 42986                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 42987                                  ;		  ES:DI points to SF entry
 42988                                  ;		'C' set if index too large
 42989                                  ;	USES	BX, DI, ES
 42990                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42991                                  
 42992                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42993                                  	; 11/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 42994                                  
 42995                                  SFFromSFN:
 42996                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 42997                                  	;getdseg <es>			; es -> dosdata
 42998 00007318 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 42999                                  
 43000                                  	;LES	DI,[CS:SFT_ADDR]	; (es:di) = start of SFT table
 43001 0000731D 26C43E[2A00]            	les	di,[es:SFT_ADDR]
 43002                                  sfsfn5:	
 43003                                  	;cmp	bx,[es:di+4]
 43004 00007322 263B5D04                	CMP	BX,[ES:DI+SFT.SFCount]	; is handle in this table?
 43005 00007326 720E                    	JB	short sfsfn7		; yes, go grab it
 43006                                  	;sub	bx,[es:di+4]
 43007 00007328 262B5D04                	SUB     BX,[ES:DI+SFT.SFCount]
 43008 0000732C 26C43D                  	les	di,[es:di] ; 14/08/2018
 43009                                  	;LES	DI,[ES:DI+SFT.SFLink]	; get next table segment
 43010 0000732F 83FFFF                  	CMP     DI,-1                   ; end of tables?
 43011 00007332 75EE                    	JNZ	short sfsfn5		; no, try again
 43012 00007334 F9                      	STC
 43013 00007335 C3                      	retn				; return with error, not found
 43014                                  sfsfn7:
 43015 00007336 50                      	push	ax
 43016                                  	;;mov	ax,53 ; MSDOS 3.3
 43017                                  	;mov	ax,59 ; MSDOS 5.0 to PCDOS 7.1 (to Win ME) ; 11/03/2024
 43018                                  	;MOV	AX,SF_ENTRY.size	; put it in a nice place
 43019                                  	
 43020                                  	; 17/12/2022
 43021 00007337 B03B                    	mov	al,SF_ENTRY.size ; 28/05/2019
 43022                                  	; 07/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 43023                                  	;mov	ax,SF_ENTRY.size ; 59
 43024                                  	
 43025 00007339 F6E3                    	MUL	BL			; (ax) = offset into this SF block
 43026 0000733B 01C7                    	ADD	DI,AX			; add base of SF block
 43027 0000733D 58                      	pop	ax
 43028                                  	;add	di,6
 43029 0000733E 83C706                  	ADD	DI,SFT.SFTable		; offset into structure, 'C' cleared
 43030 00007341 C3                      	retn				; return with 'C' clear

 43034                                  ;**	JFNFree - Find a Free JFN Slot
 43035                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43036                                  ;	JFNFree scansthrough the JFN table and returnsa pointer to a free slot
 43037                                  ;
 43038                                  ;	ENTRY	(ss) = DOSDATA
 43039                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 43040                                  ;		  (bx) = new handle
 43041                                  ;		  (es:di) = pointer to JFN slot
 43042                                  ;		'C' set if error
 43043                                  ;		  (al) = error code
 43044                                  ;	USES	bx, di, es, flags
 43045                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43046                                  
 43047                                  JFNFree:
 43048 00007342 31DB                    	XOR	BX,BX			; (bx) = initial JFN to try
 43049                                  jfnf1:	
 43050 00007344 E89EFF                  	CALL	pJFNFromHandle		; get the appropriate handle
 43051 00007347 7209                    	JC	short jfnf5		; no more handles
 43052 00007349 26803DFF                	CMP     BYTE [ES:DI],-1		; free?
 43053 0000734D 7405                    	je	short jfnfx		; yes, carry is clear
 43054 0000734F 43                      	INC     BX                      ; no, next handle
 43055 00007350 EBF2                    	JMP	short jfnf1		; and try again
 43056                                  
 43057                                  	; Error. 'C' set
 43058                                  jfnf5:	
 43059                                  	;mov	al,4
 43060 00007352 B004                    	MOV	AL,error_too_many_open_files
 43061                                  jfnfx:

 43063                                  
 43064                                  ;	BREAK <SFNFree - Allocate a free SFN>
 43065                                  
 43066                                  ;**	SFNFree - Allocate a Free SFN/SFT
 43067                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43068                                  ;	SFNFree scans through the sf table looking for a free entry
 43069                                  ;	If it finds one it partially allocates it by setting SFT_REF_COUNT = -1
 43070                                  ;
 43071                                  ;	The problem is that we want to mark the SFT busy so that other threads
 43072                                  ;	can't allocate the SFT before we're finished marking it up.  However,
 43073                                  ;	we can't just mark it busy because we may get blown out of our open
 43074                                  ;	by INT24 and leave the thing orphaned.	To solve this we mark it
 43075                                  ;	"allocation in progress" by setting SFT_REF_COUNT = -1.  If we see
 43076                                  ;	an SFT with this value we look to see if it belongs to this user
 43077                                  ;	and process.  If it does belong to us then it must be an orphan
 43078                                  ;	and we reclaim it.
 43079                                  ;
 43080                                  ;	BUGBUG - improve the performance. I guess it's smaller to call SFFromSFN
 43081                                  ;		over and over, but we could at least set a high water mark...
 43082                                  ;		cause an N^2 loop calling slow SFFromSFN is real slow, too slow
 43083                                  ;		even though this is not a frequently called routine - jgl
 43084                                  ;
 43085                                  ;	ENTRY	(ss) = DOSDATA
 43086                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if no error
 43087                                  ;		  (bx) = SFN
 43088                                  ;		  (es:di) = pointer to SFT
 43089                                  ;		  es:[di].SFT_REF_COUNT = -1
 43090                                  ;		'C' set if error
 43091                                  ;		  (al) = error code
 43092                                  ;	USES	bx, di, es, Flags
 43093                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43094                                  
 43095                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 43096                                  	; DOSCODE:A682h (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 43097                                  
 43098                                  	; 11/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 43099                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0B8DEh
 43100                                  
 43101                                  SFNFree:
 43102                                  	; 12/08/2018
 43103                                  	; 05/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 43104                                  	;
 43105                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 43106 00007355 50                      	push	ax
 43107 00007356 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx			; (bx) = SFN to consider
 43108                                  sfnf5:	
 43109 00007358 53                      	push	bx
 43110 00007359 E8BCFF                  	call	SFFromSFN		; get the potential handle
 43111 0000735C 5B                      	pop	bx
 43112 0000735D 723A                    	jc	short sfnf95		; no more free SFNs
 43113 0000735F 26833D00                	cmp	word [ES:DI],0
 43114                                  	;cmp	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_Ref_Count],0 ; free?
 43115 00007363 741D                    	je	short sfnf20			; yep, got one
 43116                                  	
 43117                                  	;cmp	word [es:di],0FFFFh ; -1
 43118 00007365 26833DFF                	cmp	word [ES:DI],sf_busy
 43119                                  	;cmp	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],sf_busy
 43120 00007369 7403                    	je	short sfnf10		; special busy mark
 43121                                  sfnf7:	
 43122 0000736B 43                      	inc	bx			; try the next one
 43123 0000736C EBEA                    	jmp	short sfnf5
 43124                                  
 43125                                  ;	The SFT has the special "busy" mark; if it belongs to us then
 43126                                  ;	it was abandoned during a earlier call and we can use it.
 43127                                  ;
 43128                                  ;	(bx)	= SFN
 43129                                  ;	(es:di) = pointer to SFT
 43130                                  ;	(TOS)	= caller's (ax)
 43131                                  
 43132                                  sfnf10:	
 43133 0000736E 36A1[3E03]              	mov	ax,[SS:USER_ID]
 43134                                  	;cmp	[es:di+2Fh],ax
 43135 00007372 2639452F                	cmp	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_UID],ax
 43136 00007376 75F3                    	jnz	short sfnf7		; not ours
 43137 00007378 36A1[3C03]              	mov	ax,[SS:PROC_ID]
 43138                                  	;cmp	[es:di+31h],ax
 43139 0000737C 26394531                	cmp	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax
 43140 00007380 75E9                    	jnz	short sfnf7		; can't use this one, try the next
 43141                                  
 43142                                  ;	We have an SFT to allocate
 43143                                  ;
 43144                                  ;	(bx)	= SFN
 43145                                  ;	(es:di) = pointer to SFT
 43146                                  ;	(TOS)	= caller's (ax)
 43147                                  
 43148                                  sfnf20:
 43149                                  	; cf = 0 ;; Retro DOS v3.0
 43150                                  
 43151                                  	;mov	word [es:di],0FFFFh
 43152 00007382 26C705FFFF              	mov	word [ES:DI],sf_busy
 43153                                  					; make sure that this is allocated
 43154                                  	;mov	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],sf_busy
 43155                                  
 43156 00007387 36A1[3E03]              	mov	ax,[SS:USER_ID]
 43157                                  	;mov	[es:di+2Fh],ax
 43158 0000738B 2689452F                	mov	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_UID],ax
 43159 0000738F 36A1[3C03]              	mov	ax,[SS:PROC_ID]
 43160                                  	;mov	[es:di+31h],ax
 43161 00007393 26894531                	mov	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax
 43162                                  sfnf21: ;; Retro DOS v3.0
 43163                                  	; 02/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 43164                                  	;pop	ax
 43165                                  	;;clc
 43166                                  	;retn				; return with no error

 43240                                  ; ES:DI point to SFT
 43241                                  ;
 43242                                  ; We now examine the user's JFN entry; If the file was a 70-mode file (network
 43243                                  ; FCB, we examine the ref count on the SFT; if it was 1, we free the JFN.

 44332                                  ;Break	<CheckOwner - verify ownership of handles from server>
 44333                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44334                                  ;   CheckOwner - Due to the ability of the server to close file handles for a
 44335                                  ;   process without the process knowing it (delete/rename of open files, for
 44336                                  ;   example), it is possible for the redirector to issue a call to a handle
 44337                                  ;   that it does not rightfully own. We check here to make sure that the
 44338                                  ;   issuing process is the owner of the SFT. At the same time, we do a
 44339                                  ;   SFFromHandle to really make sure that the SFT is good.
 44340                                  ;
 44341                                  ;	ENTRY	BX has the handle
 44342                                  ;		User_ID is the current user
 44343                                  ;	EXIT	Carry Clear => ES:DI points to SFT
 44344                                  ;		Carry Set => AX has error code
 44345                                  ;	USES	none
 44346                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44347                                  
 44348                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 44349                                  	; 21/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 44351                                  	; 13/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0

 44397                                  ;	TITLE	MACRO - Pathname and macro related internal routines
 44398                                  ;	NAME	MACRO
 44399                                  
 44400                                  ;	Microsoft Confidential
 44401                                  ;	Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation 1991
 44402                                  ;	All Rights Reserved.
 44403                                  
 44404                                  ;**	MACRO.ASM
 44405                                  ;
 44406                                  ;	$AssignOper
 44407                                  ;	FIND_DPB
 44408                                  ;	InitCDS
 44409                                  ;	$UserOper
 44410                                  ;	GetVisDrv
 44411                                  ;	GetThisDrv
 44412                                  ;	GetCDSFromDrv
 44413                                  ;
 44414                                  ;   Revision history:
 44415                                  ;
 44416                                  ;	Created: MZ 4 April 1983
 44417                                  ;		 MZ 18 April 1983   Make TransFCB handle extended FCBs
 44418                                  ;		 AR 2 June 1983     Define/Delete macro for NET redir.
 44419                                  ;		 MZ 3 Nov 83	    Fix InitCDS to reset length to 2
 44420                                  ;		 MZ 4 Nov 83	    Fix NetAssign to use STRLEN only
 44421                                  ;		 MZ 18 Nov 83	    Rewrite string processing for subtree
 44422                                  ;				    aliasing.
 44423                                  ;
 44424                                  ;   MSDOS performs several types of name translation. First, we maintain for
 44425                                  ;   each valid drive letter the text of the current directory on that drive.
 44426                                  ;   For invalid drive letters, there is no current directory so we pretend to
 44427                                  ;   be at the root. A current directory is either the raw local directory
 44428                                  ;   (consisting of drive:\path) or a local network directory (consisting of
 44429                                  ;   \\machine\path. There is a limit on the point to which a .. is allowed.
 44430                                  ;
 44431                                  ;   Given a path, MSDOS will transform this into a real from-the-root path
 44432                                  ;   without . or .. entries. Any component that is > 8.3 is truncated to
 44433                                  ;   this and all * are expanded into ?'s.
 44434                                  ;
 44435                                  ;   The second part of name translation involves subtree aliasing. A list of
 44436                                  ;   subtree pairs is maintained by the external utility SUBST. The results of
 44437                                  ;   the previous 'canonicalization' are then examined to see if any of the
 44438                                  ;   subtree pairs is a prefix of the user path. If so, then this prefix is
 44439                                  ;   replaced with the other subtree in the pair.
 44440                                  ;
 44441                                  ;   A third part involves mapping this "real" path into a "physical" path.  A
 44442                                  ;   list of drive/subtree pairs are maintained by the external utility JOIN.
 44443                                  ;   The output of the previous translation is examined to see if any of the
 44444                                  ;   subtrees in this list are a prefix of the string. If so, then the prefix
 44445                                  ;   is replaced by the appropriate drive letter. In this manner, we can
 44446                                  ;   'mount' one device under another.
 44447                                  ;
 44448                                  ;   The final form of name translation involves the mapping of a user's
 44449                                  ;   logical drive number into the internal physical drive. This is
 44450                                  ;   accomplished by converting the drive number into letter:CON, performing
 44451                                  ;   the above translation and then converting the character back into a drive
 44452                                  ;   number.
 44453                                  ;
 44454                                  ;   There are two main entry points: TransPath and TransFCB. TransPath will
 44455                                  ;   take a path and form the real text of the pathname with all . and ..
 44456                                  ;   removed. TransFCB will translate an FCB into a path and then invoke
 44457                                  ;   TransPath.
 44458                                  ;
 44459                                  ;	A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 44460                                  
 44461                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 44462                                  
 44463                                  ;	I_need	ThisCDS,DWORD		; pointer to CDS used
 44464                                  ;	I_need	CDSAddr,DWORD		; pointer to CDS table
 44465                                  ;	I_need	CDSCount,BYTE		; number of CDS entries
 44466                                  ;	I_need	CurDrv,BYTE		; current macro assignment (old
 44467                                  ;					; current drive)
 44468                                  ;	I_need	NUMIO,BYTE		; Number of physical drives
 44469                                  ;	I_need	fSharing,BYTE		; TRUE => no redirection allowed
 44470                                  ;	I_need	DummyCDS,80h		; buffer for dummy cds
 44471                                  ;	I_need	DIFFNAM,BYTE		; flag for MyName being set
 44472                                  ;	I_need	MYNAME,16		; machine name
 44473                                  ;	I_need	MYNUM,WORD		; machine number
 44474                                  ;	I_need	DPBHEAD,DWORD		; beginning of DPB chain

 44990                                  ;BREAK <TransFCB - convert an FCB into a path, doing substitution>
 44991                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44992                                  ;   TransFCB - Copy an FCB from DS:DX into a reserved area doing all of the
 44993                                  ;       gritty substitution.
 44994                                  ;
 44995                                  ;   Inputs:     DS:DX - pointer to FCB
 44996                                  ;               ES:DI - point to destination
 44997                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry Set - invalid path in final map
 44998                                  ;               Carry Clear - FCB has been mapped into ES:DI
 44999                                  ;                   Sattrib is set from possibly extended FCB
 45000                                  ;                   ExtFCB set if extended FCB found
 45001                                  ;   Registers modified: most
 45002                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 45003                                  
 45004                                  	; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 45005                                  TransFCB:
 45006                                  	; 22/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 45007                                  	; 12/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 45008                                  	;LocalVar FCBTmp,16

 45011 0000782C 89E5                    	mov	bp,sp
 45012                                  	;sub	sp,15	; MSDOS 3.3
 45013 0000782E 83EC10                  	sub	sp,16	; MSDOS 6.0

 45015 00007832 07                      	pop	es
 45016 00007833 06                      	push	es

 45018                                  	;lea	di,[bp-15] ; MSDOS 3.3
 45019                                  	;LEA	DI,FCBTmp 
 45020 00007835 8D7EF0                  	lea	di,[bp-16]		; point to FCB temp area

 45023 00007844 E8B9A9                  	call	GetExtended             ; get FCB, extended or not
 45024                                  	; 06/12/2022
 45025 00007847 740D                    	jz	short GetDrive		; not an extended FCB, get drive
 45026 00007849 8A44FF                  	mov	AL,[SI-1]               ; get attributes
 45027 0000784C 36A2[6D05]              	mov	[SS:SATTRIB],AL		; store search attributes;smr;SS Override

 45082                                  ; 12/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 45083                                  
 45084                                  ;BREAK <TransPath - copy a path, do string sub and put in current dir>
 45085                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 45086                                  ;
 45087                                  ;   TransPath - copy a path from DS:SI to ES:DI, performing component string
 45088                                  ;       substitution, insertion of current directory and fixing . and ..
 45089                                  ;       entries. Perform splicing. Allow input string to match splice
 45090                                  ;       exactly.
 45091                                  ;
 45092                                  ;   TransPathSet - Same as above except No splicing is performed if input path
 45093                                  ;       matches splice.
 45094                                  ;
 45095                                  ;   TransPathNoSet - No splicing/local using is performed at all.
 45096                                  ;
 45097                                  ;   The following anomalous behaviour is required:
 45098                                  ;
 45099                                  ;       Drive letters on devices are ignored. (set up DummyCDS)
 45100                                  ;       Paths on devices are ignored. (truncate to 0-length)
 45101                                  ;       Raw net I/O sets ThisCDS => NULL.
 45102                                  ;       fSharing => dummyCDS and no subst/splice. Only canonicalize.
 45103                                  ;
 45104                                  ;   Other behaviour:
 45105                                  ;
 45106                                  ;       ThisCDS set up.
 45107                                  ;       FatRead done on local CDS.
 45108                                  ;       ValidateCDS done on local CDS.
 45109                                  ;
 45110                                  ;   Brief flowchart:
 45111                                  ;
 45112                                  ;       if fSharing then
 45113                                  ;           set up DummyCDS (ThisCDS)
 45114                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 45115                                  ;           splice
 45116                                  ;           fatRead
 45117                                  ;           return
 45118                                  ;       if \\ or d:\\ lead then
 45119                                  ;           set up null CDS (ThisCDS)
 45120                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 45121                                  ;           return
 45122                                  ;       if device then
 45123                                  ;           set up dummyCDS (ThisCDS)
 45124                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 45125                                  ;           return
 45126                                  ;       if file then
 45127                                  ;           getCDS (sets (ThisCDS) from name)
 45128                                  ;           validateCDS (may reset current dir)
 45129                                  ;           Copy current dir
 45130                                  ;           canonicalize (set cMeta)
 45131                                  ;           splice
 45132                                  ;           generate correct CDS (ThisCDS)
 45133                                  ;           if local then
 45134                                  ;               fatread
 45135                                  ;           return
 45136                                  ;
 45137                                  ;   Inputs:     DS:SI - point to ASCIZ string path
 45138                                  ;               DI - point to buffer in DOSDATA
 45139                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry Set - invalid path specification: too many .., bad
 45140                                  ;                   syntax, etc. or user FAILed to I 24.
 45141                                  ;               WFP_Start - points to beginning of buffer
 45142                                  ;               Curr_Dir_End - points to end of current dir in path
 45143                                  ;               DS - DOSDATA
 45144                                  ;   Registers modified: most
 45145                                  ;
 45146                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 45147                                  
 45148                                  ; 22/05/2019
 45149                                  ; 13/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 45150                                  ; DOSCODE:AB99h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 45151                                  
 45152                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 45153                                  ; DOSCODE:AB39h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 45913                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 45915                                  ;   performs only string substitution and canonicalization, not splicing.  Due
 45916                                  ;   to Transpath playing games with devices, we need to insure that the output
 45917                                  ;   has drive letter and : in it.
 45918                                  ;

 46746                                  ;**	BinToAscii - convert a number to a string.
 46747                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46748                                  ;	BinToAscii converts a 16 bit number into a 4 ascii characters.
 46749                                  ;	This routine is used to generate temp file names so we don't spend
 46750                                  ;	the time and code needed for a true hex number, we just use
 46751                                  ;	A thorugh O.
 46752                                  ;
 46753                                  ;	ENTRY	(ax) = value
 46754                                  ;		(es:di) = destination
 46755                                  ;	EXIT	(es:di) updated by 4
 46756                                  ;	USES	cx, di, flags
 46757                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46758                                  
 46759                                  ; MSDOS 3.3
 46760                                  ;BinToAscii:
 46761                                  ;	mov     cx,4
 46762                                  ;bta5:
 46763                                  ;	push    cx
 46764                                  ;	mov     cl,4
 46765                                  ;	rol     ax,cl
 46766                                  ;	push    ax
 46767                                  ;	and     al,0Fh
 46768                                  ;	add     al,'0'
 46769                                  ;	cmp     al,'9'
 46770                                  ;	jbe     short bta6
 46771                                  ;	add     al,7
 46772                                  ;bta6: 
 46773                                  ;	stosb
 46774                                  ;	pop     ax
 46775                                  ;	pop     cx
 46776                                  ;	loop    bta5
 46777                                  ;	retn
 46778                                  
 46779                                  ; 15/03/2024
 46780                                  ; MSDOS 5.0-6.22 & Windows ME
 46781                                  ; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0B0D9h)
 46782                                  ; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0ABA4h)
 46783                                  %if 0
 46784                                  
 46785                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 46786                                  BinToAscii:
 46787                                  	mov	cx,404h			; (ch) = digit counter, (cl) = shift cnt
 46788                                  bta5:	
 46789                                  	ROL	AX,CL			; move leftmost nibble into rightmost
 46790                                  	push	ax			; preserve remainder of digits
 46791                                  	AND	AL,0Fh			; grab low nibble
 46792                                  	ADD	AL,'A'			; turn into ascii
 46793                                  	STOSB				; drop in the character
 46794                                  	pop	ax			; (ax) = shifted number
 46795                                  	dec	ch
 46796                                  	jnz	short bta5		; process 4 digits
 46797                                  	retn
 46798                                  %else
 46799                                  ; 15/03/2024
 46800                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0C385h
 46801                                  
 46802                                  BinToAscii:
 46803 00007DE3 50                      	push	ax		; convert a number to a string ; ax = value
 46804 00007DE4 86E0                    	xchg	ah,al
 46805                                  	;db	0D4h,10h
 46806 00007DE6 D410                    	aam	10h		; AH = AL / 16 and AL = remainder
 46807 00007DE8 054141                  	add	ax,4141h	; 'AA'
 46808 00007DEB AB                      	stosw
 46809 00007DEC 58                      	pop	ax
 46810                                  	;db	0D4h,10h
 46811 00007DED D410                    	aam	10h
 46812 00007DEF 054141                  	add	ax,4141h	; add ax,'AA'
 46813 00007DF2 AB                      	stosw
 46814 00007DF3 C3                      	retn

 46817                                  ;Break	<$CreateTempFile - create a unique name>
 46818                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46819                                  ;   $CreateTemp - given a directory, create a unique name in that directory.
 46820                                  ;	Method used is to get the current time, convert to a name and attempt
 46821                                  ;	a create new. Repeat until create new succeeds.
 46822                                  ;
 46823                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:DX point to a null terminated directory name.
 46824                                  ;		CX  contains default attributes
 46825                                  ;   Outputs:	Unique name is appended to DS:DX directory.
 46826                                  ;		AX has handle
 46827                                  ;   Registers modified: all
 46828                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46829                                  
 46830                                  	; 10/07/2024
 46831                                  	; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 46832                                  	; 15/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 46833                                  
 46834                                  _$CreateTempFile:
 46835                                  	;Enter
 46836 00007DF4 55                      	push	bp
 46837 00007DF5 89E5                    	mov	bp,sp
 46838                                  
 46839                                  	;LocalVar  EndPtr,DWORD
 46840                                  	;LocalVar  FilPtr,DWORD
 46841                                  	;LocalVar  Attr,WORD
 46842

 46844                                  
 46845                                  	;test	cx,0FFD8h
 46846 00007DFA F7C1D8FF                	test	CX,~attr_changeable
 46847 00007DFE 7405                    	JZ	short OKatts		; Ok if no non-changeable bits set
 46848                                  
 46849                                  ; We need this "hook" here to detect these cases (like user sets one both of
 46850                                  ; vol_id and dir bits) because of the structure of the or $CreateNewFile loop
 46851                                  ; below. The code loops on error_access_denied, but if one of the non
 46852                                  ; changeable attributes is specified, the loop COULD be infinite or WILL be
 46853                                  ; infinite because CreateNewFile will fail with access_denied always. Thus we
 46854                                  ; need to detect these cases before getting to the loop.
 46855                                  
 46856                                  	;mov	ax, 5
 46857 00007E00 B80500                  	MOV	AX,error_access_denied
 46858 00007E03 EB7A                    	JMP	SHORT SETTMPERR

 46861                                  	;MOV	attr,CX 		; save attribute
 46862 00007E05 894EF6                  	mov     [bp-10],cx

 46865                                  	;MOV	FilPtrH,DS
 46866 00007E0B 8C5EFA                  	mov	[bp-6],ds
 46867                                  	;MOV	EndPtrH,DS		; seg pointer to end of dir
 46868 00007E0E 8C5EFE                  	mov	[bp-2],ds
 46869 00007E11 1E                      	PUSH	DS
 46870 00007E12 07                      	POP	ES			; destination for nul search
 46871 00007E13 89D7                    	MOV	DI,DX
 46872 00007E15 89F9                    	MOV	CX,DI

 46874                                  	; MSDOS 6.0

 47799                                  ;Break <ShareEnter - attempt to enter a node into the sharing set>
 47800                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47801                                  ;   ShareEnter - perform a retried entry of a nodde into the sharing set. If
 47802                                  ;   the max number of retries is exceeded, we notify the user via int 24.
 47803                                  ;
 47804                                  ;   Inputs:     ThisSFT points to the SFT
 47805                                  ;               WFP_Start points to the WFP
 47806                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry clear => successful entry
 47807                                  ;               Carry set => failed system call
 47808                                  ;   Registers modified: all
 47809                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47810                                  
 47811                                  ShareEnter:
 47812 000080B8 51                      	push	cx
 47813                                  retry:
 47814 000080B9 8B0E[1A00]              	mov     cx,[RetryCount]
 47815                                  attempt:
 47816 000080BD C43E[9E05]              	les     di,[THISSFT]		; grab sft
 47817 000080C1 31C0                    	XOR     AX,AX
 47818                                   	;mov	[es:di+51],ax
 47819 000080C3 26894533                	MOV     [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_MFT],AX ; indicate free SFT
 47820 000080C7 51                      	push	cx
 47821 000080C8 E8ABFF                  	call    SHARE_CHECK             ; attempt to enter into the sharing set
 47822 000080CB 59                      	pop	cx
 47823 000080CC 730A                    	jnc	short done		; success, let the user see this
 47824 000080CE E80497                  	call	Idle                    ; wait a while
 47825 000080D1 E2EA                    	loop    attempt                 ; go back for another attempt
 47826 000080D3 E8A5FF                  	call    SHARE_VIOLATION         ; signal the problem to the user
 47827 000080D6 73E1                    	jnc	short retry		; user said to retry, go do it
 47828                                  done:
 47829 000080D8 59                      	pop	cx
 47830 000080D9 C3                      	retn

 47839                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47840                                  ;	Contains the foll:
 47841                                  ;
 47842                                  ;		- code to find and overlay buggy unpack code

 47852                                  ;
 47853                                  ; M020 : Fix for rational bug - for details see routine header
 47854                                  ; M028 : 4b04 implementation
 47855                                  ; M030 : Fixing bug in EXEPACKPATCH (EXEC_CS is an un-relocated value)
 47856                                  ; M032 : set turnoff bit only if DOS in HMA.
 47857                                  ; M033 : if IP < 2 then not exepacked.
 47858                                  ; M046 : support for a 4th version of exepacked files.
 47859                                  ; M068 : support for copy protected apps.

 48061                                  ;
 48062                                  ; Procedure Name : WhatCPUType
 48063                                  ;
 48064                                  ; Inputs	 : none
 48065                                  ;
 48066                                  ; Outputs	 : AL = 0 if CPU <  286
 48067                                  ;		      = 1 if CPU == 286
 48068                                  ;		      = 2 if CPU >= 386
 48069                                  ;
 48070                                  ; Regs. Mod.	 : AX
 48071                                  ;
 48072                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 48073                                  
 48074                                  WhatCPUType:
 48075                                  	; 25/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 48076                                  	;get_cpu_type	; done with a MACRO which can't be generated > once
 48077                                  
 48078                                  	;CPUTYPE.INC (MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
 48079                                  
 48080                                  ; Note: this must be a macro, and not a subroutine in the BIOS since
 48081                                  ; 	it is called from both CODE and SYSINITSEG.
 48082                                  ;
 48083                                  ;------GET_CPU_TYPE-----------------------------------May, 88 by M.Williamson
 48084                                  ;  Returns: AX = 0 if 8086 or 8088
 48085                                  ;              = 1 if 80286
 48086                                  ;              = 2 if 80386
 48087                                  
 48088                                  	; 04/11/2022
 48089                                  	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BB03h
 48090                                  
 48091                                  	; 22/03/2024
 48092                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0CCEDh
 48093                                  
 48094                                  Get_CPU_Type:	;macro
 48095 00008150 9C                      	pushf
 48096 00008151 53                      	push	bx			; preserve bx
 48097 00008152 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx			; init bx to zero
 48098                                  
 48099 00008154 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax			; 0000 into AX
 48100 00008156 50                      	push	ax			; put it on the stack...
 48101 00008157 9D                      	popf				; ...then shove it into the flags
 48102 00008158 9C                      	pushf				; get it back out of the flags...
 48103 00008159 58                      	pop	ax			; ...and into ax
 48104 0000815A 2500F0                  	and	ax,0F000h		; mask off high four bits
 48105 0000815D 3D00F0                  	cmp	ax,0F000h		; was it all 1's?
 48106 00008160 740E                    	je	short cpu_8086		; aye; it's an 8086 or 8088
 48107                                  
 48108 00008162 B800F0                  	mov	ax,0F000h		; now try to set the high four bits..
 48109 00008165 50                      	push	ax
 48110 00008166 9D                      	popf
 48111 00008167 9C                      	pushf
 48112 00008168 58                      	pop	ax			; ...and see what happens
 48113 00008169 2500F0                  	and	ax,0F000h		; any high bits set ?
 48114 0000816C 7401                    	jz	short cpu_286		; nay; it's an 80286
 48115                                  cpu_386:				; bx starts as zero
 48116 0000816E 43                      	inc	bx			; inc twice if 386
 48117                                  cpu_286:				; just inc once if 286
 48118 0000816F 43                      	inc	bx
 48119                                  cpu_8086:				; don't inc at all if 086
 48120 00008170 89D8                    	mov	ax,bx			; put CPU type value in ax
 48121 00008172 5B                      	pop	bx			; restore original bx
 48122 00008173 9D                      	popf
 48123                                  	
 48124                                  	;endm
 48125                                  
 48126                                  	; 04/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 48127 00008174 C3                      	retn	; 19/09/2023
 48128

 48130                                  %endif	; 28/12/2022

 49633                                  ; 	Procedure Name	:	patch_in_nops
 49634                                  ;
 49635                                  ; 	Entry		: 	ES -> DOSDATA
 49636                                  ;
 49637                                  ;	Regs Mod	: 	cx, di
 49638                                  ;
 49639                                  ;	Description:
 49640                                  ;		This routine patches in 2 nops at the offsets specified in 
 49641                                  ;	patch_table. This basically enables the low mem stub to start 
 49642                                  ;	making XMS calls.
 49643                                  ;
 49644                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 49645                                  
 49646                                  	; 04/11/2022
 49647                                  	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BC50h
 49648                                  
 49649                                  	; 23/03/2024
 49650                                  	; MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BF42h
 49651                                  	; 23/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 49652                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0D1E9h
 49653                                  
 49654                                  patch_table:	; label	byte
 49655                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i0patch
 49656                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i20patch
 49657                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i21patch
 49658                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i25patch
 49659                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i26patch
 49660                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i27patch
 49661                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i2fpatch
 49662                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:cpmpatch
 49663 000085C6 [700F]                  	dw	i0patch
 49664 000085C8 [7A0F]                  	dw	i20patch
 49665 000085CA [840F]                  	dw	i21patch
 49666 000085CC [8E0F]                  	dw	i25patch
 49667 000085CE [980F]                  	dw	i26patch
 49668 000085D0 [A20F]                  	dw	i27patch
 49669 000085D2 [AC0F]                  	dw	i2fpatch
 49670 000085D4 [B60F]                  	dw	cpmpatch
 49671                                  
 49672                                  patch_table_size equ ($-patch_table)/2
 49673                                  
 49674                                  patch_in_nops:
 49675 000085D6 50                      	push	ax
 49676 000085D7 56                      	push	si
 49677 000085D8 BE[C685]                	mov	si,patch_table
 49678 000085DB B89090                  	mov	ax,9090h ; nop, nop
 49679                                  	; 17/12/2022
 49680                                  	; cx = 0
 49681                                  	;mov	cx,8
 49682                                  	;mov	cx,patch_table_size ; 8
 49683 000085DE B108                    	mov	cl,patch_table_size ; 8
 49684                                  pin_loop:
 49685 000085E0 2E8B3C                  	mov	di,[cs:si]
 49686 000085E3 AB                      	stosw
 49687                                  	;add	si,2
 49688                                  	; 17/12/2022
 49689 000085E4 46                      	inc	si
 49690 000085E5 46                      	inc	si
 49691 000085E6 E2F8                    	loop	pin_loop
 49692 000085E8 5E                      	pop	si
 49693 000085E9 58                      	pop	ax
 49694 000085EA C3                      	retn

 49903                                  ;;
 49904                                  ;;	AH = 52h
 49905                                  ;;
 49906                                  ;;	on return:
 49907                                  ;;	ES:BX = pointer to DOS "invars", a table of pointers used by DOS.

 49909                                  ;;
 49910                                  ;;	Offset Size		 Description
 49911                                  ;;
 49912                                  ;;	 -12   word   sharing retry count (DOS 3.1-3.3)
 49913                                  ;;	 -10   word   sharing retry delay  (DOS 3.1-3.3)
 49914                                  ;;	  -8   dword  pointer to current disk buffer (DOS 3.x)
 49915                                  ;;	  -4   word   pointer in DOS code segment of unread CON input;
 49916                                  ;;		      0 indicates no unread input (DOS 3.x)
 49917                                  ;;	  -2   word   segment of first Memory Control Block (MCB)
 49918                                  ;;	  00   dword  pointer to first DRIVE PARAMETER TABLE (A:) in chain
 49919                                  ;;	  04   dword  pointer to DOS System File Table (SFT)
 49920                                  ;;	  08   dword  pointer to $CLOCK device driver
 49921                                  ;;	  0C   dword  pointer to CON device driver
 49922                                  ;;	  10   byte   number of logical drives in system
 49923                                  ;;	  11   word   maximum bytes/block of any block device
 49924                                  ;;	  13   dword  pointer to DOS cache buffer header
 49925                                  ;;	  17 18bytes  NUL device header, first 4 bytes of device header
 49926                                  ;;		      point to the next device in device chain

 50141                                  
 50142                                  ;Break <Initialized data and data used at DOS initialization>
 50143                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 50144                                  
 50145                                  ; We need to identify the parts of the data area that are relevant to tasks
 50146                                  ; and those that are relevant to the system as a whole.  Under 3.0, the system
 50147                                  ; data will be gathered with the system code.  The process data under 2.x will
 50148                                  ; be available for swapping and under 3.0 it will be allocated per-process.
 50149                                  ;
 50150                                  ; The data that is system data will be identified by [SYSTEM] in the comments
 50151                                  ; describing that data item.
 50152                                  
 50153                                  ;DOSDATA SEGMENT WORD PUBLIC 'DATA'
 50154                                  
 50155                                  ;
 50156                                  ; Table of routines for assignable devices
 50157                                  ;
 50158                                  ; MSDOS allows assignment if the following standard devices:
 50159                                  ;   stdin  (usually CON input)
 50160                                  ;   stdout (usually CON output)
 50161                                  ;   auxin  (usually AUX input)
 50162                                  ;   auxout (usually AUX output)
 50163                                  ;   stdlpt (usually PRN output)
 50164                                  ;
 50165                                  ; SPECIAL NOTE:
 50166                                  ;   Status of a file is a strange idea. We choose to handle it in this manner:
 50167                                  ;   If we're not at end-of-file, then we always say that we have a character.
 50168                                  ;   Otherwise, we return ^Z as the character and set the ZERO flag. In this
 50169                                  ;   manner we can support program written under the old DOS (they use ^Z as EOF
 50170                                  ;   on devices) and programs written under the new DOS (they use the ZERO flag
 50171                                  ;   as EOF).
 50172                                  
 50173                                  ; Default SFTs for boot up
 50174                                  
 50175                                  		;PUBLIC	SFTABL
 50176                                  
 50177                                  SFTABL:	   ; LABEL   DWORD		; [SYSTEM] file table
 50178 000000CC FFFF                    		DW -1			; [SYSTEM] link to next table
 50179 000000CE FFFF                    		DW -1			; [SYSTEM] link seg to next table
 50180                                  		;dw 5 ; 24/03/2024
 50181 000000D0 0500                    		DW sf_default_number	; [SYSTEM] Number of entries in table
 50182                                  		;times 295 db 0 ; MSDOS 6.0 ; PCDOS 7.1  ; 24/03/2024
 50183 000000D2 00<rep 127h>            		times (sf_default_number*sf_entry_size) db 0
 50184

 50186                                  ; cursor. They are only meaningful when stdin/stdout are assigned to the
 50187                                  ; console.

 50191                                  					;	   of buffered input call

 50193 0000027B 00<rep 83h>             CONBUF:		times 131 db 0		; [SYSTEM] The rest of INBUF and console buffer
 50194                                  		; DOSDATA:02FEh (MSDOS 6.21) ; PCDOS 7.1

 50196 000002FF 00                      VERFLG:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] Initialize with verify off
 50197 00000300 03                      CHARCO:		db 00000011b ; 3	; [SYSTEM] Allows statchks every 4 chars...
 50198                                  switch_character:
 50199 00000301 2F                      chSwitch:	db '/'			; UNUSED - obsolete datum, can be reused
 50200 00000302 00                      AllocMethod:	db 0			; [SYSTEM] how to alloc first(best)last
 50201 00000303 00                      fShare:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] TRUE => sharing installed
