 50420                                  ; This data section which was named as uninitialized data
 50421                                  ; (as overlayed by initialization code) but follows 
 50422                                  ; initialized data section from DOSDATA:03B6h address
 50423                                  ; (in otherwords, the method is different than MSDOS 3.3,
 50424                                  ; and there is not overlaying..)
 50425                                  ; **********************************************************
 50426                                  ; Reference: MSDOS 6.21 kernel DOSDATA section (4970 bytes)
 50427                                  ; follows DOSCODE section in the kernel file (MSDOS.SYS) 
 50428                                  ; (it is located at offset 0BF70h, file offset 0BF70h-3DE0h) 
 50429                                  ; but starts from offset 0 (ORG 0) and ends at offset 1370h.
 50430                                  ; TIMEBUF is at offset 03B6h.
 50431                                  ; **********************************************************

 51031                                  
 51032                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51033                                  ;
 51034                                  ;CASE MAPPER ROUTINE FOR 80H-FFH character range, DOS 3.3
 51035                                  ;     ENTRY: AL = Character to map
 51036                                  ;     EXIT:  AL = The converted character
 51037                                  ; Alters no registers except AL and flags.
 51038                                  ; The routine should do nothing to chars below 80H.
 51039                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51040                                  ; Example:
 51041                                  
 51042                                  MAP_CASE:
 51043                                  ;Procedure MAP_CASE,FAR
 51044                                  
 51045 00000D6B 3C80                    	CMP	AL,80h
 51046                                  	;JAE	short Map1	;Map no chars below 80H ever
 51047                                  	;RETF
 51048                                  	; 24/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 51049                                  	;;;
 51050 00000D6D 720C                    	jb	short L_RET     ;Map no chars below 80H ever
 51051                                  	;;;
 51052                                  Map1:
 51053 00000D6F 2C80                    	SUB	AL,80h		;Turn into index value
 51054 00000D71 1E                      	PUSH	DS
 51055 00000D72 53                      	PUSH	BX
 51056 00000D73 BB[FC0A]                	MOV	BX,UCASE_TAB+2
 51057                                  FINISH:
 51058 00000D76 0E                      	PUSH	CS		;Move to DS
 51059 00000D77 1F                      	POP	DS
 51060 00000D78 D7                      	XLAT			;Get upper case character
 51061 00000D79 5B                      	POP	BX
 51062 00000D7A 1F                      	POP	DS
 51063                                  L_RET:	
 51064 00000D7B CB                      	RETF
 51065                                  
 51066                                  ;EndProc MAP_CASE

 51421                                  ; errors. Each entry is 4 bytes long:
 51422                                  ;

 51424                                  ;
 51425                                  ; A value of 0FFh indicates a call specific value (ie. should already
 51426                                  ; be set). AN ERROR CODE NOT IN THE TABLE FALLS THROUGH TO THE CATCH ALL AT
 51427                                  ; THE END, IT IS ASSUMES THAT CLASS, ACTION, LOCUS IS ALREADY SET.
 51428                                  ;
 51429                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 51432                                  ;ifidn <locus>,<0FFh>

 51434                                  ;ELSE
 51435                                  ;    DB  error_&err,errCLASS_&class,errACT_&action,errLOC_&locus

 51857                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51858                                  ;
 51859                                  ; LOW MEM STUB:
 51860                                  ;
 51861                                  ; The low mem stub contains the entry points into DOS for all interrupts
 51862                                  ; handled by DOS. This stub is installed if the user specifies that the
 51863                                  ; DOS load in HIMEM. Each entry point does this.
 51864                                  ;
 51865                                  ; 	1. if jmp to 8 has been patched out
 51866                                  ;	   2. if A20 OFF
 51867                                  ;	      3. Enable A20
 51868                                  ;	   4. else 
 51869                                  ;	      5. just go to dos entry
 51870                                  ;	   6. endif
 51871                                  ;	7. else
 51872                                  ;	   8. just go to dos entry
 51873                                  ;	9. endif
 51874                                  ;
 51875                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51876                                  
 51877                                  ; 27/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 51878                                  
 51879                                  ; DOSDATA:108Ah (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 51880                                  
 51881                                  ; 25/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 51882                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSDATA:0F9Eh
 51883                                  
 51884                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51885                                  ;
 51886                                  ; DIVIDE BY 0 handler
 51887                                  ;
 51888                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51889                                  
 51890                                  ldivov:
 51891                                  	; The following jump, skipping the XMS calls will be patched to
 51892                                  	; NOPS by SEG_REINIT if DOS successfully loads high. This jump is
 51893                                  	; needed because the stub is installed even before the XMS driver
 51894                                  	; is loaded if the user specifies dos=high in the config.sys
 51895                                  i0patch:
 51896 00000F70 EB03                    	jmp	short divov_cont
 51897                                  
 51898 00000F72 E8E200                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; we must turn on A20 if OFF
 51899                                  divov_cont:
 51900 00000F75 2EFF2E[4C0F]            	jmp	far [cs:DOSINTTABLE]	; jmp to DOS
 51901                                  
 51902                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51903                                  ;
 51904                                  ; INT 20h Handler
 51905                                  ;
 51906                                  ; Here we do not have to set up the stack to return here as the abort call
 51907                                  ; will return to the address after the int 21 ah=4b call. This would be the
 51908                                  ; common exit point if A20 had been OFF (for TOGGLE DOS) and the A20 line
 51909                                  ; will be restored then.
 51910                                  ;
 51911                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51912                                  
 51913                                  lquit:
 51914                                  	; The following jump, skipping the XMS calls will be patched to
 51915                                  	; NOPS by SEG_REINIT if DOS successfully loads high. This jump is
 51916                                  	; needed because the stub is installed even before the XMS driver
 51917                                  	; is loaded if the user specifies dos=high in the config.sys
 51918                                  i20patch:
 51919 00000F7A EB03                    	jmp	short quit_cont
 51920                                  
 51921 00000F7C E8D800                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; we must turn on A20 if OFF
 51922                                  quit_cont:
 51923 00000F7F 2EFF2E[500F]            	jmp	far [cs:DOSINTTABLE+4]	; jump to DOS
 51924                                  
 51925                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51926                                  ;
 51927                                  ; INT 21h Handler
 51928                                  ;
 51929                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 51930                                  
 51931                                  lcommand:
 51932                                  	; The following jump, skipping the XMS calls will be patched to
 51933                                  	; NOPS by SEG_REINIT if DOS successfully loads high. This jump is
 51934                                  	; needed because the stub is installed even before the XMS driver
 51935                                  	; is loaded if the user specifies dos=high in the config.sys
 51936                                  i21patch:
 51937 00000F84 EB03                    	jmp	short command_cont
 51938                                  
 51939 00000F86 E8CE00                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; we must turn on A20 if OFF
 51940                                  command_cont:
 51941 00000F89 2EFF2E[540F]            	jmp	far [cs:DOSINTTABLE+8]	; jmp to DOS

 52043                                  
 52044                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 52045                                  ;
 52046                                  ; LowIntXX:
 52047                                  ;
 52048                                  ; Interrupts from DOS that pass control to a user program must be done from
 52049                                  ; low memory, as the user program may change the state of the A20 line or
 52050                                  ; they may require that the A20 line be OFF. The following piece of code is
 52051                                  ; far call'd from the following places in DOS:
 52052                                  ;
 52053                                  ;	1. msctrlc.asm where dos issues an int 23h (ctrlc)
 52054                                  ;	2. msctrlc.asm where dos issues an int 24h (critical error)
 52055                                  ;	3. msctrlc.asm where dos issues an int 28h (idle int)
 52056                                  ;
 52057                                  ; The int 23 and int 24 handlers may decide to do a far return instead of an
 52058                                  ; IRET ane leave the flags on the stack. Therefore we save the return address
 52059                                  ; before doing the ints and then do a far junp back into DOS.
 52060                                  ;
 52061                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 52062                                  
 52063                                  ; 25/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 52064                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSDATA:0FEEh
 52065                                  ; (MSDOS 5.0-6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSDATA:10DBh)
 52066                                  
 52067 00000FC0 00000000                DosRetAddr23:	dd	0
 52068 00000FC4 00000000                DosRetAddr24:	dd	0
 52069                                  
 52070                                  ; 25/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 52071                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 52072                                  %if 0
 52073                                  DosRetAddr28:	dd	0
 52074                                  %endif
 52075                                  
 52076                                  	; Execute int 23h from low memory
 52077                                  LowInt23:
 52078                                  					; save the return address that is on
 52079                                  					; the stack
 52080 00000FC8 2E8F06[C00F]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr23]
 52081 00000FCD 2E8F06[C20F]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr23+2]
 52082                                  
 52083 00000FD2 CD23                    	int	23h			; ctrl C
 52084                                  					; turn on A20 it has been turned OFF
 52085                                  					; by int 28/23/24 handler.
 52086                                  
 52087 00000FD4 E88000                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; M011: we must turn on A20 if OFF
 52088                                  
 52089 00000FD7 2EFF2E[C00F]            	jmp	far [cs:DosRetAddr23]	; jump back to DOS
 52090                                  
 52091                                  
 52092                                  	; Execute int 24h from low memory
 52093                                  LowInt24:
 52094                                  					; save the return address that is on
 52095                                  					; the stack
 52096 00000FDC 2E8F06[C40F]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr24]
 52097 00000FE1 2E8F06[C60F]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr24+2]
 52098                                  
 52099 00000FE6 CD24                    	int	24h			; crit error
 52100                                  					; turn on A20 it has been turned OFF
 52101                                  					; by int 28/23/24 handler.
 52102                                  
 52103 00000FE8 E86C00                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; M011: we must turn on A20 if OFF
 52104                                  
 52105 00000FEB 2EFF2E[C40F]            	jmp	far [cs:DosRetAddr24]	; jump back to DOS
 52106                                  
 52107                                  
 52108                                   
 52109                                  	; Execute int 28h from low memory
 52110                                  LowInt28:
 52111 00000FF0 CD28                    	int	28h			; idle int
 52112                                  					; turn on A20 it has been turned OFF
 52113                                  					; by int 28/23/24 handler.
 52114                                  
 52115 00000FF2 E86200                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; M011: we must turn on A20 if OFF
 52116                                  
 52117 00000FF5 CB                      	retf
 52118                                  
 52119                                  ; DOSDATA:1115h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 52120                                  
 52121                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 52122                                  ;
 52123                                  ; int 21 ah=4b (exec) call will jump to the following label before xferring
 52124                                  ; control to the exec'd program. We turn off A20 inorder to allow programs
 52125                                  ; that have been packed by the faulty exepack utility to unpack correctly.
 52126                                  ; This is so because exepac'd programs rely on address wrap.
 52127                                  ;
 52128                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 52129                                  
 52130                                  ; 25/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 52131                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSDATA:1024h
 52132                                  
 52133                                  disa20_xfer:
 52134 00000FF6 E84800                  	call	XMMDisableA20		; disable A20
 52135                                  
 52136                                  	; Look at msproc.asm at label exec_go for understanding the following:
 52137                                  
 52138                                  	; DS:SI points to entry point
 52139                                  	; AX:DI points to initial stack
 52140                                  	; DX has PDB pointer
 52141                                  	; BX has initial AX value
 52142                                  
 52143 00000FF9 FA                      	cli
 52144 00000FFA 2EC606[2103]00          	mov	byte [cs:INDOS],0	; SS Override
 52145                                  
 52146                                  	; 25/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 52147                                  	;;;
 52148 00001000 36C606[C011]00          	mov     byte [ss:INDOS_FLAG],0
 52149                                  	;;;
 52150                                  
 52151 00001006 8ED0                    	mov	SS,AX			; set up user's stack
 52152 00001008 89FC                    	mov	SP,DI			; and SP
 52153 0000100A FB                      	sti
 52154                                  
 52155 0000100B 1E                      	push	DS			; fake long call to entry
 52156 0000100C 56                      	push	SI
 52157 0000100D 8EC2                    	mov	ES,DX			; set up proper seg registers
 52158 0000100F 8EDA                    	mov	DS,DX
 52159 00001011 89D8                    	mov	AX,BX			; set up proper AX
 52160 00001013 CB                      	retf
 52161                                  
 52162                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 52163                                  ;
 52164                                  ; M003:
 52165                                  ;
 52166                                  ; If an int 21 ah=25 call is made immediately after an exec call, DOS will
 52167                                  ; come here, turn A20 OFF restore user stack and registers before returning
 52168                                  ; to user. This is done in dos\msdisp.asm. This has been done to support 
 52169                                  ; programs compiled with MS PASCAL 3.2. See under TAG M003 in DOSSYM.INC for
 52170                                  ; more info.
 52171                                  ;
 52172                                  ; Also at this point DS is DOSDATA. So we can assume DS DOSDATA. Note that
 52173                                  ; SS is also DOS stack. It is important that we do the XMS call on DOS's
 52174                                  ; stack to avoid additional stack overhead for the user.
 52175                                  ;
 52176                                  ; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 52177                                  
 52178                                  disa20_iret:
 52179 00001014 E82A00                  	call	XMMDisableA20
 52180 00001017 FE0E[2103]              	dec	byte [INDOS]
 52181                                  
 52182                                  	; 25/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 52183                                  	;;;
 52184 0000101B FE0E[C011]              	dec	byte [INDOS_FLAG]
 52185                                  	;;;
 52186                                  
 52187 0000101F 8E16[8605]              	mov	SS,[USER_SS]		; restore user stack
 52188 00001023 8B26[8405]              	mov	SP,[USER_SP]
 52189 00001027 89E5                    	mov	BP,SP
 52190                                  	;mov	[BP+user_env.user_AX],AL
 52191 00001029 884600                  	mov	[bp],al
 52192                                  	
 52193                                  ; 25/03/2024
 52194                                  %if 0
 52195                                  	mov	AX,[NSP]
 52196                                  	mov	[USER_SP],AX
 52197                                  	mov	AX,[NSS]
 52198                                  	mov	[USER_SS],AX
 52199                                  %else
 52200                                  	; 25/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 52201                                  	;;;
 52202                                  	;les	ax, dword ptr ds:NSS
 52203 0000102C C406[F005]              	les	ax,[NSS]
 52204 00001030 8C06[8405]              	mov	[USER_SP],es
 52205 00001034 A3[8605]                	mov	[USER_SS],ax
 52206                                  	;;;
 52207                                  %endif
 52208 00001037 58                      	pop	AX			; restore user regs
 52209 00001038 5B                      	pop	BX
 52210 00001039 59                      	pop	CX
 52211 0000103A 5A                      	pop	DX
 52212 0000103B 5E                      	pop	SI
 52213 0000103C 5F                      	pop	DI
 52214 0000103D 5D                      	pop	BP
 52215 0000103E 1F                      	pop	DS
 52216 0000103F 07                      	pop	ES
 52217                                  lirett:		; 25/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 52218 00001040 CF                      	iret

 52222                                  ;
 52223                                  ;	This routine is used to disable the 20th address line in
 52224                                  ;	the system using XMM calls.
 52225                                  ;
 52226                                  ;	ENTRY	none		;ds = _DATA
 52227                                  ;	EXIT	A20 line disabled

 52240 0000104C C3                      	retn

 53026                                  ;============================================================================
 53027                                  ; MPATCH.ASM (MSDOS 6.0, 1993)
 53028                                  ;============================================================================
 53029                                  ; 27/04/2019 - Retro DOS 4.0
 53030                                  
 53031                                  ;mpatch.asm -- holds data patch location for callouts
 53032                                  ; -- allocate cluster in rom.asm
 53033                                  ;
 53034                                  ; This area is pointed to by OffsetMagicPatch[609h] in fixed DOS data.
 53035                                  ; Currently, this location is used only by magicdrv.sys's patch to
 53036                                  ; cluster allocation, however it can be expanded to be used by other
 53037                                  ; patches. This is important since we have an easy-access pointer to
 53038                                  ; this location in OffsetMagicPatch. Magicdrv.sys is guaranteed to
 53039                                  ; only patch out a far call/retf, so any space after that could be
 53040                                  ; used as a patch by using OffsetMagicPatch+6. See rom.asm on how
 53041                                  ; to call out here.
 53042                                  ;
 53043                                  ; Currently, we allocate only the minimum space required for the 6
 53044                                  ; byte magicdrv patch, so if you change the dos data, you may want
 53045                                  ; to reserve space here if your new data will be position dependent
 53046                                  ; and would prohibit growing of this table.
 53047                                  ;
 53048                                  ;history	-	created 8-7-92 by scottq
 53049                                  ;		-	added Rational386PatchPtr 2-1-93 by jimmat
 53050                                  ;
 53051                                  ;Exported Functions
 53052                                  ;==================
 53053                                  ;MagicPatch     -       callout patched by magidrv.sys for cluster allocations
 53054                                  
 53055                                  ; DosData Segment
 53056                                  
 53057                                  ; DOSDATA:1362h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 53058                                  
 53059                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 53060                                  
 53061                                  ; Rational386PatchPtr points to either a RET instruction (80286 or less) or
 53062                                  ; a routine to fix buggy versions of the Rational DOS Extender (80386 or
 53063                                  ; greater). Added to this file because it needed to be somewhere and is
 53064                                  ; 'patch' related.
 53065                                  
 53066                                  Rational386PatchPtr:
 53067 00001246 0000                    	dw	0	; points to patch routine or RET instr.
 53068                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 53069                                  
 53070                                  ; 25/03/2024
 53071                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSDATA:1340h
 53072                                  ; (Windows ME IO.SYS - DOSDATA:133Eh)
 53073                                  
 53074                                  ; 07/03/2025
 53075                                  %if 0
 53076                                  MagicPatch:
 53077                                  ;MagicPatch proc far
 53078                                          retf            ;default is to just return to allocate
 53079                                          nop             ;however, this code will be patched
 53080                                          nop             ;by magicdrv.sys to
 53081                                          nop             ; call far ?:?     
 53082                                          nop             ; retf or perhaps just jmp far
 53083                                          nop             ;retf/nop take one byte, so we need six instructions
 53084                                                          ;for 6 byte patch
 53085                                  ;MagicPatch endp
 53086                                  %endif
 53087                                  
 53088                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
